if (eliminatedOverviewToggle) {
  eliminatedOverviewToggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
    playersTable.classList.toggle("eliminated-overviews-collapsed");

var POWER_BAR_STYLE_STORAGE_KEY = "powerBarStyle";
var POWER_BAR_STYLE_FULL = "full";
var POWER_BAR_STYLE_CONDENSED = "condensed";
var POWER_BAR_STYLE_CLASSIC = "classic";
var PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_STORAGE_KEY = "playerBoxPosition";
var PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_AUTOMATIC = "automatic";
var PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_RIGHT = "right";
var PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_BOTTOM = "bottom";
var playerBoxPositionPreference = localStorage.getItem(PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_STORAGE_KEY) || PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_AUTOMATIC;

if (![PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_AUTOMATIC, PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_RIGHT, PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_BOTTOM].includes(playerBoxPositionPreference)) {
  playerBoxPositionPreference = PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_AUTOMATIC;
}

if (powerBarSettingsMenu) {
  document.body.appendChild(powerBarSettingsMenu);
  var hasPowerBars = !!playersTable.querySelector(".player-overview-bar");
  powerBarSettingsMenu.style.display = "none";

  if (hasPowerBars) {
    var storedPowerBarStyle = localStorage.getItem(POWER_BAR_STYLE_STORAGE_KEY);
    applyPowerBarStyle([POWER_BAR_STYLE_FULL, POWER_BAR_STYLE_CLASSIC].includes(storedPowerBarStyle) ? storedPowerBarStyle : POWER_BAR_STYLE_CONDENSED);
  }

  syncPowerBarSettingsMenu();
  playersTable.addEventListener("contextmenu", function (event) {
    if (!event.target.closest(".player-overview-container")) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    showPowerBarSettingsMenu(event.pageX, event.pageY);
  });
  powerBarSettingsMenu.addEventListener("change", function (event) {
    var input = event.target;
    if (!input.matches("input[type='radio'], input[type='checkbox']")) return;

    if (input.name === "power-bar-style") {
      setPowerBarStyle(input.value, true);
    } else if (input.name === "player-box-position") {
      setPlayerBoxPosition(input.value);
    }
  });
  powerBarSettingsMenu.addEventListener("contextmenu", function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    hidePowerBarSettingsMenu();
  });
  document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
    if (!powerBarSettingsMenu.contains(event.target)) {
      hidePowerBarSettingsMenu();
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      hidePowerBarSettingsMenu();
    }
  });
}

function showPowerBarSettingsMenu(x, y) {
  syncPowerBarSettingsMenu();
  document.body.classList.add("power-bar-settings-open");
  powerBarSettingsMenu.style.display = "block";
  var menuRect = powerBarSettingsMenu.getBoundingClientRect();
  var maxLeft = window.scrollX + window.innerWidth - menuRect.width - 4;
  var maxTop = window.scrollY + window.innerHeight - menuRect.height - 4;
  var left = Math.min(x, maxLeft);
  var top = Math.min(y, maxTop);
  powerBarSettingsMenu.style.left = Math.max(window.scrollX + 4, left) + "px";
  powerBarSettingsMenu.style.top = Math.max(window.scrollY + 4, top) + "px";
}

function hidePowerBarSettingsMenu() {
  document.body.classList.remove("power-bar-settings-open");
  powerBarSettingsMenu.style.display = "none";
}

function syncPowerBarSettingsMenu() {
  var powerStyle = playersTable.classList.contains("power-bars-full-box") ? POWER_BAR_STYLE_FULL : playersTable.classList.contains("power-bars-classic") ? POWER_BAR_STYLE_CLASSIC : POWER_BAR_STYLE_CONDENSED;
  var powerStyleInput = powerBarSettingsMenu.querySelector("input[name='power-bar-style'][value='" + powerStyle + "']");
  var playerPositionInput = powerBarSettingsMenu.querySelector("input[name='player-box-position'][value='" + playerBoxPositionPreference + "']");

  if (powerStyleInput) {
    powerStyleInput.checked = true;
  }

  if (playerPositionInput) {
    playerPositionInput.checked = true;
  }
}

function setPlayerBoxPosition(position) {
  if (![PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_AUTOMATIC, PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_RIGHT, PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_BOTTOM].includes(position)) {
    position = PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_AUTOMATIC;
  }

  playerBoxPositionPreference = position;
  localStorage.setItem(PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_STORAGE_KEY, position);
  syncPowerBarSettingsMenu();
  applyScale(0);
}

function setPowerBarStyle(style) {
  var refreshLayout = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;

  if (![POWER_BAR_STYLE_FULL, POWER_BAR_STYLE_CONDENSED, POWER_BAR_STYLE_CLASSIC].includes(style)) {
    style = POWER_BAR_STYLE_CONDENSED;
  }

  var needsReload = style === POWER_BAR_STYLE_FULL;
  localStorage.setItem(POWER_BAR_STYLE_STORAGE_KEY, style);

  if (needsReload) {
    location.reload();
    return;
  }

  applyPowerBarStyle(style);

  if (refreshLayout) {
    applyScale(0);
  }
}

function applyPowerBarStyle(style) {
  if (![POWER_BAR_STYLE_FULL, POWER_BAR_STYLE_CONDENSED, POWER_BAR_STYLE_CLASSIC].includes(style)) {
    style = POWER_BAR_STYLE_CONDENSED;
  }

  var fullBox = style === POWER_BAR_STYLE_FULL;
  var classicStyle = style === POWER_BAR_STYLE_CLASSIC;
  playersTable.classList.remove("power-bars-full-box", "power-bars-condensed", "power-bars-classic");
  playersTable.querySelectorAll(".player-overview-container").forEach(function (playerBox) {
    var content = playerBox.querySelector(".player-overview-content");
    var main = playerBox.querySelector(".player-overview-main");
    var overview = playerBox.querySelector(".player-overview");
    var bar = playerBox.querySelector(".player-overview-bar");
    if (!content || !main || !overview || !bar) return;

    if (fullBox) {
      main.appendChild(bar);
    } else if (classicStyle) {
      overview.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", bar);
    } else {
      main.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", bar);
    }
  });
  playersTable.classList.toggle("power-bars-full-box", fullBox);
  playersTable.classList.toggle("power-bars-condensed", style === POWER_BAR_STYLE_CONDENSED);
  playersTable.classList.toggle("power-bars-classic", classicStyle);

  if (powerBarSettingsMenu) {
    syncPowerBarSettingsMenu();
  }

  localStorage.setItem(POWER_BAR_STYLE_STORAGE_KEY, style);
}

function updateEliminatedOverviewToggle() {
  if (!eliminatedOverviewToggle) return;
  var hasEliminatedPlayers = !!playersTable.querySelector(".player-overview-eliminated");
  eliminatedOverviewToggle.style.display = hasEliminatedPlayers ? "block" : "none";
}

function getViewerPId() {

      var otherPId = _step2.value;

      if (otherPId == currentTurn) {
        return otherPId;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    _iterator2.e(err);
  } finally {
    _iterator2.f();
  }

  return viewerPId;
} //End turn confirmation

var playerKeys = Object.keys(playersInfo).map(function (key) {
  return parseInt(key);
});
playerKeys.sort(function (a, b) {
  if (!playersInfo[a] || !playersInfo[b]) return;
  return playersInfo[a].players_order - playersInfo[b].players_order;
});

function updateBuildingCounts() {
  var totalCounts = {
    city: 0,
    base: 0,
    airport: 0,
    port: 0,
    hq: 0,
    lab: 0,
    comtower: 0
  }; // Initialize per player counts

  var countsPerPlayer = {};

  var _iterator3 = _createForOfIteratorHelper(playerKeys),
      _step3;

  try {
    for (_iterator3.s(); !(_step3 = _iterator3.n()).done;) {
      var _playerId = _step3.value;
      countsPerPlayer[_playerId] = _objectSpread({}, totalCounts);
    } // Initialize neutral properties counter, in fog this will include all non-discovered properties

  } catch (err) {
    _iterator3.e(err);
  } finally {
    _iterator3.f();
  }

  countsPerPlayer[""] = _objectSpread({}, totalCounts);

  for (var _i = 0, _Object$entries = Object.entries(buildingsInfo); _i < _Object$entries.length; _i++) {
    var _Object$entries$_i = _slicedToArray(_Object$entries[_i], 2),
        _x = _Object$entries$_i[0],
        row = _Object$entries$_i[1];

    for (var _i2 = 0, _Object$entries2 = Object.entries(row); _i2 < _Object$entries2.length; _i2++) {
      var _info$buildings_playe;

      var _Object$entries2$_i = _slicedToArray(_Object$entries2[_i2], 2),
          _y = _Object$entries2$_i[0],
          info = _Object$entries2$_i[1];

      if (!info) continue; // Get the counts for the given player so we can update them, if no player, increase the neutral counts

      var buildingPId = (_info$buildings_playe = info["buildings_players_id"]) !== null && _info$buildings_playe !== void 0 ? _info$buildings_playe : "";
      var buildingName = info["terrain_name"];
      var counts = countsPerPlayer[buildingPId];

      if (/City/.test(buildingName)) {
        counts.city++;
        totalCounts.city++;
      } else if (/Base/.test(buildingName)) {
        counts.base++;
        totalCounts.base++;
      } else if (/Airport/.test(buildingName)) {
        counts.airport++;
        totalCounts.airport++;
      } else if (/Port/.test(buildingName)) {
        counts.port++;
        totalCounts.port++;
      } else if (/HQ/.test(buildingName)) {
        counts.hq++;
        totalCounts.hq++;
      } else if (/Lab/.test(buildingName)) {
        counts.lab++;
        totalCounts.lab++;
      } else if (/Com Tower/.test(buildingName)) {
        counts.comtower++;
        totalCounts.comtower++;
      }
    }
  } // Update player boxes


  for (var _i3 = 0, _Object$entries3 = Object.entries(countsPerPlayer); _i3 < _Object$entries3.length; _i3++) {
    var _Object$entries3$_i = _slicedToArray(_Object$entries3[_i3], 2),
        playerId = _Object$entries3$_i[0],
        _counts = _Object$entries3$_i[1];

    if (!playerId) continue; // Skip neutral

    for (var _i4 = 0, _Object$entries4 = Object.entries(_counts); _i4 < _Object$entries4.length; _i4++) {
      var _Object$entries4$_i = _slicedToArray(_Object$entries4[_i4], 2),
          _buildingName = _Object$entries4$_i[0],
          currentCount = _Object$entries4$_i[1];

      var totalCount = totalCounts[_buildingName]; // In fog, we don't know the total properties only the ones we've seen before so add a ? to the number since we aren't sure

      if (fogInfo && playerId != getViewerPId()) currentCount += "?";
      updatePlayerRow(playerId, _defineProperty({}, "player-".concat(_buildingName), "".concat(currentCount, "/").concat(totalCount)), false);
    }
  }
} //Update building counts based on buildingsInfo because PHP doesn't fill them out


updateBuildingCounts(); //Stats menu && end Game screen

function areAnimationsOn() {
  var pID = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : null;
  if (pID === null) pID = currentTurn;
  return gameAnims || !gameAnims && pID !== getViewerPId() || replayAnims && freezeGame && !exitingReplay;
}

var countryMenuOptions = document.querySelectorAll(".country-color-menu-option");
var menuEnterTime = Date.now();
var menuLeaveTime = Date.now();
var clickTime = Date.now();
var prevClickTime = Date.now();
var previewDelay = 250; //how long to delay before showing preview on mouse over

var clickDelay = 250; //how long to delay before allowing another click

var previewActive = false; //determine whether the preview was finished before clicking

var boolMobile = false; //determine if user is on mobile or not
//color menu interfaces

var _loop2 = function _loop2(_i5) {
  //mobile touch (update color)
  countryMenuOptions[_i5].ontouchstart = function () {
    boolMobile = true;
    newCountryCode = countryMenuOptions[_i5].id;
    updateCountryColor();
    newCountryCode = "";
  }; //preview colors on mouseover


  countryMenuOptions[_i5].onmouseenter = function () {
    if (boolMobile) {
      return;
    } //do not show preview for mobile


    boolMobile = false;
    newCountryCode = countryMenuOptions[_i5].id;
    menuEnterTime = Date.now();
    previewTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      previewCountryColor(currentClickId, newCountryCode, currentCountryCode);
    }, previewDelay);
  }; //undo preview changes on mouse out


  countryMenuOptions[_i5].onmouseleave = function () {
    //clear preview timer so that only the last selection is previewed when mousing quickly
    menuLeaveTime = Date.now();

    if (menuLeaveTime - menuEnterTime < previewDelay) {
      clearTimeout(previewTimer);
    } //revert changes


    if (origCountryCode !== currentCountryCode) {
      previewCountryColor(currentClickId, origCountryCode, currentCountryCode); //revert back to original selection

      newCountryCode = "";
      previewActive = false;
    }
  }; //save changes permanently on click


  countryMenuOptions[_i5].onclick = function () {
    if (boolMobile) {
      return;
    } //do not show preview for mobile


    boolMobile = false;

    if (origCountryCode !== currentCountryCode) {
      clickTime = Date.now();

      if (clickTime - prevClickTime > clickDelay) {
        updateCountryColor();
      }

      prevClickTime = clickTime;
    }
  }; // //try to simulate mobile using click instead
  // countryMenuOptions[i].onclick = function() {
  //   boolMobile = true;
  //   newCountryCode = countryMenuOptions[i].id;
  //   updateCountryColor();
  //   newCountryCode = "";
  // }

};

for (var _i5 = 0; _i5 < countryMenuOptions.length; _i5++) {
  _loop2(_i5);
} //close menu

function previewCountryColor(colorpId, newCode, currCode) {
  //all units owned by selected player
  var unitsToChange = document.querySelectorAll("span[data-unit-id]");
  Object.keys(unitsToChange).forEach(function (unitIdx) {
    tempUnit = unitsToChange[unitIdx];
    tempUId = tempUnit.attributes["data-unit-id"].nodeValue; //unit id

    if (unitsInfo[tempUId].units_players_id == colorpId) {
      //owned by player
      var unitImg = tempUnit.children[0];
      var _tempSrc = unitImg.src; //handle units with active movement animation sprites

      if (unitImg.src.indexOf("movement") > 0) {
        tDir = "terrain/aw2/";
        currAnimDir = "movement/" + currCode + "/";
        newAnimDir = "movement/" + newCode + "/";
      } else {
        currAnimDir = "";
        newAnimDir = "";
        tDir = TP;
      }

      if (_tempSrc.indexOf("gs_") > 0) {
        gs = "gs_";
      } else {
        gs = "";
      }

      var strFind = tDir + currAnimDir + gs + currCode; //current image

      var strRepl = tDir + newAnimDir + gs + newCode; //new image

      unitImg.src = unitImg.src.replace(strFind, strRepl); //replace img src

      ensureSpriteVersion(unitImg);
    }
  });
  currentCountryCode = newCode; //all buildings owned by selected player

  var bldgsToChange = document.querySelectorAll("span[data-building-id]");
  Object.keys(bldgsToChange).forEach(function (bldgIdx) {
    tempBldg = bldgsToChange[bldgIdx];
    tempBId = tempBldg.attributes["data-building-id"].nodeValue; //bldg id

    currCName = countryNames[currCode].replace(" ", "").toLowerCase();
    newCName = countryNames[newCode].replace(" ", "").toLowerCase();
    var weather = {
      C: "",
      S: "_snow",
      R: "_rain"
    };
    var weatherName = weather[gameWeather.code];
    var bldgImg = tempBldg.children[0];
    var tempBInfo = {};
    tempBInfo = findBuildingPId(tempBId);
    tempBPId = tempBInfo.pId;

    if (tempBPId == colorpId) {
      //owned by player (or opponent's HQ in fog)
      tempBName = getBuildingType(tempBInfo.bName).toLowerCase().replace(" ", "");
      tempSrc = TP + newCName + tempBName + weatherName + ".gif";
      bldgImg.src = tempSrc;
      ensureSpriteVersion(bldgImg);
    }
  });
  previewActive = true;
} //actually update country colors


function updateCountryColor() {
  if (!previewActive) {
    previewCountryColor(currentClickId, newCountryCode, currentCountryCode);
  } //update player info box


  countryLight = countriesColors[currentCountryCode].light;
  countryDark = countriesColors[currentCountryCode].dark;
  countryTransp = countriesColors[currentCountryCode].transp;
  strCSS = "linear-gradient(to right, " + countryLight + ", " + countryDark + ")";
  applyCSS(currentClickLogo.parentElement, {
    background: strCSS
  });
  currentClickLogo.children[0].src = currentClickLogo.children[0].src.replace(origCountryCode + "logo.gif", currentCountryCode + "logo.gif"); //logo

  ensureSpriteVersion(currentClickLogo.children[0]);
  var playerInfoUnitCnt = document.querySelector("#player-overview-unit-count-" + currentClickId).children[0];
  playerInfoUnitCnt.src = TP + currentCountryCode + "infantry.gif"; //unit count

  ensureSpriteVersion(playerInfoUnitCnt);
  var playerInfoUnitValue = document.querySelector("#unit-value-icon-" + currentClickId).children[0];
  playerInfoUnitValue.src = TP + currentCountryCode + "infantry.gif"; //unit value

  ensureSpriteVersion(playerInfoUnitValue);
  var playerOverviewInfo = document.querySelector("#player" + currentClickId + " .player-overview-info"); //overview box

  applyCSS(playerOverviewInfo.children[0], {
    borderColor: countryDark
  }); //update player stats menu header

  var displayStatsOverview = document.querySelector(".game-stats");
  applyCSS(displayStatsOverview, {
    borderColor: countryLight
  });
  var displayStatsBorder = document.querySelector(".game-stats-select-" + currentClickId);
  applyCSS(displayStatsBorder, {
    background: countryTransp,
    borderBottom: "solid 2px " + countryDark
  });
  var displayStatsLogo = document.querySelector(".game-stats-select-" + currentClickId + " img");
  displayStatsLogo.src = TP + currentCountryCode + "logo.gif";
  ensureSpriteVersion(displayStatsLogo); //select next unit display

  var nextUnitImg = document.querySelectorAll("#select-next-unit img");
  var nextSprite = nextUnitImg[0];

  if (nextSprite && currentClickId == getViewerPId()) {
    if (nextSprite.src.indexOf(countryNames[origCountryCode].toLowerCase().replace(" ", "")) > 0) {
      //building
      nextSprite.src = nextSprite.src.replace(countryNames[origCountryCode].toLowerCase().replace(" ", ""), countryNames[currentCountryCode].toLowerCase().replace(" ", ""));
    } else {
      //unit
      nextSprite.src = nextSprite.src.replace("/" + origCountryCode, "/" + newCountryCode);
    }

    ensureSpriteVersion(nextSprite);
  } //update viewer colors array


  viewerColors[currentClickId] = currentCountryCode; //update playersInfo (countries_code && countries_name)

  playersInfo[currentClickId].countries_code = currentCountryCode;
  playersInfo[currentClickId].countries_name = countryNames[currentCountryCode]; //update unit count display

  displayUnitCount(currentClickId, playersUnitCount[currentClickId].count); //update terrain name in buildingsInfo

  origCName = countryNames[origCountryCode];
  currCName = countryNames[currentCountryCode];
  Object.keys(buildingsInfo).forEach(function (bldgX) {
    Object.keys(buildingsInfo[bldgX]).forEach(function (bldgY) {
      thisBldg = buildingsInfo[bldgX][bldgY];

      if (thisBldg.buildings_players_id == currentClickId) {
        bName = getBuildingType(thisBldg.terrain_name);
        buildingsInfo[bldgX][bldgY].terrain_name = currCName + " " + bName;
      }
    });
  }); //update selection permanently

  origCountryCode = currentCountryCode;
  previewActive = false; //send query to DB to update player preferences for this game

  if (loggedIn) {
    axios.post("api/game/validate_change_view_color.php", {
      playersId: currentClickId,
      countryCode: currentCountryCode
    }).then(function (res) {})["catch"](catchError);
  } //hide color menu (non-mobile only)


  if (!boolMobile) {
    showCountryColorMenu("close");
  }

  replayControlsVue.refreshCountries();
} //find building player ID if given a building ID


function findBuildingPId(buildingId) {
  var thisPId = 0;
  Object.keys(buildingsInfo).forEach(function (bldgX) {
    Object.keys(buildingsInfo[bldgX]).forEach(function (bldgY) {
      thisBldg = buildingsInfo[bldgX][bldgY];

      if (thisBldg.buildings_id == buildingId) {
        thisPId = thisBldg.buildings_players_id;
        thisBName = thisBldg.terrain_name;
      }
    });
  });
  return {
    pId: thisPId,
    bName: thisBName
  };
}

function getBuildingType(bName) {
  if (bName.indexOf("City") > 0) {
    return "City";
  }

  if (bName.indexOf("Tower") > 0) {
    return "Com Tower";
  }

  if (bName.indexOf("HQ") > 0) {
    return "HQ";
  }

  if (bName.indexOf("Base") > 0) {
    return "Base";
  }

  if (bName.indexOf("Lab") > 0) {
    return "Lab";
  }

  if (bName.indexOf("Airport") > 0) {
    return "Airport";
  }

  if (bName.indexOf("Port") > 0) {
    return "Port";
  }
}

function showCountryColorMenu() {
  var strInput = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : "";

  if (strInput !== "close") {
    newClickId = newClickLogo.children[0].id; //player id of clicked button

    newClickImg = newClickLogo.children[1]; //current caret image (up/down)
  } //adjust caret direction


  if (newClickId == currentClickId || strInput == "close") {
    newClickImg.src = "terrain/down_caret_lite.gif";
  } else {
    newClickImg.src = "terrain/up_caret_lite.gif";

    if (currentClickLogo) {
      currentClickLogo.children[1].src = "terrain/down_caret_lite.gif";
      ensureSpriteVersion(currentClickLogo);
    }
  }

  ensureSpriteVersion(newClickImg); //hide menu

  if (newClickId == currentClickId || strInput == "close") {
    applyCSS(countryColorMenu, {
      display: "none"
    });
    currentClickId = 0;
    newClickLogo = "";
    newClickId = 0;
    origCountryCode = "";
    currentCountryCode = "";
  } //re-position and show menu
  else {
    origCountryCode = playersInfo[newClickId].countries_code; //previous country code (store for reverting)

    currentCountryCode = origCountryCode;
    applyCSS(countryColorMenu, {
      display: "flex"
    }); //adjust position of menu

    var btnPos = newClickLogo.getBoundingClientRect();
    var gamemapDims = gamemapContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
    var menuX = btnPos.left - gamemapDims.left - countryColorMenu.getBoundingClientRect().width / 2;
    var menuY = btnPos.top - gamemapDims.top + 16; //adjust menu position & display

    applyCSS(countryColorMenu, {
      left: menuX + "px",
      top: menuY + "px"
    });
  }
} //Event screen elements (powers, elimination, win, etc)

var ongoingTimer;
var currentTimerEl = document.querySelector("#player" + currentTurn + " .player-timer"); // cache difference between client and server time in a Promise

var getServerTimeOffset = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
  var req = new XMLHttpRequest(); // use xhr because it's more precise than axios

  var clientSendTime, clientReceiveTime;

  req.onload = function () {
    clientReceiveTime = Date.now();

    if (req.status === 200) {
      var res = JSON.parse(req.response);
      var serverReceiveTime = Math.round(res.receive * 1000);
      var serverSendTime = Math.round(res.send * 1000);
      var clientToServerDiff = serverReceiveTime - clientSendTime;
      var serverToClientDiff = serverSendTime - clientReceiveTime;
      var offset = (clientToServerDiff + serverToClientDiff) / 2;
      resolve(offset);

      if (window.location.search.indexOf("debug") >= 0) {
        var rr = "client -> server ".concat(clientToServerDiff, "\nserver -> client ").concat(serverToClientDiff, "\nclient send:    ").concat(clientSendTime, "\nserver receive: ").concat(serverReceiveTime, "\nserver send:    ").concat(serverSendTime, "\nclient receive: ").concat(clientReceiveTime, "\nreal:           ").concat(Math.round(clientReceiveTime + offset), "\noffset: ").concat(offset);
        console.log(rr);
      }
    } else {
      err("".concat(req.status, " ").concat(req.statusText));
    }
  };

  function err(e) {
    resolve(0);
    catchError("Failed to sync timer: ".concat(e));
  }

  req.onerror = err;
  req.open("POST", "api/game/get_server_time.php");
  clientSendTime = Date.now();
  req.send();
}); //Tick down timer for current player

if (!gameEndDate) {
  startPlayerTimer(currentTurn);

function toggleConfMenu(menu) {
  var display = menu.style.display;
  menu.style.display = display === "none" ? "block" : "none";
}

var actionHandlers = {
  JoinRoom: joinRoom,
  LeaveRoom: joinRoom,
  //Same event as JoinRoom with different input
  Fire: resolveAttack,
  AttackSeam: attackSeamHandler,
  Move: moveUnit,
  Capt: captureHandler,

  Resign: resignHandler,
  Follow: followHandler,
  Pause: pauseHandler,
  BootAET: bootAETHandler,
  GameOver: gameOverHandler,
  SwapVision: swapActiveVision,
  Notification: showNotifications,
  ActivityUpdate: updatePlayersActivity,
  Sync: function Sync() {}
};
var actionQueue = [];
var ongoingAction = false;
var wsTimerId = 0;
var dateTimerId = 0;
var notifsTimerId = 0;
var webSocket = connectClient();

function connectClient() {
  var socket = new WebSocket("".concat(wsUrl, "/").concat(wsServerBranch, "/game/").concat(gameId));
  addSocketListeners(socket);
  return socket;
} //Listener for Socket responses. Initialize response handler after succesful connection


function addSocketListeners(socket) {
  socket.onopen = function () {
    connectionMsg.style.display = "none";
    connectionError.style.display = "none";
    keepWsAlive();

    if (allViewerPId.length > 1 && allViewerPId.includes(currentTurn)) {
      swapActiveVision(currentTurn);
    } //Stop actions from playing while fetching new ones that could've been missed while connecting


    ongoingAction = true;
    fetchActions(gameId, gameDay, clientLastUpdated).then(function (res) {
      var newActions = res.data;

      if (newActions.err) {
        ongoingAction = false;
        return handleError(newActions);
      }

      actionQueue = newActions.concat(actionQueue) || [];
      handleNextResponse();
    })["catch"](catchError); //Hide the game's page elements and show a loading icon until the socket is connected

    socket.onmessage = function (jsonData) {
      var responseData = JSON.parse(jsonData.data);
      console.log(responseData);

      if (responseData.err) {
        return handleError(responseData);
      }

      var responseActions = Object.keys(responseData);
      responseActions.forEach(function (action) {
        actionQueue.push(responseData[action]);
      }); //Action already playing or game frozen by replay mode

      if (ongoingAction || freezeGame) return;
      handleNextResponse();
    };
  };

  socket.onclose = function (jsonData) {
    console.log(jsonData); //Error display

    connectionMsg.style.display = "block";
    connectionError.style.display = "block";
    var closeData;

    if (!jsonData.reason) {
      closeData = {
        reconnect: true
      };
    } else {
      closeData = JSON.parse(jsonData.reason);
    }

    var closeMsg = closeData.msg;

    if (closeMsg) {
      connectionError.textContent = closeMsg;
    } else {
      connectionError.textContent = "The connection was interrupted";
    }

    var loadDisplay = closeData.reconnect ? "block" : "none";
    connectionLoad.style.display = loadDisplay;
    if (!closeData.reconnect) return; //Try to reconnect every 10 seconds

    setTimeout(function () {
      webSocket = connectClient();
    }, 10000);
  };
}

function fetchActions(gameId, gameDay, stateTime) {
  //Get every action of the given player Id after the last update date or stored stateTime in db
  var data = {
    gameId: gameId,
    stateTime: stateTime
  };
  return postData("api/game/fetch_actions.php", data);
} //Socket Timeout is 60 seconds: Send an empty string every 45 seconds to keep it alive


function keepWsAlive() {
  var pingInterval = 45000;

  if (webSocket.readyState === 1) {
    webSocket.send("");
  }

  cancelKeepWsAlive();
  wsTimerId = setTimeout(keepWsAlive, pingInterval);
}

function cancelKeepWsAlive() {
  if (wsTimerId) {
    clearTimeout(wsTimerId);
  }
}

function showNotifications(notifications) {
  //New messages from press
  if (notifications.newMessage) {
    animWarning(msgWarning, true);
  } //# of your turn games (not implemented)


  var gameCount = notifications.yourTurn;

  if (gameCount) {
    for (var _i7 = 0; _i7 < yourTurnAlert.length; _i7++) {
      yourTurnAlert[_i7].textContent = gameCount;

      if (gameCount > 0) {
        yourTurnAlert[_i7].style.display = "flex";
      }
    }
  }
} //turn is according to replay, only updated upon end turn events


function updateUserState(gameId, gameTurn) {
  var data = {
    date: new Date(),
    gameId: gameId,
    gameTurn: gameTurn
  };
  postData("api/game/update_user_state.php", data);
} //Takes the proper action handler after receiving a response from the server


function handleResponse(responseData, actionQueue) {
  var playNext = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : true;
  ongoingAction = true;
  var action = responseData.action;
  var actionHandler = actionHandlers[action]; //Delay needed only for move action

  var moveDelay = 0;
  var loadFlag;

  if (action === "Move") {
    var path = responseData.path; //always show enemy units moving when animations are turned off

    moveDelay = path.length * movementSpeed; //The next action in the queue is a Load, mark as true

    loadFlag = actionQueue[0] && actionQueue[0].action === "Load";
  } //ping actions are simply to keep clientLastUpdated accurate - no actual action played


  if (action !== "Ping") {
    actionHandler(responseData, loadFlag);
  }

  if (playNext) {
    setTimeout(handleNextResponse, moveDelay);
  }
} //Takes the first action in queue and executes it


function handleNextResponse() {
  ongoingAction = false;

  if (actionQueue.length !== 0) {
    var nextResponse = actionQueue.shift();
    handleResponse(nextResponse, actionQueue);
  }
} //Displays error message


function handleError(err) {
  console.log(err);
  clearTimeout(errorTimeout);
  errorMessage.textContent = err.message;
  errorDisplay.style.display = "block";
  setTimeout(function () {
    errorDisplay.style.opacity = 1; //don't remove the error

    if (err.persist) return;
    errorTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
      errorDisplay.style.opacity = 0;
    }, 5000);
  }, 25);
} //Same as "handleError" but box does not disappear until clicked


function handleClientError(err) {
  errorMessage.innerHTML = err.message;
  errorDisplay.style.display = "block";
  setTimeout(function () {
    errorDisplay.style.opacity = 1;
  }, 25);
} //Error from catch block after async request


function catchError(errMsg) {
  var error = {
    err: true,
    message: errMsg
  };
  handleError(error);
}

window.onbeforeunload = function () {
  if (webSocket.readyState !== 1) return;
  var leaveRoomData = {
    action: "LeaveRoom"
  };
  emitData(webSocket, leaveRoomData);
};
/* const mobileTest = document.querySelector(".mobiletest"); */


var touchTimeout;
gamemap.addEventListener("touchstart", mapTouchStart);
gamemap.addEventListener("touchmove", mapTouchMove);
gamemap.addEventListener("touchend", mapTouchEnd);

function mapTouchStart(e) {
  var touchPoints = e.touches.length;

  if (touchPoints === 1) {
    touchTimeout = setTimeout(function () {
      touchTimeout = clearTimeout(touchTimeout);
    }, 500);
  }
}

function mapTouchMove(e) {
  var touchPoints = e.touches.length;

  if (touchPoints > 1) {
    return;
  }

  if (touchPoints === 1) {
    //only disallow screen panning when a unit has been selected to move
    if (moving) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }

    updateCoords(e);
  }
} // global flag: If the user creates tiles (movement, range, vision) from a touch event,
// this flag insures they are cleaned up the next time the player touches the screen.


var should_reset_created_tiles_on_touch = false;

function mapTouchEnd(e) {
  if (!touchTimeout || e.touches.length > 1) return;
  /* applyCSS(gamemapContainer, {touchAction: "auto"}); */

  e.preventDefault();
  updateCoords(e);
  var endTouchX = e.changedTouches[0].pageX;
  var endTouchY = e.changedTouches[0].pageY;
  var touchEndEl = document.elementFromPoint(endTouchX, endTouchY);

  if (should_reset_created_tiles_on_touch) {
    resetCreatedTiles(".movement-tile, .range-square, .vision-square");
    should_reset_created_tiles_on_touch = false;
  }

  mapClick(e, touchEndEl);
} //Handle user's click on the game map based on element
//allow click for replay mode even when the game is over


function mapClick(e, el) {
  if (calculator.selectorPosition || gameEndDate && !freezeGame) return false;
  var target = el || e.target;
  var targetParent = target.closest("span") ? target.closest("span") : target;

  var type = function () {
    var item = targetParent.classList.item(0);

    if (item === "game-unit") {
      return "unit";
    } else if (item === "game-building") {
      return "building";
    } else if (item === "movement-tile" || item === "path-tile") {
      return "movement";
    } else if (item === "silo-square") {
      return "silo";
    } else if (item === "bomb-square") {
      return "bomb";
    }
  }();

  var isAction = targetParent.classList.contains("action-square"); //Info about the clicked element

  var clicked = {
    el: targetParent,
    id: type === "unit" || type === "building" ? targetParent.getAttribute("data-" + type + "-id") : 0,
    type: type
  };
  var resetType = /movement|silo|bomb/;
  var unit_under_mvmt_tile = getGameUnitFromEvent(e); // If not moving, and there's a unit under the selected move tile, process the unit instead.

  if (!moving && unit_under_mvmt_tile && clicked.type === "movement") {
    clicked.type = "unit";
    clicked.id = unit_under_mvmt_tile.getAttribute("data-unit-id");
    clicked.e1 = unit_under_mvmt_tile;
  } //Reset the last click's events


  if (!resetType.test(clicked.type) && !isAction) {
    closeMenu();
    resetAttack();
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square'], .action-square, .check-range-square");
    currentClick = null;
    moving = false;
  }

  if (clicked.type === "unit") {
    unitClickHandler(clicked);
  } else if (clicked.type === "movement" && moving) {
    movementClickHandler(currentClick);
  } else if (clicked.type === "building") {
    if (ghostUnits && ghostUnits[coordX] && ghostUnits[coordX][coordY]) return;
    var buildingPId = buildingsInfo[coordX] && buildingsInfo[coordX][coordY] ? buildingsInfo[coordX][coordY].buildings_players_id : null;

    if (buildingPId !== getViewerPId() || currentTurn !== getViewerPId() || unitMap[coordX] && unitMap[coordX][coordY]) {
      return;
    }

    showBuildOptions(coordX, coordY);
    clicked.info = buildingsInfo[coordX][coordY];
    currentClick = clicked;
  }
} // Given an event (touchend, click) attempts to return a game unit (by class "game-unit") based on that event's x/y coordinates.


function getGameUnitFromEvent(e) {
  var x,
      y = 0;

  if (e.type === "touchend") {
    x = e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
    y = e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
  } else {
    // triggered from click event
    x = e.clientX;
    y = e.clientY;
  }

  var unit = document.elementsFromPoint(x, y).filter(function (x) {
    return x.className.includes("game-unit");
  })[0];
  return unit;
}

function createAttackRangeTilesForUnit(unit, startTile) {
  var type = "range";
  var minRange = unit.units_short_range;
  var maxRange = unit.units_long_range;

  if (minRange <= 0 || maxRange <= 0) {
    minRange = 1;
    maxRange = 1;
  } // Show explosion radius for black bombs


  if (unit.units_name == "Black Bomb") {
    maxRange = 3;
  }

  var rangeTiles = createSquareInRangeOf(maxRange, minRange, type, startTile.x, startTile.y);
  return rangeTiles;
}

function unitClickHandler(clicked) {
  var unit = unitsInfo[clicked.id];
  var unitName = unit.units_name;
  var unitId = unit.units_id;
  var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
  var unitFuel = unit.units_fuel;
  var mType = unit.units_movement_type;
  var startTile = {
    x: unit.units_x,
    y: unit.units_y
  };
  var mp = unit.units_movement_points; //Use remaining fuel as mp

  if (unitFuel < mp) mp = unitFuel;
  var unitTeam = playersInfo[unit.units_players_id].players_team;
  var unitMoved = unit.units_moved === 1;
  var transportUnits = /T-Copter|APC|Lander|Black Boat|Cruiser|Carrier/;
  var unitCargo = unit.units_cargo1_units_id || unit.units_cargo2_units_id; //Allow click on Transport units that already moved to open menu with unload option

  if (unitPId === getViewerPId() && currentTurn === getViewerPId() && transportUnits.test(unitName) && unitMoved && unitCargo) {
    var isLandingTile = checkLanding(unitCargo, unit, startTile.x, startTile.y);

    if (isLandingTile) {
      showUnitOptions([{
        option: "Unload",
        clickable: true
      }], coordX, coordY);
    }

    clicked.info = unitsInfo[clicked.id];
    clicked.path = [startTile.x + maxX * startTile.y];
    currentClick = clicked;
    return;
  } //Show movement range only and exit
  //don't allow movement in replay mode (freezeGame in gameReplay.js)


  if (unitPId !== getViewerPId() || currentTurn !== getViewerPId() || unitMoved || freezeGame) {
    //Not the same unit as last click, reset to movement
    if (checkRange.unitId !== unitId) {
      checkRange.state = 0;
    } //Skip attack range for units that can't attack


    if (unitName === "APC" || unitName === "T-Copter" || unitName === "Lander" || unitName === "Black Boat") {
      if (checkRange.state === 1 && gameFog === "Y") {
        checkRange.state = 2;
      } else {
        checkRange.state = 0;
      }
    }

    if (checkRange.state === 0) {
      getMovementTiles(maxX, maxY, mType, mp, startTile, unitTeam, playersInfo[unitPId]);
    } else if (checkRange.state === 1) {
      //Attack Range
      createAttackRangeTilesForUnit(unit, startTile);
    } else if (checkRange.state === 2) {
      //Vision
      var unitVision = unit.units_vision;
      unitVision = checkMountain(unitId, unitVision, startTile.x, startTile.y);
      createSquareInRangeOf(unitVision, 1, "vision", startTile.x, startTile.y);
    }

    checkRange.state++;

    if (checkRange.state > 2 && gameFog === "Y" || checkRange.state > 1 && gameFog === "N") {
      checkRange.state = 0;
    }

    checkRange.unitId = unitId;

    gamemap.onmouseup = function () {
      resetCreatedTiles(".movement-tile, .range-square, .vision-square");
      gamemap.onmouseup = null;
    }; // When the player touches the map again, clear the tiles.


    should_reset_created_tiles_on_touch = true;
    return;
  } //Show movement and change move status


  moving = true;
  clicked.info = unitsInfo[clicked.id]; //Initiate path with starting position

  var startNode = startTile.y * maxX + startTile.x;
  clicked.path = [startNode];
  currentClick = clicked;
  movementInfo = getMovementTiles(maxX, maxY, mType, mp, startTile, unitTeam, playersInfo[unitPId]);
} //Click handler when a movement tile is clicked after a unit is selected


function movementClickHandler(clicked) {
  //check the target tile from the end of the path, not where the user clicked
  var path = clicked.path;
  var coords = coordsFromNode(path[path.length - 1]);
  var endX = coords.x;
  var endY = coords.y;
  var isTeleportTile = terrainInfo[endX] && terrainInfo[endX][endY] && terrainInfo[endX][endY].terrain_id === 195;

  if (isTeleportTile) {
    console.log("Landed on black tile!");
    return;
  } //Get options to display in the menu


  var optionsDisplay = checkTargetTile(endX, endY);

  if (optionsDisplay !== undefined) {
    //Open menu with available options
    moving = false;
    resetCreatedTiles(".movement-tile, .action-square"); //Show vision of unit on last tile of path, if there's no unit on that tile
    //In case of available options like Load, Join, etc

    if (gameFog === "Y" && !(unitMap[endX] && unitMap[endX][endY])) {
      var unit = clicked.info;
      var unitVision = checkMountain(unit.units_id, unit.units_vision, endX, endY);
      createSquareInRangeOf(unitVision, 1, "vision", endX, endY);
    }

    showUnitOptions(optionsDisplay, coordX, coordY);
  }
}

function menuClick(e) {
  var option = e.target.closest("li");
  if (!option) return; //Skip if clicked option is striked

  if (option.classList.contains("forbidden")) return;
  option = option.textContent;
  var path = currentClick.path;
  var endPathCoords = coordsFromNode(path[path.length - 1]);
  var unitId = currentClick.info.units_id;
  var unitPId = currentClick.info.units_players_id; //x & y is end of path if defined or original position

  var unitX = typeof endPathCoords.x === "number" ? endPathCoords.x : currentClick.info.units_x;
  var unitY = typeof endPathCoords.y === "number" ? endPathCoords.y : currentClick.info.units_y;
  var actionData = {
    playerID: unitPId,
    unitID: unitId,
    path: path
  };

  if (option === "Fire") {
    //Wipe damage squares from the movement and recreate adjacent ones only
    //emitData in clickable square's click handler
    createDamageSquares(currentClick.info, currentClick.unitsInRange, movementInfo, false);
  } else if (option === "Capt") {
    actionData.action = "Capt";
    emitData(webSocket, actionData);
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square']");
    resetUnit();
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Load") {
    var transportId = unitMap[unitX][unitY].units_id;
    var loadData = {
      action: "Load",
      playerID: unitPId,
      loadID: unitId,
      transportID: transportId,
      path: path
    };
    emitData(webSocket, loadData);
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square']");
    resetUnit();
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Unload") {
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='square']");
    var firstCargo = currentClick.info.units_cargo1_units_id;
    var secondCargo = currentClick.info.units_cargo2_units_id;
    var unloadOptions = [unitsInfo[firstCargo], unitsInfo[secondCargo]];
    showUnloadOptions(unloadOptions, unitsInfo[unitId]);
  } else if (option === "Repair") {
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='square']");
    closeMenu();
    var alliedNeighbours = loopNeighbours(unitX, unitY, unitsInfo[unitId]).allied;
    var repairableUnits = checkIfCanRepair(alliedNeighbours);
    createActionSquares(repairableUnits, "repair", repairClickHandler);
  } else if (option === "Hide") {
    var hideData = {
      action: "Hide",
      path: path,
      playerID: unitPId,
      unitID: unitId
    };
    emitData(webSocket, hideData);
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square']");
    resetUnit();
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Unhide") {
    var unhideData = {
      action: "Unhide",
      path: path,
      playerID: unitPId,
      unitID: unitId
    };
    emitData(webSocket, unhideData);
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square']");
    resetUnit();
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Supply") {
    var supplyData = {
      action: "Supply",
      path: path,
      playerID: unitPId,
      unitID: unitId
    };
    emitData(webSocket, supplyData);
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square']");
    resetUnit();
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Join") {
    var joinData = {
      action: "Join",
      joinID: unitId,
      path: path,
      playerID: unitPId
    };
    emitData(webSocket, joinData);
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square']");
    resetUnit();
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Launch") {
    //When true, the cursor updates to show the missile range (updateCoords fn)
    showSiloRange = true;
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Fire Silo") {
    //Run the onclick function of the silo square that was created
    var siloSquare = document.querySelector(".silo-square");
    siloSquare.onclick();
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Explode") {
    resetCreatedTiles(".movement-tile, span[class*='square']");
    createSquareInRangeOf(3, 0, "bomb", unitX, unitY, bombClickHandler);
    closeMenu();
  } else if (option === "Delete") {
    var deleteData = {
      action: "Delete",
      playerID: unitPId,
      unitID: unitId
    };
    deleteConfirmation(deleteData);
  } else if (option === "Wait") {
    var moveData = {
      action: "Move",
      path: path,
      playerID: unitPId,
      unitID: unitId
    };
    emitData(webSocket, moveData);
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square']");
    closeMenu();
  }
}

function updateTileDisplay(x, y) {
  var _terrainInfo$x, _buildingsInfo$x, _unitMap$x, _unitMap$x$y;

  var terrain = ((_terrainInfo$x = terrainInfo[x]) === null || _terrainInfo$x === void 0 ? void 0 : _terrainInfo$x[y]) || ((_buildingsInfo$x = buildingsInfo[x]) === null || _buildingsInfo$x === void 0 ? void 0 : _buildingsInfo$x[y]);
  var unitId = (_unitMap$x = unitMap[x]) === null || _unitMap$x === void 0 ? void 0 : (_unitMap$x$y = _unitMap$x[y]) === null || _unitMap$x$y === void 0 ? void 0 : _unitMap$x$y.units_id;
  tileInfoDisplay.style.display = "flex";
  updateTerrainDisplay(terrain);
  updateUnitDisplay(unitsInfo[unitId]);
  var clientHeight = window.innerHeight;
  var gamemapDims = gamemapContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
  var gamemapBottom = gamemapDims.bottom; //There is space before the map in the game container, change it's location
  //so it doesn't block smaller maps

  var gameContainerDims = gameContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
  var gameContainerLeft = gameContainerDims.left;
  var gamemapLeft = gamemapDims.left;
  var tileInfoWidth = tileInfoDisplay.getBoundingClientRect().width;

  if (gamemapLeft - tileInfoWidth >= gameContainerLeft) {
    tileInfoDisplay.classList.remove("right-side");
    tileInfoDisplay.classList.add("left-side");
    applyCSS(tileInfoDisplay, {
      left: "-57px"
    });

    if (unitsInfo[unitId]) {
      applyCSS(tileInfoDisplay, {
        left: "-106px"
      });
    }
  } else {
    tileInfoDisplay.style.left = "";
  } //Map goes out of viewerport, append tile display at the bottom of the
  //viewer's screen


  if (gamemapBottom > clientHeight) {
    var gamemapTop = gamemapDims.top;
    var gamemapHeight = gamemapDims.height;
    var topOffset = clientHeight - gamemapTop;
    var tileDisplayOffset = gamemapHeight - topOffset;
    tileInfoDisplay.style.bottom = tileDisplayOffset + "px";
  } //Put back the tile display at the bottom of the map
  else {
    tileInfoDisplay.style.bottom = "2px";
  }
}

function updateTerrainDisplay(terrain) {
  //Don't update for black tiles
  if (!terrain) return;
  var terrainName = terrain.terrain_name;

  if (terrain.buildings_players_id) {
    var newCountry = countryNames[viewerColors[terrain.buildings_players_id]]; //update building countries per viewer selections

    Object.keys(countryNames).forEach(function (code) {
      //find current name
      if (terrainName.indexOf(countryNames[code]) >= 0) {
        if (countryNames[code] !== newCountry) {
          terrainName = terrainName.replace(countryNames[code], newCountry);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  var terrainSrc = terrainName.replace(/ /g, "").toLowerCase();
  var terrainDefense = terrain.terrain_defense;
  var buildingHP = terrain.buildings_capture ? terrain.buildings_capture : null;
  var terrainInfoChildren = terrainInfoDisplay.children;
  var terrainSpan = terrainInfoChildren[1];
  var terrainDefenseSpan = terrainInfoChildren[2];
  var terrainHpSpan = terrainInfoChildren[3];
  mapRenderer.drawTileImage(terrainSrc, terrainSpan.children[0]);
  terrainDefenseSpan.children[1].textContent = terrainDefense; //Terrain is not Silo, Regular Pipe or broken Pipeseam

  if (!/Silo|(Pipe)$|(Rubble)$/.test(terrainName) && buildingHP) {
    if (/Seam/.test(terrainName)) {
      //Change to HP icon for Pipeseams
      terrainHpSpan.children[0].src = "terrain/hp.gif";
    } else {
      //Building capture icon for Properties
      terrainHpSpan.children[0].src = "terrain/capt.gif";
    }

    terrainHpSpan.children[1].textContent = buildingHP;
    terrainHpSpan.style.display = "block";
  } else {
    terrainHpSpan.style.display = "none";
  }

  applyCSS(terrainInfoDisplay, {
    display: "flex"
  });
}

function updateUnitDisplay(unit) {
  if (unit) {
    //Units inside transport, show elements
    var unitName = unit.units_name;
    var countryCode = unit.countries_code;

    if (viewerColors) {
      countryCode = viewerColors[unit.units_players_id] || countryCode;
    }

    var unitSrc = TP + countryCode + unitName.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase() + ".gif";
    var unitHp = unit.units_hit_points;
    var unitFuel = unit.units_fuel;
    var unitAmmo = unit.units_ammo;
    var loadedUnitId = unit.units_cargo1_units_id;
    var loadedUnit2Id = unit.units_cargo2_units_id;
    var unitInfoChildren = unitInfoDisplay.children; //Update the corresponding elements in the display

    var unitContainer = unitInfoChildren[1];
    var loadIcon = unitContainer.children[1];
    loadIcon.style.display = "none";
    unitContainer.children[0].src = unitSrc;
    ensureSpriteVersion(unitContainer.children[0]);
    unitInfoChildren[2].children[1].textContent = unitHp;
    unitInfoChildren[3].children[1].textContent = unitFuel;

    if (unitAmmo !== undefined) {
      unitInfoChildren[4].children[1].textContent = unitAmmo;
    } //Check for loaded units


    var loadedUnitName = unitsInfo[loadedUnitId] && loadedUnitId !== "?" ? unitsInfo[loadedUnitId].units_name : null;
    var loadedUnit2Name = unitsInfo[loadedUnit2Id] && loadedUnit2Id !== "?" ? unitsInfo[loadedUnit2Id].units_name : null;
    var loadedUnitSprite = unitInfoChildren[1].children[2].children[0];
    var loadedUnit2Sprite = unitInfoChildren[1].children[2].children[1];
    var multiTransport = /Black Boat|Lander|Cruiser|Carrier/;

    if (loadedUnitName && loadedUnitId !== "?" || loadedUnit2Name && loadedUnit2Id !== "?") {
      loadIcon.src = TP + "load.gif"; //Always only change first unit element for APC & T-Copter

      if (loadedUnitName) {
        loadedUnitSprite.src = TP + countryCode + loadedUnitName.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase() + ".gif";
      } //Transport with capacity of 2


      if (loadedUnit2Name && multiTransport.test(unitName)) {
        loadedUnit2Sprite.src = TP + countryCode + loadedUnit2Name.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase() + ".gif";
      }
    } else if (loadedUnitId === "?") {
      loadIcon.src = TP + "fogload.gif";
    }

    loadIcon.style.display = loadedUnitId ? "block" : "none";
    loadedUnitSprite.style.display = loadedUnitId && loadedUnitId !== "?" ? "block" : "none";
    loadedUnit2Sprite.style.display = loadedUnit2Id && loadedUnit2Id !== "?" ? "block" : "none";
    unitInfoChildren[4].style.display = unitAmmo !== undefined ? "block" : "none";
    applyCSS(unitInfoDisplay, {
      display: "flex"
    });
  } else {
    //No units inside transport, hide elements
    applyCSS(unitInfoDisplay, {
      display: "none"
    });
    applyCSS(tileInfoDisplay, {
      left: "-57px"
    });
  }
}

function switchMenuSide() {
  if (tileInfoDisplay.classList.contains("left-side")) {
    switchClasses("right-side", "left-side");
  } else {
    switchClasses("left-side", "right-side");
  }

  function switchClasses(add, remove) {
    tileInfoDisplay.classList.remove(remove);
    tileInfoDisplay.classList.add(add);
  }
} //Create squares that show the range of multiple events:
//Unit Range, Vision, Silos, Black bombs...


function createSquareInRangeOf(maxRange, minRange, type, x, y, clickHandler) {
  var draw = arguments.length > 6 && arguments[6] !== undefined ? arguments[6] : true;

  function findSquareBorders(i, j) {
    var borderWidth = "";
    borderWidth += j <= 0 ? "1px " : "0 ";
    borderWidth += i >= 0 ? "1px " : "0 ";
    borderWidth += j >= 0 ? "1px " : "0 ";
    borderWidth += i <= 0 ? "1px " : "0 ";
    return borderWidth;
  }

  var tiles = [];

  for (var _i8 = -maxRange; _i8 <= maxRange; _i8++) {
    for (var j = -maxRange; j <= maxRange; j++) {
      var absoluteSum = Math.abs(_i8) + Math.abs(j);

      if (absoluteSum <= maxRange && absoluteSum >= minRange) {
        var ax = x + _i8;
        var ay = y + j;
        if (ax < 0 || ay < 0 || ax >= maxX || ay >= maxY) continue;
        var borderWidth = void 0; //Tile's distance is the same as max range from the given X & Y, find border and apply it to square

        if (absoluteSum === maxRange) {
          borderWidth = findSquareBorders(_i8, j);
        }

        tiles.push({
          x: ax,
          y: ay,
          borderWidth: borderWidth
        });
      }
    }
  }

  if (draw) drawTiles(tiles, type, clickHandler);
  return tiles;
}
/**
 * Draw tiles/squares that show the range of different events like unit movement, attack range, vision, etc.
 * @param {Array} tiles - Array of objects with x, y, and borderWidth properties
 * @param {String} type - Type of tile to draw. Can be "movement", "range", "vision", "silo", "bomb"
 */


function drawTiles(tiles, type) {
  var clickHandler = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : null;
  // Use fragment for better performance
  var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
  tiles.forEach(function (tile) {
    var x = tile.x;
    var y = tile.y;
    var borderWidth = tile.borderWidth;
    var tileSpan = document.createElement("span");
    if (type === "movement") tileSpan.className = "movement-tile";else tileSpan.classList.add(type + "-square", "check-range-square");
    applyCSS(tileSpan, {
      borderStyle: function () {
        if (borderWidth && borderWidth !== "0 0 0 0 ") {
          return "solid";
        }
      }(),
      borderWidth: borderWidth,
      left: x * 16 - 1 + "px",
      top: y * 16 - 1 + "px"
    }); //For silos squares, a callback function is required (siloClickHandler)

    if (clickHandler) {
      var unitPath = currentClick.path;
      var coords = coordsFromNode(unitPath[unitPath.length - 1]);
      clickHandler(tileSpan, {
        x: x,
        y: y
      }, {
        x: coords.x,
        y: coords.y
      });
    }

    fragment.appendChild(tileSpan);
  });
  gamemap.appendChild(fragment);
}

function siloClickHandler(squareSpan, squarePos) {
  //Only add an event to the center square
  if (squarePos.x !== coordX && squarePos.y !== coordY) return;
  var unitId = currentClick.info.units_id;
  var unitPath = currentClick.path;
  var playerId = currentClick.info.units_players_id;
  var siloCoords = coordsFromNode(unitPath[unitPath.length - 1]);

  squareSpan.onclick = function () {
    primeSiloTargetSpaces();
  };

  squareSpan.ontouchend = function () {
    primeSiloTargetSpaces();
  }; //First click event to lock the silo's area of effect


  function primeSiloTargetSpaces() {
    closeMenu();
    squareSpan.onclick = null;
    squareSpan.ontouchend = null;
    showSiloRange = false;
    var siloSquares = document.querySelectorAll(".silo-square");

    var _loop3 = function _loop3(_i9) {
      var siloSquare = siloSquares[_i9];
      siloSquare.classList.add("silo-pulse", "fire-cursor");

      siloSquares[_i9].onclick = function () {
        launchSilo(siloSquare);
      };

      siloSquares[_i9].ontouchend = function () {
        launchSilo(siloSquare);
      };
    };

    for (var _i9 = 0; _i9 < siloSquares.length; _i9++) {
      _loop3(_i9);
    }

    showUnitOptions([{
      option: "Fire Silo",
      clickable: true
    }], squarePos.x, squarePos.y);
  } //Second click event to fire the silo


  function launchSilo(squareSpan) {
    squareSpan.onclick = null;
    squareSpan.ontouchend = null;
    resetCreatedTiles(".silo-square, .path-tile");
    closeMenu(); //Emit data to server

    var siloData = {
      action: "Launch",
      playerID: playerId,
      targetX: squarePos.x,
      targetY: squarePos.y,
      unitId: unitId,
      unitX: siloCoords.x,
      unitY: siloCoords.y,
      path: unitPath
    };
    resetUnit();
    emitData(webSocket, siloData);
  }
}

function onExplosionTileClickHandler() {
  var unitId = currentClick.info.units_id;
  var playerId = currentClick.info.units_players_id;
  this.ontouchend = null;
  this.onclick = null;
  resetCreatedTiles(".bomb-square, span[class$='tile']");
  var explodeData = {
    action: "Explode",
    path: currentClick.path,
    playerID: playerId,
    unitID: unitId
  };
  resetUnit();
  emitData(webSocket, explodeData);
}

function bombClickHandler(squareSpan, squarePos, unitPos) {
  if (squarePos.x !== unitPos.x || squarePos.y !== unitPos.y) return;
  squareSpan.classList.add("bomb-pulse", "action-square", "fire-cursor");
  squareSpan.onclick = onExplosionTileClickHandler;
  squareSpan.ontouchend = onExplosionTileClickHandler;
} //Create clickable squares to attack units


function createDamageSquares(attackerUnit, unitsInRange, movementInfo, movingUnit) {
  var attAmmo = attackerUnit.units_ammo;
  var attSecondWeapon = attackerUnit.units_second_weapon; //No ammo and no secondary weapon, skip entire function

  if (attAmmo === 0 && !attSecondWeapon) return;
  var f = document.createDocumentFragment(); //Create a clickable square to launch an attack for every unit in range of the Attacker

  unitsInRange.forEach(function (defenderUnit) {
    //Skip target if attacker is a piperunner and the defender is a pipe seam when
    //moving the unit, otherwise it can not move on the pipe seam
    var attackerName = attackerUnit.units_name;
    var defenderName = defenderUnit.units_name;
    if (movingUnit && attackerName === "Piperunner" && defenderName === "Pipe Seam") return;
    var attRange = attackerUnit.units_short_range;
    var defId = defenderUnit.units_id;
    var defX = defenderUnit.units_x;
    var defY = defenderUnit.units_y; //Check if there's an empty adjacent square around target unit for direct units
    //4 means every tile around the Defender is occupied

    var occupiedAdjacent = 0;
    var xv = [-1, 1, 0, 0];
    var yv = [0, 0, -1, 1];

    for (var _i10 = 0; _i10 < 4; _i10++) {
      var ax = defX + xv[_i10];
      var ay = defY + yv[_i10];
      var node = ay * maxX + ax; //A unit is on the adjacent square or the tile is unreachable

      if (unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay] || movementInfo && movementInfo.dist[node] === Infinity) {
        var unitId = unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay] && unitMap[ax][ay].units_id;
        var selectedId = currentClick.info.units_id;

        if (selectedId !== unitId) {
          occupiedAdjacent++;
        }
      } //Squares outside of the map count as occupied
      else if (ax < 0 || ay < 0 || ax >= maxX || ay >= maxY) occupiedAdjacent++;
    } //Skip unit if every tile is occupied or unreachable around defender


    if (attRange <= 1 && occupiedAdjacent === 4) {
      return;
    } //Create square and position it above the defender


    var dmgSquare = document.createElement("span");
    dmgSquare.classList.add("dmg-square", "action-square", "hover-lower-bright");
    dmgSquare.setAttribute("data-attack-uid", defId);
    applyCSS(dmgSquare, {
      left: defX * 16 - 1 + "px",
      top: defY * 16 - 1 + "px"
    }); //Mouse enter listener to update the Damage display for corresponding unit

    dmgSquare.onmouseenter = function () {
      populateDamageDisplay(attackerUnit, defenderUnit);
    };

    dmgSquare.onmouseleave = resetAttack;

    dmgSquare.ontouchstart = function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      populateDamageDisplay(attackerUnit, defenderUnit);
      lockAttack(attackerUnit, defenderUnit, dmgSquare, "ontouchstart");
    };

    dmgSquare.onclick = function () {
      lockAttack(attackerUnit, defenderUnit, dmgSquare, "onclick");
    };

    f.appendChild(dmgSquare);
  });
  resetCreatedTiles("span[class*='square']");
  closeMenu();
  gamemap.appendChild(f);
}

function populateDamageDisplay(attackerUnit, defenderUnit) {
  var attRange = attackerUnit.units_short_range;
  var defX = defenderUnit.units_x;
  var defY = defenderUnit.units_y; // The damage displat needs to be visible first to calculate the x offset

  applyCSS(damageDisplay, {
    display: "block"
  }); //To center the display horizontally:
  //Defender's position - (Damage display's width in px/(scale level) - 16) / 2 - 16px is 1 tile in 1.0x scale
  //Vertical adjustment:
  //2 tiles above Defender - arbitrary amount of px

  var xOffset = (damageDisplay.getBoundingClientRect().width / scale - 16) / 2;
  applyCSS(damageDisplay, {
    left: defX * 16 - xOffset + "px",
    top: (defY - 2) * 16 - 7 + "px"
  }); //Make sure the path to the defender is drawn for direct units

  if ((!currentClick.path || currentClick.path.length === 0) && attRange <= 1) {
    currentClick.path = drawPathTiles(movementInfo, defX, defY, currentClick.path);
  } //Clear unit's path for indirects since they do not move
  else if (currentClick.path && attRange >= 1) {
    currentClick.path = [];
    resetCreatedTiles(".path-tile");
  }

  var endPath = currentClick.path.length - 1;
  var endTile = currentClick.path[endPath];
  calculateDamage(attackerUnit, defenderUnit, endTile).then(function (res) {
    var damageValues = {
      max: res.data.maxInfo,
      min: res.data.minInfo,
      maxCounter: res.data.maxCounterInfo,
      minCounter: res.data.minCounterInfo
    };
    updateDamageDisplay(damageValues, attackerUnit, defenderUnit, endTile); // Readjust the damage display so it's centered if the damage values are bigger than normal
    // the x offset is different here

    applyCSS(damageDisplay, {
      left: defX * 16 - (damageDisplay.getBoundingClientRect().width / scale - 16) / 2 + "px"
    });
  })["catch"](catchError);
} //Prepare data for attack when clicking on attack square once


function lockAttack(attackerUnit, defenderUnit, dmgSquare, event) {
  var attId = attackerUnit.units_id;
  var attackData = {
    action: "Fire",
    attacker: {
      playerID: attackerUnit.units_players_id,
      unitID: attId,
      path: currentClick.path
    }
  };

  if (defenderUnit.units_name !== "Pipe Seam") {
    attackData.defender = {
      playerID: defenderUnit.units_players_id,
      unitID: defenderUnit.units_id
    };
  } else {
    var defX = defenderUnit.units_x;
    var defY = defenderUnit.units_y;
    attackData.seamID = buildingsInfo[defX][defY].buildings_id;
    attackData.action = "AttackSeam";
  } //Show menu or lock damage display if unit is in move state


  if (moving) {
    var endPath = currentClick.path.length - 1;
    var endTile = currentClick.path[endPath];
    var endX = endTile % maxX;
    var endY = (endTile - endX) / maxX;
    var endPathUnit = unitMap[endX] && unitMap[endX][endY] ? unitMap[endX][endY] : null; //Unit on the tile at the end of the path and that unit is not the Attacker

    if (endPathUnit && endPathUnit.units_id !== attId) return;
    moving = false;
    dmgSquare[event] = null;
    dmgSquare.onmouseleave = null;
    dmgSquare.onmouseenter = null; //Clear every tiles and reappend clicked one

    resetCreatedTiles(".movement-tile, .action-square");
    dmgSquare.classList.add("fire-cursor");
    gamemap.appendChild(dmgSquare); //Listener to emit the attack data on a second click

    dmgSquare.onclick = function (e) {
      confirmAttack();
    };

    dmgSquare.ontouchstart = function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      confirmAttack();
    };
  } else {
    //Player has clicked the Fire option in the menu and not the attack square
    confirmAttack();
  }

  function confirmAttack() {
    dmgSquare.parentElement.removeChild(dmgSquare);
    resetAttack();
    resetUnit();
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class*='tile'], span[class*='square']");
    emitData(webSocket, attackData);
  }
}

function updateDamageDisplay(damageValues, attacker, defender, endTile) {
  var attackerValues = {
    min: damageValues.min.percent,
    max: damageValues.max.percent
  };
  var defenderValues = {
    min: damageValues.minCounter ? damageValues.minCounter.minLuck.counterPercent : 0,
    max: damageValues.maxCounter ? damageValues.maxCounter.maxLuck.counterPercent : 0
  };
  updateDamageDisplayUnit(attackerValues, attackerDisplay, attDamageContainer, attacker, endTile, "A");
  updateDamageDisplayUnit(defenderValues, defenderDisplay, defDamageContainer, defender, null, "D");

  function updateDamageDisplayUnit(damageValues, display, damageDisplay, unit, endTile, position) {
    var unitName = unit.units_name;
    var countryCode = unit.countries_code;

    if (viewerColors) {
      countryCode = viewerColors[unit.units_players_id] || countryCode;
    }

    var pipeSeam = defender.units_name === "Pipe Seam";
    var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
    var unitHp = unit.units_hit_points;
    var unitX = unit.units_x;
    var unitY = unit.units_y; //Take the tile at the end of the path for attacker if given

    if (endTile) {
      unitX = endTile % maxX;
      unitY = (endTile - unitX) / maxX;
    }

    var terrainName = terrainInfo[unitX] && terrainInfo[unitX][unitY] ? terrainInfo[unitX][unitY].terrain_name : buildingsInfo[unitX][unitY].terrain_name;
    var unitSpan = position === "A" ? display.children[1] : display.children[0];
    var unitSprite = unitSpan.children[0];
    var unitSrc = TP + countryCode + unitName.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, "") + ".gif";
    var hpSprite = unitSpan.children[1];
    var terrainSprite = position === "A" ? display.children[0] : display.children[1];
    var terrainSrc = TP + terrainName.toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, "") + ".gif";
    damageDisplay.textContent = damageValues.min + " - " + damageValues.max + "%";

    if (pipeSeam && position === "D"
    /* !pipeSeam || !/Seam/.test(terrainName) */
    ) {
      unitSprite.src = terrainSrc;
      damageDisplay.textContent = 0;
    } else {
      unitSprite.src = unitSrc;
      terrainSprite.src = terrainSrc;
      ensureSpriteVersion(terrainSprite);
    }

    ensureSpriteVersion(unitSprite);

    if (pipeSeam && position === "A") {
      //Pipeseam are not affected by luck:
      //Take the average damage for Sonja because of negative luck (floor value for no decimal)
      var isSonja = playersInfo[unitPId].co_name === "Sonja";
      var seamDamage = !isSonja ? damageValues.min : Math.floor((damageValues.min + damageValues.max) / 2);
      damageDisplay.textContent = seamDamage + "%";
    } //Display hp if < 10


    if (unitHp < 10) {
      hpSprite.src = TP + unitHp + ".gif";
      hpSprite.style.display = "block";
    } else {
      hpSprite.style.display = "none";
    }
  }
}

function createActionSquares(tileSet, type, actionHandler, clickedUnit) {
  var f = document.createDocumentFragment();
  tileSet.forEach(function (tile) {
    var actionSquare = document.createElement("span");
    actionSquare.classList.add(type + "-square", "hover-lower-bright", "action-square");
    var currentUnit = currentClick.info;
    var tileX = tile.x !== undefined ? tile.x : tile.units_x;
    var tileY = tile.y !== undefined ? tile.y : tile.units_y;
    applyCSS(actionSquare, {
      left: tileX * 16 - 1 + "px",
      top: tileY * 16 - 1 + "px"
    }); //Add the repairable unit id to the clickable square to get the reference later

    if (type === "repair") {
      actionSquare.setAttribute("data-" + type + "-id", tile.units_id);
    }

    actionSquare.onclick = function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      actionHandler(e, currentUnit, tileX, tileY, clickedUnit);
      resetCreatedTiles("span[class*='square'], span[class*='path']");
    };

    actionSquare.ontouchstart = function (e) {
      actionHandler(e, currentUnit, tileX, tileY, clickedUnit);
      resetCreatedTiles("span[class*='square'], span[class*='path']");
    };

    f.appendChild(actionSquare);
  });
  gamemap.appendChild(f);
} //Function that is attached to every "unload" square created


function unloadClickHandler(e, cargoUnit, dropX, dropY, clickedUnit) {
  var unloadData = {
    action: "Unload",
    playerID: cargoUnit.units_players_id,
    unitID: clickedUnit.units_id,
    dropX: dropX,
    dropY: dropY
  };
  emitData(webSocket, unloadData);
} //Function that is attached to every "repair" square created


function repairClickHandler(e, bBoat) {
  var targetId = e.target.getAttribute("data-repair-id");
  var repairData = {
    action: "Repair",
    playerID: bBoat.units_players_id,
    targetID: parseInt(targetId),
    unitID: bBoat.units_id,
    path: currentClick.path
  };
  emitData(webSocket, repairData);
} //Opens a menu that show possible unloads from a transport


function showUnloadOptions(options, selectedUnit) {
  var f = document.createDocumentFragment();
  var currentOptions = document.querySelector(".unit-options-game ul");
  currentOptions.innerHTML = "";
  options.forEach(function (loadedUnit) {
    if (!loadedUnit) return;
    var path = currentClick.path;
    var endNode = path[path.length - 1];
    var endX = selectedUnit.units_x !== undefined ? selectedUnit.units_x : endNode % maxX;
    var endY = selectedUnit.units_y !== undefined ? selectedUnit.units_y : (endNode - endX) / maxX;
    var landingTiles = findLandingTiles(currentClick.info, loadedUnit, endX, endY);
    var unitName = loadedUnit.units_name;
    var darkened = landingTiles.length !== 0 ? false : true;
    var unitSpan = createUnitSpan(loadedUnit, null, darkened);
    unitSpan.classList.add("menu-unit");
    var li = createOption(unitName, unitSpan); //Clickable if landing tiles exist, strike option if not

    if (landingTiles.length !== 0) {
      li.classList.add("hover-lower-bright");
      li.setAttribute("data-drop-id", loadedUnit.units_id);

      li.onclick = function () {
        li.onclick = null;
        createActionSquares(landingTiles, "landing", unloadClickHandler, loadedUnit);
        closeMenu();
      };
    } else {
      li.classList.add("forbidden");
    }

    f.appendChild(li);
  });
  unitOptionsContent.appendChild(f);
} //Make the appropriate unit elements from a unit object


function createUnitSpan(unit, playerCountry) {
  var darkened = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : false;
  var unitName = unit.units_name.toLowerCase().replace(" ", "");
  var unitX = unit.units_x;
  var unitY = unit.units_y;
  var capture = (unitName === "infantry" || unitName === "mech") && buildingsInfo[unitX] && buildingsInfo[unitX][unitY] && buildingsInfo[unitX][unitY].buildings_capture < 20;
  var cargo1 = unit.units_cargo1_units_id;
  var cargo2 = unit.units_cargo2_units_id;
  var loaded = cargo1 || cargo2;
  var dived = unit.units_sub_dive !== "N" ? true : false;
  var hp = unit.units_hit_points !== "?" ? unit.units_hit_points : "qhp";
  var unitSpan = document.createElement("span");
  var countryCode = unit.countries_code;

  if (viewerColors) {
    countryCode = viewerColors[unit.units_players_id] || countryCode;
  }

  var country = playerCountry || countryCode;

  if (darkened) {
    country = "gs_" + country;
  }

  makeImage(unitSpan, unitName, TP + country + unitName, "sprite");
  makeImage(unitSpan, hp, TP + hp, "unit-ricon", hp === 10);
  makeImage(unitSpan, capture, TP + "capture");
  makeImage(unitSpan, dived, TP + "subdive2"); //Unit is loaded and cargo is not unknown (Standard or teammates in Fog)

  if (loaded && cargo1 !== "?") {
    makeImage(unitSpan, loaded, TP + "load");
  } else if (loaded && cargo1 === "?") {
    makeImage(unitSpan, loaded, TP + "fogload");
  }

  return unitSpan;
} //Function to make an image/icon and append it to given unitSpan


function makeImage(unitSpan, icon, src) {
  var className = arguments.length > 3 && arguments[3] !== undefined ? arguments[3] : "unit-licon";
  var hidden = arguments.length > 4 && arguments[4] !== undefined ? arguments[4] : false;

  if (icon) {
    //Hidden hp for Sonja
    if (src === "?") src = "qhp";
    var image = new Image();
    image.setAttribute("draggable", false); // https://stackoverflow.com/questions/19126185/setting-an-image-src-to-empty
    // 1px transparent image for 10hp units to stop "10.gif not found" requests and errors in console

    if (icon == 10) image.src = "data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7";else {
      image.src = src + ".gif";
    }
    image.classList.add(className);
    if (hidden) image.style.display = "none";
    unitSpan.appendChild(image);
    return image;
  }
} //Show the available actions for a unit after clicking a movement square
//x & y is where the menu pops up


function showUnitOptions(options, x, y) {
  var f = document.createDocumentFragment(); //Reset menu options

  var currentOptions = document.querySelector(".unit-options-game ul");
  currentOptions.innerHTML = "";
  options.forEach(function (option) {
    var li = createOption(option.option); //Cross option if not available

    if (!option.clickable) {
      li.classList.add("forbidden");
    } else {
      li.classList.add("hover-lower-bright");
    }

    f.appendChild(li);
  });
  unitOptionsContent.appendChild(f);
  openMenu(unitOptionsMenu, x, y);
}

function showBuildOptions(x, y) {
  var building = buildingsInfo[x][y];
  var buildingId = building.buildings_id;
  var buildingName = building.terrain_name;
  var buildingSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + buildingId + "']");
  var coName = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].co_name;
  var coPower = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_co_power_on;
  var playerFunds = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_funds;
  var mTypes;
  var buildMenuType; //Get what units can be built

  if (/Base/.test(buildingName) || /City/.test(buildingName) && coName === "Hachi" && coPower === "S") {
    mTypes = ["F", "B", "T", "W", "P"];
    buildMenuType = buildMenuBase;
  } else if (/Airport/.test(buildingName)) {
    mTypes = ["A"];
    buildMenuType = buildMenuAirport;
  } else if (/Port/.test(buildingName)) {
    mTypes = ["L", "S"];
    buildMenuType = buildMenuPort;
  }

  if (!mTypes) return;
  var buildOptions = [];
  var hasLabs = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].labs !== 0;

  for (var unit in genericUnits) {
    //Skip banned units
    if (banUnits && banUnits[unit]) continue; //Skip lab units

    if (labUnits && labUnits[unit] && !hasLabs) continue;
    var mType = genericUnits[unit].units_movement_type;

    if (mTypes.includes(mType)) {
      buildOptions.push(genericUnits[unit]);
    }
  }

  var sortedOptions = buildOptions.sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.units_cost - b.units_cost;
  }); // Clear current menus

  var currentOptions = document.querySelectorAll(".build-options-game ul");
  currentOptions.forEach(function (option) {
    option.style.display = "none";
    option.innerHTML = "";
  });
  var leftColumnUnits = new Set();
  var extraColumnUnits = new Set(); // Less frequent units go into a separate 3rd section if desired

  if (buildMenuType == "F" && /Base/.test(buildingName)) {
    extraColumnUnits = new Set(["Rocket", "Missile", "Piperunner"]);
  } // Split evenly for double column


  if (buildMenuType == "F" || buildMenuType == "D") {
    var leftHalf = sortedOptions.slice(0, Math.ceil(sortedOptions.length / 2));
    leftHalf.forEach(function (unit) {
      return leftColumnUnits.add(unit.units_name);
    });
  }

  var playerCountry = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].countries_code;
  var costMultiplier = findCostMultiplier(getViewerPId()); //Create new option

  sortedOptions.forEach(function (unit) {
    var canBuy = playerFunds >= unit.units_cost * costMultiplier;
    var unitId = unit.units_id;
    var unitName = unit.units_name;
    var unitSpan = createUnitSpan(unit, (!canBuy ? "gs_" : "") + playerCountry);
    var li = createOption(unitName, unitSpan);
    var costSpan = document.createElement("span");
    costSpan.classList.add("unit-cost");
    costSpan.textContent = unit.units_cost * costMultiplier;
    li.setAttribute("data-build-unit", unitId);
    li.appendChild(costSpan); //Strike unit if can't buy
    //Will need visuals for lab units that aren't buyable in the menu

    if (!canBuy || labUnits && labUnits[unitName] && !hasLabs) li.classList.add("forbidden");else {
      li.classList.add("hover-lower-bright");

      var sendBuildData = function sendBuildData() {
        var buildData = {
          action: "Build",
          playerID: getViewerPId(),
          unitID: unitId,
          buildingID: buildingId
        };
        emitData(webSocket, buildData);
      };

      li.onclick = function () {
        li.onclick = null;

        if (buildConfirmation) {
          // Close build menu and display confirmation dialogue
          closeMenu();
          buildConfirmationMenu.style.display = "block";
          var unitSrc = TP + playerCountry + unit.units_name.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase() + ".gif";
          buildConfirmationUnitImage.src = unitSrc;
          buildConfirmationUnitName.textContent = unit.units_name;

          if (buildConfirmationBtn) {
            // Only ever have 1 listener at a time by using onclick instead of addEventListener
            buildConfirmationBtn.onclick = function () {
              sendBuildData();
              closeMenu();
            }; // Highlight the base that will be used


            animIcon(targetIcon, 1000 * 10, "anim-target", x, y, -5, -7);
          }
        } else {
          sendBuildData();
        }
      };
    } // Put the unit in the correct column

    if (leftColumnUnits.has(unit.units_name)) buildOptionsLeftColumn.appendChild(li);else if (extraColumnUnits.has(unit.units_name)) buildOptionsExtraColumn.appendChild(li);else buildOptionsRightColumn.appendChild(li);
  }); // Show columns if needed

  if (buildOptionsLeftColumn.childElementCount > 0) {
    buildOptionsLeftColumn.style.display = "flex";
  }

  if (buildOptionsRightColumn.childElementCount > 0) {
    buildOptionsRightColumn.style.display = "flex";
  }

  if (buildOptionsExtraColumn.childElementCount > 0) {
    var extraText = document.createElement("strong");
    extraText.textContent = "Less Frequent Units";
    buildOptionsExtraColumn.prepend(extraText);
    buildOptionsExtraColumn.style.marginTop = "8px";
    buildOptionsExtraColumn.style.display = "flex";
    buildOptionsRightColumn.appendChild(buildOptionsExtraColumn);
  }

  openMenu(buildOptionsMenu, x, y); // Try to keep the build menu on screen so the player doesn't have to scroll

  if (buildMenuInsideMap) {
    var mapBounds = map.getBoundingClientRect();
    var menuBounds = buildOptionsMenu.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (menuBounds.bottom > mapBounds.bottom) {
      var dt = menuBounds.top - mapBounds.top;
      var db = menuBounds.bottom - mapBounds.bottom;
      var offsetY = Math.max(0, dt - db);
      buildOptionsMenu.style.top = "".concat(offsetY, "px");
    }

    if (menuBounds.right > mapBounds.right + 210) {
      var tw = 16 * scale;
      var bx = x * tw - buildOptionsMenu.clientWidth - 2;

      if (bx >= 0) {
        buildOptionsMenu.style.left = "".concat(bx, "px");
      }
    }
  }
} //For COs with unordinary unit prices (Colin, Kanbei, Hachi)
//When dealing with unit value, Hachi's value remains 0.9x despite COP/SCOP


function findCostMultiplier(playerId, unitValue) {
  var coName = playersInfo[playerId].co_name;
  var costs = {
    Kanbei: 1.2,
    Colin: 0.8,
    Hachi: function () {
      var power = playersInfo[playerId].players_co_power_on;

      if ((power === "Y" || power === "S") && !unitValue) {
        return 0.5;
      } else {
        return 0.9;
      }
    }()
  };
  return costs[coName] || 1;
} //Function to add a new unit to the map with it's info stored in unitsInfo


function createNewUnit(unit, pId) {
  var countryCode = unit.countries_code;
  var movedState = unit.units_moved;
  var playerId = unit.units_players_id || pId;

  if (viewerColors) {
    countryCode = viewerColors[playerId] || countryCode;
  }

  var player = playersInfo[playerId];
  var newUnitId = unit.units_id;
  var unitSpan = createUnitSpan(unit, (movedState === 1 ? "gs_" : "") + countryCode);
  var x = unit.units_x;
  var y = unit.units_y;
  var unitClasses = ["game-unit", "clickable"];

  if (areAnimationsOn(playerId)) {
    unitClasses.push("game-unit-anim");
  }

  setElementAttributes(unitSpan, unitClasses, "data-unit-id", newUnitId, x, y);
  updateUnitMap(newUnitId, player.players_team, x, y);
  var playerUnits = playersUnits[playerId];
