  if (!playerUnits || Array.isArray(playerUnits)) {
    playersUnits[playerId] = {};
  }
  /* console.log(playersUnits[playerId]); */


  playersUnits[playerId][newUnitId] = newUnitId;
  /* console.log(playersUnits[playerId]); */

  unitsInfo[newUnitId] = unit;
  checkLowProp(newUnitId, unitSpan, "units_ammo", "aniammo");
  checkLowProp(newUnitId, unitSpan, "units_fuel", "anifuel");
  gamemap.appendChild(unitSpan);
  closeMenu();
  return unitSpan;
}

function updateUnitMap(unitId, unitTeam, x, y) {
  if (!unitMap[x]) {
    unitMap[x] = {};
  }

  unitMap[x][y] = {
    team: unitTeam,
    units_id: unitId
  };
}

function setElementAttributes(element, classNames, attributeName, attribute, x, y) {
  var _element$classList;

  (_element$classList = element.classList).add.apply(_element$classList, _toConsumableArray(classNames));

  element.setAttribute(attributeName, attribute);
  applyCSS(element, {
    left: x * 16 + "px",
    top: y * 16 + "px"
  });
} //Delete a unit and possible carried units from given one from global & player units


function deleteUnitInfo(unit) {
  var _unitMap$x2, _unitMap$x2$y, _buildingsInfo$x2;

  var isJoin = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;
  var decrementUnitCount = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : true;
  //Unit was already deleted
  if (!unit) return;
  var unitId = unit.units_id;
  var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
  var x = unit.units_x;
  var y = unit.units_y;
  var firstCargo = unit.units_cargo1_units_id;
  var secondCargo = unit.units_cargo2_units_id;
  delete unitsInfo[unitId];
  delete playersUnits[unitPId][unitId]; //Case for joining units where you want to keep the position in unit map
  //make sure unit in the unit map is the same as the given one

  var positionId = (_unitMap$x2 = unitMap[x]) === null || _unitMap$x2 === void 0 ? void 0 : (_unitMap$x2$y = _unitMap$x2[y]) === null || _unitMap$x2$y === void 0 ? void 0 : _unitMap$x2$y.units_id;

  if (!isJoin && positionId === unitId) {
    delete unitMap[x][y];
  } //Reset Building hp to 20
  //Don't reset for Pipe Seams or joining


  var buildingInfo = (_buildingsInfo$x2 = buildingsInfo[x]) === null || _buildingsInfo$x2 === void 0 ? void 0 : _buildingsInfo$x2[y];

  if (buildingInfo && !isJoin && !/Seam/.test(buildingInfo.terrain_name)) {
    buildingInfo.buildings_capture = 20;
  } //Condition for when a unit hides


  if (decrementUnitCount) {
    updateUnitCount(unitPId, unit.units_name, -1);
  } //Unit has loaded units, delete also
  //Loaded unit can also have a loaded units, do the same checks


  if (unitsInfo[firstCargo]) {
    deleteUnitInfo(unitsInfo[firstCargo]);
  }

  if (unitsInfo[secondCargo]) {
    deleteUnitInfo(unitsInfo[secondCargo]);
  }
}

function deleteUnitSpan(unitId) {
  var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
  if (!unitSpan) return;
  unitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(unitSpan);
}

function emitData(socket, data) {
  // console.log(JSON.stringify(data));
  socket.send(JSON.stringify(data));
} //Handler upon successful client connection to game page


function joinRoom(joinResponse) {
  var playerId = joinResponse.playerId;
  gameViewerCount.textContent = joinResponse.connectedCount; //Player is viewing game, change the view status to green

  if (playerId) {
    var _playersInfo$playerId;

    var viewStatus = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-activity-status");
    var isOnVacation = Number((_playersInfo$playerId = playersInfo[playerId]) === null || _playersInfo$playerId === void 0 ? void 0 : _playersInfo$playerId.users_vacation) === 1;
    var className = joinResponse.action === "JoinRoom" ? "dot_green" : "dot_yellow";
    viewStatus.classList.remove("dot_green", "dot_yellow", "dot_gray", "dot_red");
    viewStatus.classList.add(isOnVacation ? "dot_red" : className);
  }
}

function updatePlayersActivity(activityResponse) {
  gameViewerCount.textContent = activityResponse.viewer_count;

  for (var _i11 = 0, _Object$keys = Object.keys(activityResponse.activityMap); _i11 < _Object$keys.length; _i11++) {
    var _playersInfo$playerID;

    var playerID = _Object$keys[_i11];
    var viewStatus = document.querySelector("#player" + playerID + " .player-activity-status");
    var isOnVacation = Number((_playersInfo$playerID = playersInfo[playerID]) === null || _playersInfo$playerID === void 0 ? void 0 : _playersInfo$playerID.users_vacation) === 1;
    viewStatus.classList.remove("dot_green", "dot_yellow", "dot_gray", "dot_red");

    if (isOnVacation) {
      viewStatus.classList.add("dot_red");
    } else if (activityResponse.connectedPlayers.includes(Number(playerID))) {
      viewStatus.classList.add("dot_green");
    } else if (activityResponse.activityMap[playerID]) {
      viewStatus.classList.add("dot_yellow");
    } else {
      viewStatus.classList.add("dot_gray");
    }
  }
} //Socket response handlers below. Could move to a different file


function moveUnit(moveResponse, loadFlag) {
  var viewerTeam = getViewerPId() ? playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team : null;
  var unitResponse = moveResponse.unit;
  var unitResId = unitResponse.units_id;
  var unitResPId = unitResponse.units_players_id;
  var unitMType = unitResponse.units_movement_type;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[unitResPId];
  var unitResTeam = playerInfo.players_team;
  var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(unitResTeam);
  var path = moveResponse.path;
  var pathLength = path.length;
  var iniTile = path[0];
  var iniX = iniTile.x;
  var iniY = iniTile.y;
  var endTile = path[path.length - 1];
  var newX = endTile.x;
  var newY = endTile.y;
  var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitResId + "']"); //Unit was not in vision and just entered it, so create it

  if (!unitsInfo[unitResId]) {
    unitResponse.units_x = iniX;
    unitResponse.units_y = iniY; //Set unit to unmoved before creating it

    unitResponse.units_moved = 0;
    unitSpan = createNewUnit(unitResponse);
  } //Unit is in vision, delete initial position in unitMap (visual updated already in animation)


  if (unitMap[iniX] && unitMap[iniX][iniY]) {
    delete unitMap[iniX][iniY];
  }

  if (!loadFlag) {
    updateUnitMap(unitResId, unitResTeam, newX, newY);
    unitsInfo[unitResId] = unitResponse;
    unitsInfo[unitResId].units_x = newX;
    unitsInfo[unitResId].units_y = newY;
  }

  nextUnitCheck(unitResponse); //Move unit animation, small delay to make sure the unit is created properly

  if (pathLength > 1) {
    setTimeout(function () {
      animUnit(path, unitResId, unitSpan, unitResTeam, viewerTeam);
    }, 10);
  } else {
    //Unit was waited without moving
    //show trapped (can happen without moving if going into a teleport tile)
    if (moveResponse.trapped) {
      animIcon(trappedIcon, 2000, "", newX, newY, 16, 0);
    }

    return waitUnit(unitResId);
  }

  resetBuildingCapture(unitResId, iniX, iniY); //Check enemy neighbour units for Stealths or Subs around initial position of the moving unit and remove them

  if (isViewerTeam) {
    checkHiddenUnits(iniX, iniY, unitResponse);
  }

  var moveDelay = (path.length - 1) * movementSpeed; //Only update with new position if unit is not being loaded in Transport

  var unitVision = unitResponse.units_vision;
  var neighbours = loopNeighbours(iniX, iniY, unitResponse); //Update Fog display for moving enemy air unit (Forest/Reef)

  if (gameFog === "Y" && !isViewerTeam) {
    updateAirUnitFogOnMove(iniX, iniY, unitMType, neighbours, iniTile.unit_visible, "Remove", moveDelay);
    updateAirUnitFogOnMove(newX, newY, unitMType, neighbours, endTile.unit_visible, "Add", moveDelay);
  } else if (gameFog === "Y" && isViewerTeam) {
    //Update new vision, then remove old one
    if (!loadFlag) {
      updateFog(unitResponse, unitVision, playerInfo, null, null, newX, newY, undefined, moveDelay);
    }

    updateFog(unitResponse, unitVision, playerInfo, iniX, iniY, undefined, undefined, undefined);
  } //unit animations after moving


  setTimeout(function () {
    resetBuildingCapture(unitResId, newX, newY); //End of path is unknown, delete unit and end function

    var visibleEndTile = endTile.unit_visible;

    if (!visibleEndTile) {
      deleteUnitInfo(unitsInfo[unitResId]);
      if (unitSpan && unitSpan.parentElement) unitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(unitSpan);
      return;
    } //Unit is not loaded into a transport, update visual


    if (!loadFlag) {
      //Low fuel check
      checkLowProp(unitResId, unitSpan, "units_fuel", "anifuel");

      if (moveResponse.discovered) {
        showDiscovered(moveResponse.discovered);
      }
    }

    if (moveResponse.trapped) {
      animIcon(trappedIcon, 2000, "", newX, newY, 16, 0);
    }

    var selectedUnit = currentClick && currentClick.info; //Reset movement tiles if lag occurs (Player clicks on the unit again to display movement, then the unit starts moving)

    if (selectedUnit && selectedUnit.units_id === unitResId) {
      resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square'], .action-square");
    }
  }, moveDelay);
}

function resolveAttack(fireResponse) {
  var attUnit = fireResponse.attacker && fireResponse.attacker !== "?" ? unitsInfo[fireResponse.attacker.units_id] : null;
  var defUnit = fireResponse.defender && fireResponse.defender !== "?" ? unitsInfo[fireResponse.defender.units_id] : null;
  var copValues = fireResponse.copValues,
      gainedFunds = fireResponse.gainedFunds; //COP values are always visible to everyone regardless of fog

  var attPId = copValues.attacker.playerId;
  var defPId = copValues.defender.playerId;

  if (gameCop === "Y") {
    handlePowerBars(attPId, copValues.attacker);
    handlePowerBars(defPId, copValues.defender);
  }

  var attackDelay = areAnimationsOn() ? 1000 : 0; //Case for Sasha SCOP

  if (gainedFunds) {
    for (var playerId in gainedFunds) {
      var currentFunds = playersInfo[playerId].players_funds;
      updatePlayerRow(playerId, {
        "player-funds": currentFunds + gainedFunds[playerId]
      });
    }
  }

  if (attUnit) {
    var attDamage = (attUnit.units_hit_points - fireResponse.attacker.units_hit_points) * attUnit.units_cost;
    var newProps = fireResponse.attacker;

    for (var prop in newProps) {
      attUnit[prop] = newProps[prop];
    }

    updateUnitProps(attUnit, fireResponse.attacker, attPId, attDamage);

    if (attUnit.units_moved !== 1 || attUnit.units_fired === 1) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        waitUnit(attUnit.units_id);
      }, attackDelay);
    }
  }

  if (defUnit) {
    var defDamage = (defUnit.units_hit_points - fireResponse.defender.units_hit_points) * defUnit.units_cost;
    var _newProps = fireResponse.defender;

    for (var _prop in _newProps) {
      defUnit[_prop] = _newProps[_prop];
    }

    var defId = defUnit.units_id;
    var defX = defUnit.units_x;
    var defY = defUnit.units_y;

    if (areAnimationsOn()) {
      animIcon(targetIcon, 1000, "anim-target-unit", defX, defY, -5, -7);
    }

    updateUnitProps(defUnit, fireResponse.defender, defPId, defDamage);

    if (moving) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        //Redraw the move range if the unit died
        redrawMovementAfterAttack(defId);
      }, attackDelay);
    }
  } //A player was eliminated by rout


  if (fireResponse.eliminated) {
    setTimeout(function () {
      //Show after attack animation
      eliminationHandler(fireResponse.eliminated);
    }, attackDelay);
  } //Power bar changes function for both att/def


  function handlePowerBars(playerId, newValues) {
    var powerOn = playersInfo[playerId].players_co_power_on !== "N";
    var copValue = newValues.copValue;
    var tagValue = newValues.tagValue;

    if (!powerOn) {
      playersInfo[playerId].players_co_power = copValue;
      updatePowerBar(playerId, playersInfo);

      if (tagValue) {
        tagsInfo[playerId].players_co_power = tagValue;
        updatePowerBar(playerId, tagsInfo, true);
      }
    }
  }
}

function attackSeamHandler(seamResponse) {
  var newAttProps = seamResponse.attacker;

  if (newAttProps) {
    var attId = newAttProps.units_id;
    var attUnit = unitsInfo[attId];
    var attPId = attUnit.units_players_id;
    updateUnitProps(attUnit, newAttProps, attPId, 0);
    waitUnit(attId);
  }

  var newSeamHp = seamResponse.seamHp;
  var seamX = seamResponse.seamX;
  var seamY = seamResponse.seamY;
  var seamInfo = buildingsInfo[seamX][seamY];
  var seamId = seamInfo.buildings_id;
  seamInfo.buildings_capture = newSeamHp;

  if (areAnimationsOn()) {
    animIcon(targetIcon, 1000, "anim-target-unit", seamX, seamY, -5, -7);

    if (newSeamHp > 0) {
      // If the seam is not destroyed wiggle it after "attackDelay" ms like the targetIcon
      var seamSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + seamId + "']");
      wiggleTile(seamSpan, 1000);
    }
  }

  if (newSeamHp <= 0) {
    var seamSprite = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + seamId + "'] img");
    var newSeamTerrainId = seamResponse.seamTerrainId;
    var newSprite = newSeamTerrainId === 115 ? "HPipe Rubble" : "VPipe Rubble"; //Append the proper weather (nothing for clear weather)

    var weather = gameWeather.code === "C" ? "" : "_" + gameWeather.name;
    seamSprite.src = TP + newSprite.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase() + weather + ".gif";
    ensureSpriteVersion(seamSprite);
    seamInfo.terrain_id = newSeamTerrainId;
    seamInfo.terrain_defense = 1;
    seamInfo.terrain_name = newSprite;

    if (gameFog === "Y") {
      updateFog("Property", 0, playersInfo[getViewerPId()], seamX, seamY);
    } //Replace move costs to plain's

    /* const newMoveCosts = seamResponse.newMoveCosts;
    moveCosts[seamX][seamY] = newMoveCosts; */

  } //Update display if the user hasn't moved the cursor away from the seam


  if (buildingsInfo[coordX] && buildingsInfo[coordX][coordY]) {
    updateTileDisplay(coordX, coordY);
  }
}

function updateUnitProps(position, newProps, playerId, fundDamage) {
  var unitId = newProps.units_id;
  var unitTeam = playersInfo[playerId].players_team;
  var newHp = newProps.units_hit_points;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
  var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']"); //Unit has already been removed from vision
  //when the attacker died from a counter attack and the defender goes out of vision

  if (!unitsInfo[unitId]) return;
  var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(unitTeam); //New total value of units

  var unitCount = playersUnitCount[playerId];
  var cm = findCostMultiplier(playerId, true);
  unitCount.value -= fundDamage * cm / 10;
  updatePlayerRow(playerId, {
    "unit-value": unitCount.value
  });
  var unitX = position.units_x;
  var unitY = position.units_y; //Unit is dead

  if (newHp <= 0) {
    //Dead unit is owned or allied, remove it's vision
    if (gameFog === "Y") {
      //Remove vision of dead unit
      if (isViewerTeam) {
        updateFog(position, position.units_vision, playerInfo, unitX, unitY, undefined, undefined, undefined, 1000);
      } //Remove vision of wood/reef after killing an enemy air unit
      else if (checkEnemyAirOnWoodsReefs(unitX, unitY, position)) {
        updateFog("Wood", 0, playerInfo, unitX, unitY, undefined, undefined, undefined, 1000);
      }
    } //Dead unit is on a property, reset property's HP


    var unitBuilding = buildingsInfo[unitX] && buildingsInfo[unitX][unitY];

    if (unitBuilding && !/Seam/.test(unitBuilding.terrain_name)) {
      unitBuilding.buildings_capture = 20;
    }
  }

  setTimeout(function () {
    //Unit is dead, remove unit and update player's unit count
    if (newHp <= 0) {
      //Set the proper explosion icon (Land / Air / Naval)
      animExplosion(position);
      deleteUnitSpan(unitId);
      deleteUnitInfo(position);
      resetBuildingCapture(unitId, unitX, unitY); //Opponent stealths check around dead unit

      checkHiddenUnits(unitX, unitY, position);
      return;
    } //Unit is not dead, update HP


    if (newHp === "?" || newHp > 0 && newHp < 10) {
      //Special case for unknown hp (Sonja)
      if (newHp !== "?") {
        var hpSpan = unitSpan.children[1];
        hpSpan.src = "terrain/aw2/" + newHp + ".gif";
        hpSpan.style.display = "block";
      } //Low ammo check


      checkLowProp(unitId, unitSpan, "units_ammo", "aniammo");
    }
  }, areAnimationsOn() ? 1000 : 0);
} //Removes the clickable attack square if the user clicks a unit in between the
//unit's movement and attack
//Also redraws the path


function redrawMovementAfterAttack(defId) {
  //Remove the clickable attack square if it remains
  var attackSquare = document.querySelector("span[data-attack-uid='" + defId + "']");

  if (attackSquare) {
    attackSquare.parentElement.removeChild(attackSquare);
  } //Player has a unit selected, redraw movement


  var selectedUnit = currentClick && currentClick.info;
  if (!selectedUnit) return;
  var unitPId = selectedUnit.units_players_id;
  if (currentTurn !== unitPId) return;
  var mType = selectedUnit.units_movement_type;
  var mp = selectedUnit.units_movement_points;
  var startTile = {
    x: selectedUnit.units_x,
    y: selectedUnit.units_y
  };
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[unitPId];
  var unitTeam = playerInfo.players_team;
  resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square']");
  movementInfo = getMovementTiles(maxX, maxY, mType, mp, startTile, unitTeam, playerInfo);
} //Check if ammo is under 1/2 and fuel under 1/3 then append icon


function checkLowProp(unitId, unitSpan, property, icon) {
  var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
  if (!unit) return;
  if (unit.units_carried === "Y") return;
  var currentProp = unit[property];
  var fullProp = genericUnits[unit.units_name][property];
  var unitIcon = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .unit-ricon-" + icon); //Low ammo is less than half, fuel is less than 1/3

  var divider = property == "units_ammo" ? 2 : 3;

  if (!unitIcon && currentProp < Math.ceil(fullProp / divider)) {
    if (!unitSpan) {
      unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
    }

    makeImage(unitSpan, 1, TP + icon, "unit-ricon-" + icon);
  } //Icon already exists, simply remove it
  else if (unitIcon && currentProp > Math.ceil(fullProp / divider)) {
    unitIcon.parentElement.removeChild(unitIcon);
  }
} //Check for removal of enemy hidden units after movement / attack
//For movement, enemy hidden units around the INITIAL position


function checkHiddenUnits(unitX, unitY, unit) {
  // console.log("Checking for hidden units...");
  if (gameEndDate) return;
  var neighbours = loopNeighbours(unitX, unitY, unit);
  var enemyNeighbours = neighbours.enemy; // console.log(enemyNeighbours);

  if (enemyNeighbours && enemyNeighbours.length !== 0) {
    enemyNeighbours.forEach(function (enemyUnit) {
      var unitName = enemyUnit.units_name;
      var hidden = enemyUnit.units_sub_dive === "Y" || enemyUnit.units_sub_dive === "D";

      if (hidden && (unitName === "Sub" || unitName === "Stealth")) {
        // console.log("Unit is hidden!");
        //Check how many allied units are around given hidden unit
        var enemyX = enemyUnit.units_x;
        var enemyY = enemyUnit.units_y; //Check for allied properties

        var building = buildingsInfo[enemyX] && buildingsInfo[enemyX][enemyY];
        var buildingTeam = building && building.buildings_team;
        var viewerTeam = getViewerPId() && playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team; //Hidden unit is on allied property, keep it on the map

        if (viewerTeam === buildingTeam) return; // console.log("Not on an allied building!");

        var teamNeighbours = loopNeighbours(enemyX, enemyY, enemyUnit).team; // console.log(teamNeighbours);
        //No team unit around enemy hidden unit after last one moves, remove it

        if (teamNeighbours && teamNeighbours.length === 0) {
          console.log("No other team members adjacent!");
          var unitId = enemyUnit.units_id;
          var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
          unitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(unitSpan);
          deleteUnitInfo(enemyUnit);
        }
      }
    });
  }
} //Darken Woods/Reefs if enemy air unit was killed and no other allied unit is around


function checkEnemyAirOnWoodsReefs(x, y, unit) {
  var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
  var unitTeam = playersInfo[unitPId].players_team;
  var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(unitTeam); //Skip for allied units

  if (isViewerTeam) return;
  var unitMType = unit.units_movement_type;
  if (unitMType !== "A") return;
  var terrainName = terrainInfo[x] && terrainInfo[x][y] && terrainInfo[x][y].terrain_name;
  if (terrainName !== "Wood" && terrainName !== "Reef") return;
  return true;
}

function buildUnit(buildData) {
  var newUnit = buildData.newUnit;
  var unitPId = newUnit.units_players_id;
  var player = playersInfo[unitPId];
  var unitTeam = player.players_team;
  var unitCo = player.co_name;
  var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(unitTeam);
  var isActiveTeam = getViewerPId() && playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team === unitTeam || activeVision.team && unitTeam === activeVision.team && grantedVisions && grantedVisions[activeVision.team];
  var unitX = newUnit.units_x;
  var unitY = newUnit.units_y;
  createNewUnit(newUnit);
  var discovered = buildData.discovered;
  if (discovered) showDiscovered(discovered); //Built unit is in the same team as viewer, update vision visual

  if (gameFog === "Y" && isActiveTeam) {
    updateFog(newUnit, newUnit.units_vision, player, null, null, unitX, unitY);
  }

  if (gameFog === "Y" && isViewerTeam || gameFog === "N") {
    //Update individual unit counts and total
    updateUnitCount(unitPId, newUnit.units_name, 1); //Opponent's CO who built a unit is Sonja, don't update the rest

    if (unitCo === "Sonja" && !isViewerTeam) return;
    var costMultiplierValue = findCostMultiplier(unitPId, true); //Special case for Hachi: unit cost for new funds is * 0.5

    var costMultiplierFunds = findCostMultiplier(unitPId, false);
    var unitCost = newUnit.units_cost;
    var newFunds = player.players_funds - unitCost * costMultiplierFunds;
    var newTotalValue = playersUnitCount[unitPId].value + unitCost * costMultiplierValue;
    playersInfo[unitPId].players_funds = newFunds; //Update player funds and total unit value

    var newTableValues = {
      "player-funds": newFunds,
      "unit-value": newTotalValue
    };
    playersUnitCount[unitPId].value = newTotalValue;
    updatePlayerRow(unitPId, newTableValues);
  }

  nextBaseCheck(buildingsInfo[unitX][unitY]);
} //Handles capture operation responses


function captureHandler(captData) {
  var newBuilding = captData.buildingInfo; //no building shown in case of an elimination out of vision

  if (newBuilding) {
    var x = newBuilding.buildings_x;
    var y = newBuilding.buildings_y;
    var newBuildingHp = newBuilding.buildings_capture;
    var newBuildingTeam = newBuilding.buildings_team;
    var viewerTeam = getViewerPId() ? playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team : null; //Building info before the capture occured

    var buildingInfo = buildingsInfo[x][y];
    var buildingTeam = buildingInfo.buildings_team;
    var unitId = unitMap[x] && unitMap[x][y] && unitMap[x][y].units_id;
    var cappingUnit = unitsInfo[unitId];
    var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']"); //Unit is not already marked as move (Move handler not ran before)

    if (cappingUnit && cappingUnit.units_moved !== 1) {
      waitUnit(unitId);
    }

    if (captData.discovered) {
      showDiscovered(captData.discovered);
    } //Building is being captured, update properties with new ones


    if (newBuildingHp > 0 && newBuildingHp < 20) {
      //Capture icon on capping unit
      makeImage(unitSpan, 1, TP + "capture", "unit-licon"); //Loop props to replace existing ones

      for (var prop in newBuilding) {
        buildingInfo[prop] = newBuilding[prop];
      }
    } else {
      //Building was fully captured, update with new one and remove Capture icon
      var captIcon = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .unit-licon");

      if (captIcon) {
        captIcon.parentElement.removeChild(captIcon);
      }

      var oldPId = buildingInfo.buildings_players_id;
      var newPId = newBuilding.buildings_players_id; //change the building

      changeBuildingOwner(oldPId, newPId, newBuilding);
      var prevBuilding = buildingsInfo[x][y];
      buildingsInfo[x][y] = newBuilding;
      changeBuildingSprite(newBuilding, prevBuilding);
      updateBuildingCounts();

      if (gameFog === "Y") {
        if (hasTeamVision(buildingTeam) && !hasTeamVision(newBuildingTeam)) {
          //Remove vision
          updateFog("Building", 0, playersInfo[oldPId], x, y);
        } else if (hasTeamVision(newBuildingTeam) && newBuildingHp === 20) {
          //Add vision
          updateFog("Building", 0, playersInfo[newPId], null, null, x, y);
        }
      }
    } //Update player's income
    //Object containing one player only


    var newIncome = captData.newIncome;

    if (newIncome && newIncome.income !== undefined) {
      updatePlayerRow(newIncome.player, {
        "player-income": newIncome.income
      });
    } else {
      //Object has multiple players, loop each player
      for (var player in newIncome) {
        updatePlayerRow(newIncome[player].player, {
          "player-income": newIncome[player].income
        });
      }
    }
  } //Update page with eliminated player's info and show Event screen


  if (captData.eliminated) {
    var gameOver = captData.eliminated.GameOver;

    if (gameOver) {
      gameOver.losers.forEach(function (loserId) {
        eliminatePlayer(loserId);
      });
      endGameHandler(gameOver);
    } else {
      eliminationHandler(captData.eliminated);
    }
  }
}

function loadUnit(loadData) {
  var transportId = loadData.transportId;
  var loadedId = loadData.loadedId;
  var loadedUnit = unitsInfo[loadedId];
  var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + loadedId + "']");
  var transportUnit = unitsInfo[transportId];
  var firstCargo = Number(transportUnit.units_cargo1_units_id) || transportUnit.units_cargo1_units_id;
  var secondCargo = Number(transportUnit.units_cargo2_units_id) || transportUnit.units_cargo2_units_id;

  if (loadedUnit) {
    loadedUnit.units_carried = "Y";
  }

  if (unitSpan) {
    unitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(unitSpan);
  } //Undarken unit if darkened
  //Moved transport that is carrying a unit is seen as unmoved


  if (transportUnit && transportUnit.units_moved === 1) {
    unwaitUnit(transportId);
    transportUnit.units_moved = 1;
  } //Fog Canvas is updated in the move handler
  //Cargo is unknown, don't update cargo and delete unit info (Opponents in Fog)


  if (firstCargo === "?") {
    //unitMap's position is already deleted in moveUnit ran before
    if (loadedUnit) deleteUnitInfo(loadedUnit);
  } else {
    //Check which cargo to put unit in
    if (!firstCargo) {
      transportUnit.units_cargo1_units_id = loadedId;
    } else {
      transportUnit.units_cargo2_units_id = loadedId;
    }
  } //Cargo is known, append Load icon to transport


  if (firstCargo !== "?" && !firstCargo && !secondCargo) {
    var transportSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + transportId + "']");
    makeImage(transportSpan, 1, TP + "load", "unit-licon");
  }
} //Use full unit in case game is fog and unit is not already present in unitsInfo


function unloadUnit(unloadData) {
  var transportId = unloadData.transportId;
  var unloadedUnit = unloadData.unloadedUnit;
  var unitId = unloadedUnit.units_id;
  var unitTeam = playersInfo[unloadedUnit.units_players_id].players_team;
  var unitX = unloadedUnit.units_x;
  var unitY = unloadedUnit.units_y;
  var viewerTeam = getViewerPId() ? playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team : null;
  var transportUnit = unitsInfo[transportId];
  var transportX;
  var transportY;
  var firstCargo;
  var secondCargo; //Declare a path from the transport to the unloaded square for the moving animation

  var unloadPath = [{
    x: unitX,
    y: unitY,
    unit_visible: true
  }];

  if (transportUnit) {
    firstCargo = Number(transportUnit.units_cargo1_units_id) || transportUnit.units_cargo1_units_id;
    secondCargo = Number(transportUnit.units_cargo2_units_id) || transportUnit.units_cargo2_units_id;
    transportX = transportUnit.units_x;
    transportY = transportUnit.units_y;
    unloadPath.unshift({
      x: transportX,
      y: transportY,
      unit_visible: false
    });

    if (gameFog === "Y" && fogInfo[transportX][transportY] > 0 && gameFog === "N") {
      unloadPath[0].unit_visible = true;
    }

    var unitMoved = transportUnit.units_moved; //Loaded unit is not unknown, update the cargo (Standard)

    if (firstCargo && firstCargo !== "?" || secondCargo && secondCargo !== "?") {
      if (firstCargo === unitId) {
        transportUnit.units_cargo1_units_id = 0;
      } else {
        transportUnit.units_cargo2_units_id = 0;
      } //Updated Transport unit is seen as empty (Standard or Fog teammates)


      var updatedCargo1 = transportUnit.units_cargo1_units_id;
      var updatedCargo2 = transportUnit.units_cargo2_units_id;

      if (!updatedCargo1 && !updatedCargo2) {
        var loadIcon = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + transportId + "'] .unit-licon");
        loadIcon.parentElement.removeChild(loadIcon); //Wait tranport when every unit is unloaded

        if (!updatedCargo1 && !updatedCargo2 && unitMoved !== 0) {
          waitUnit(transportId);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  unloadedUnit.units_carried = "N";
  var unitSpan = createNewUnit(unloadedUnit); //Override the current unloaded position to the transport's position if applicable for the animation

  setElementAttributes(unitSpan, ["game-unit"], "data-unit-id", unitId, transportX || unitX, transportY || unitY);
  setTimeout(function () {
    animUnit(unloadPath, unitId, unitSpan, unitTeam, viewerTeam);
  }, 10); //Unit is in the same team as viewer, update Fog canvas

  if (gameFog === "Y" && hasTeamVision(unitTeam)) {
    updateFog(unloadedUnit, unloadedUnit.units_vision, playersInfo[unloadedUnit.units_players_id], null, null, unitX, unitY);
  }

  var discovered = unloadData.discovered;
  if (discovered) showDiscovered(discovered);
}

function supplyUnits(supplyRes) {
  var suppliedIds = supplyRes.suppliedIds;
  suppliedIds.forEach(function (unitId, unitIndex) {
    supply(unitId, unitIndex);
  });
} //For APCs and buildings


function supply(unitId) {
  var unitIndex = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 0;
  var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
  if (!unit) return;
  var genericUnit = genericUnits[unit.units_name];
  unit.units_ammo = genericUnit.units_ammo;
  unit.units_fuel = genericUnit.units_fuel;
  var fuelIcon = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .unit-ricon-anifuel");
  var ammoIcon = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .unit-ricon-aniammo");
  var unitX = unit.units_x;
  var unitY = unit.units_y; //Increment the next "supplied!" animation delay for each unit

  setTimeout(function () {
    animIcon(supplyIcon, 500, "", unitX, unitY, 16);
  }, 525 * unitIndex);
  if (fuelIcon) fuelIcon.parentElement.removeChild(fuelIcon);
  if (ammoIcon) ammoIcon.parentElement.removeChild(ammoIcon);
} //For black boats


function repairUnit(repairData) {
  var blackBoatId = repairData.unitId;
  var repairedId = repairData.repairedUnit.units_id;
  var repairedUnit = unitsInfo[repairedId];
  var newFunds = repairData.funds;
  var newHp = repairData.repairedUnit.units_hit_points;
  var oldHp = repairedUnit && repairedUnit.units_hit_points;
  var unitHpGain;

  if (repairedUnit) {
    unitHpGain = newHp - oldHp;
    updateHP(repairedId, unitHpGain);
    supply(repairedId, 0);
  }

  var repairer = unitsInfo[blackBoatId];

  if (repairer && !repairer.units_moved) {
    waitUnit(blackBoatId);
  }

  if (repairedUnit && newFunds >= 0) {
    var unitCost = repairedUnit.units_cost;
    var repairedPId = repairedUnit.units_players_id;
    var cm = findCostMultiplier(repairedPId, true);
    var newTotalValue = playersUnitCount[repairedPId].value + cm * unitCost / 10 * unitHpGain;
    playersUnitCount[repairedPId].value = newTotalValue;
    playersInfo[repairedPId].players_funds = newFunds;
    updatePlayerRow(repairedPId, {
      "player-funds": newFunds,
      "unit-value": newTotalValue
    });
  }
}

function hideUnit(hideData) {
  var unitId = hideData.unitId;
  var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
  var unitName = unit.units_name;
  var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
  var unitMoved = unit.units_moved === 1;

  if (!unitMoved) {
    waitUnit(unitId);
  } //Delete unit if not in the player's team


  if (!hideData.vision) {
    var unitTeam = playersInfo[unit.units_players_id].players_team;
    var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(unitTeam);
    unitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(unitSpan);
    deleteUnitInfo(unit, false, false);

    if (gameFog === "Y" && !isViewerTeam) {
      var unitX = unit.units_x;
      var unitY = unit.units_y;
      var neighbours = loopNeighbours(unitX, unitY, unit);
      updateAirUnitFogOnMove(unitX, unitY, "A", neighbours, true, "Remove");
    }
  } else {
    unit.units_sub_dive = unitName === "Stealth" ? "Y" : "D";
    makeImage(unitSpan, unit.units_sub_dive, TP + "subdive2");
  }
}

function unhideUnit(unhideData) {
  var unit = unhideData.unit;
  var unitId = unit.units_id;
  var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
  unit.units_sub_dive = "N"; //Create unit if it doesn't exist (not in same team)

  if (!unitsInfo[unitId]) {
    unit.units_moved = 1;
    createNewUnit(unit, unitPId);
    var unitTeam = playersInfo[unitPId].players_team;
    var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(unitTeam); //Air unit unhides on Woods in fog, make it visible

    if (gameFog === "Y" && !isViewerTeam) {
      var unitX = unit.units_x;
      var unitY = unit.units_y;
      var neighbours = loopNeighbours(unitX, unitY, unit);
      updateAirUnitFogOnMove(unitX, unitY, "A", neighbours, true, "Add");
    }
  } else {
    //Unit already exists in the map, simply removes the hidden icon
    var hiddenIcon = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .unit-licon");
    hiddenIcon.parentElement.removeChild(hiddenIcon);
    unitsInfo[unitId] = unit;
    waitUnit(unitId);
  }
} //For black bombs


function explodeUnit(data) {
  var explosionX = data.explosionX;
  var explosionY = data.explosionY;
  var bombId = data.unitId;
  var bomb = unitsInfo[bombId];

  if (bomb) {
    var bombSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + bombId + "']");
    var bombPId = bomb.units_players_id;
    var cm = findCostMultiplier(bombPId, true);
    var playerUnitCount = playersUnitCount[bombPId];
    var bombCost = bomb.units_cost;
    var bombHp = bomb.units_hit_points;
    var newValue = playerUnitCount.value - bombCost * bombHp / 10 * cm;
    playerUnitCount.value = newValue;
    updatePlayerRow(bombPId, {
      "unit-value": newValue
    });
    var bombTeam = playersInfo[bombPId].players_team;
    var viewerTeam = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team;

    if (gameFog === "Y" && hasTeamVision(bombTeam)) {
      updateFog(bomb, bomb.units_vision, playersInfo[bombPId], explosionX, explosionY);
    }

    animExplosion(bomb);
    deleteUnitInfo(bomb);
    bombSpan.parentElement.removeChild(bombSpan);
  }

  damageUnitsInRangeOf(3, -5, explosionX, explosionY);
}

function launchSilo(data) {
  var siloX = data.siloX;
  var siloY = data.siloY;
  var siloInfo = buildingsInfo[siloX][siloY];
  var siloId = siloInfo.buildings_id;
  var siloSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + siloId + "']");
  var siloSprite = siloSpan.children[0];
  var targetX = data.targetX;
  var targetY = data.targetY; //Get the weather name and append it to src (Snow or Rain)

  var weatherName = gameWeather.code !== "C" ? "_" + gameWeather.name.toLowerCase() : "";
  var siloDelay = areAnimationsOn() ? 3000 : 0;
  createSquareInRangeOf(2, 0, "silo", targetX, targetY);
  animIcon(targetIcon, siloDelay, "anim-target", targetX, targetY, -5, -7); //Animation delay

  setTimeout(function () {
    resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='square']"); //Change silo's sprite to empty

    siloSprite.src = TP + "missilesiloempty" + weatherName + ".gif";
    ensureSpriteVersion(siloSprite);
    siloInfo.terrain_id = 112;
    siloInfo.terrain_name = "Missile Silo Empty"; //new position

    siloSpan.style.top = parseInt(siloSpan.style.top) + 8 + "px";
    damageUnitsInRangeOf(2, -3, targetX, targetY);
    var firedBy = unitMap[siloX] && unitMap[siloX][siloY];

    if (firedBy) {
      var firedById = firedBy.units_id;
      waitUnit(firedById);
    }
  }, siloDelay);
} //Used for silos/black bombs


function damageUnitsInRangeOf(radius, hp, x, y) {
  for (var _i12 = -radius; _i12 <= radius; _i12++) {
    for (var j = -radius; j <= radius; j++) {
      var distanceFromCenter = Math.abs(_i12) + Math.abs(j);
      if (distanceFromCenter > radius) continue;
      var ax = x + _i12;
      var ay = y + j;
      var unitId = unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay] && unitMap[ax][ay].units_id;
      if (!unitId) continue;
      var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
      var hpBefore = unit.units_hit_points;
      updateHP(unitId, hp, true);
      var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
      var unitTeam = playersInfo[unitPId].players_team;
      var viewerTeam = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team;
      if (unitTeam !== viewerTeam) continue;
      var hpAfter = unit.units_hit_points;
      var hpDiff = hpBefore - hpAfter;
      var cm = findCostMultiplier(unitPId, true);
      var unitDamage = unit.units_cost / 10 * hpDiff * cm;
      var newValue = playersUnitCount[unitPId].value - unitDamage;
      playersUnitCount[unitPId].value = newValue;
      updatePlayerRow(unitPId, {
        "unit-value": newValue
      });
    }
  }
} //Change sprite of unit and moved state in unitsInfo


function waitUnit(unitId) {
  var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
  if (!unit) return;
  var unitName = unit.units_name;
  var countryCode = unit.countries_code;

  if (viewerColors) {
    countryCode = viewerColors[unit.units_players_id] || countryCode;
  }

  var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
  if (!unitSpan) return;
  var unitSprite = unitSpan.children[0];
  var cargo1 = unit.units_cargo1_units_id;
  var cargo2 = unit.units_cargo2_units_id; //For transport units, don't darken it until every carried unit is unloaded

  if (!cargo1 && !cargo2) {
    unitSprite.src = TP + "gs_" + countryCode + unitName.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase() + ".gif";
    ensureSpriteVersion(unitSprite);
  }

  unit.units_moved = 1;
}

function unwaitUnit(unitId) {
  var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
  unit.units_moved = 0;
  unit.units_fired = 0; //Select image and change the sprite to refreshed unit

  var unitSprite = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .sprite");
  if (!unitSprite) return;
  var refreshedSprite = unitSprite.src.replace("gs_", "");
  unitSprite.src = refreshedSprite;
  ensureSpriteVersion(unitSprite);
  var stunIcon = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .stun-icon");
  if (!stunIcon) return;
  stunIcon.parentElement.removeChild(stunIcon);
}

function deleteUnit(deleteData) {
  var unitId = deleteData.deletedId;
  var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
  var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
  var viewerTeam = playersInfo[getViewerPId()] && playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[unitPId];
  var unitTeam = playerInfo.players_team;
  var unitX = unit.units_x;
  var unitY = unit.units_y;
  var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(unitTeam);
  nextUnitCheck(unit);
  animExplosion(unit);
  deleteUnitSpan(unitId);

  if (gameFog === "Y") {
    if (hasTeamVision(unitTeam)) {
      updateFog(unit, unit.units_vision, playerInfo, unitX, unitY);
    } else if (checkEnemyAirOnWoodsReefs(unitX, unitY, unit)) {
      updateFog("Wood", 0, playerInfo, unitX, unitY);
    }
  }

  deleteUnitInfo(unit); //Check enemy neighbour units for Stealths or Subs around initial position of the moving unit and remove them

  if (isViewerTeam) {
    checkHiddenUnits(unitX, unitY, unit);
  }

  var cm = findCostMultiplier(unitPId, true);
  var unitCost = unit.units_cost;
  var unitHp = unit.units_hit_points;
  var newValue = playersUnitCount[unitPId].value - unitHp * unitCost / 10 * cm;
  playersUnitCount[unitPId].value = newValue;
  updatePlayerRow(unitPId, {
    "unit-value": newValue
  });
  var eliminated = deleteData.eliminated;

  if (eliminated) {
    eliminationHandler(eliminated);
  }
}

function joinUnits(joinData) {
  var playerId = joinData.playerId; //Unit that initiated the join

  var joinId = joinData.joinId;
  var joinUnit = unitsInfo[joinId]; //Unit that resulted from the join

  var joinedUnit = joinData.joinedUnit;
  var joinedUnitId = joinedUnit.units_id; //Remove the unit that joined the second one

  if (joinUnit) {
    var joinUnitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + joinId + "']");
    joinUnitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(joinUnitSpan);
    deleteUnitInfo(joinUnit, true);
  }

  var hpDif = joinedUnit.units_hit_points - unitsInfo[joinedUnitId].units_hit_points;

  if (hpDif !== 0) {
    updateHP(joinedUnitId, hpDif);
  }

  unitsInfo[joinedUnitId] = joinedUnit;
  var unitX = joinedUnit.units_x;
  var unitY = joinedUnit.units_y;
  unitMap[unitX][unitY].units_id = joinedUnitId;
  waitUnit(joinedUnitId);
  checkLowProp(joinedUnitId, null, "units_ammo", "aniammo");
  checkLowProp(joinedUnitId, null, "units_fuel", "anifuel");
  var oldFunds = playersInfo[playerId].players_funds;
  var newFunds = joinData.newFunds || oldFunds;
  var unitValue = playersUnitCount[playerId].value;
  var newUnitValue = unitValue - (newFunds - oldFunds);
  playersUnitCount[playerId].value = newUnitValue;
  updatePlayerRow(playerId, {
    "player-funds": newFunds,
    "unit-value": newUnitValue
  });
} //For each property there is a handler that updates the visual


var powerVisualHandlers = {
  players_co_power: powerCopBarHandler,
  players_funds: powerFundsHandler,
  tags_co_power: powerCopBarHandler,
  units_fuel: powerSupplyHandler,
  units_hit_points: powerHpHandler,
  units_moved: powerRefreshHandler,
  units_vision: powerVisionHandler
};
var powerAnimations = {
  Sturm: animMeteor
};

function powerHandler(powerRes) {
  var unitReplace = powerRes.unitReplace && (powerRes.unitReplace.units || []);
  var hiddenReplace = powerRes.hiddenReplace && (powerRes.hiddenReplace.units || []);
  var playerReplace = powerRes.playerReplace;
  var unitAdd = powerRes.unitAdd;
  var weatherReplace = powerRes.weatherReplace;
  var discovered = powerRes.discovered; //Object for mass damage

  var hpChange = powerRes.hpChange;
  var globalChange = powerRes.global;
  var powerPId = powerRes.playerId;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[powerPId];

  if (playerInfo.players_co_max_power < 0) {
    playerInfo.players_co_max_power *= 1;
  }

  if (playerInfo.players_co_max_spower < 0) {
    playerInfo.players_co_max_spower *= 1;
  }

  var username = playerInfo.users_username;
  var powerType = powerRes.coPower === "Y" ? "CO Power" : "Super CO Power";
  var coName = powerRes.coName; //Display event

  var powerEvent = {
    username: powerType,
    co: coName,
    playerInfo: playerInfo,
    country: playerInfo.countries_code,
    text: username + " activated " + powerRes.coName + "'s " + powerRes.powerName + "!"
  };
  showEventScreen(powerEvent);
  playerInfo.players_co_power_on = powerRes.coPower;
  playerInfo.players_co_power = powerRes.copValue; //Increment players max s/power by 1800 funds for each star

  var copStars = playerInfo.co_max_power / 90000;
  var scopStars = playerInfo.co_max_spower / 90000 + copStars;
  playerInfo.players_max_power += copStars * 18000;
  playerInfo.players_max_spower += scopStars * 18000;
  updateCopValues(powerPId);
  resetPowerBar(powerPId);
  updatePowerBar(powerPId, playersInfo);
  updateRowPower(powerPId, powerRes.coPower, "hidden", "visible");
  var cm = findCostMultiplier(powerPId, true);

  if (hpChange) {
    var hpLoss = hpChange.hpLoss;

    if (hpLoss) {
      var affectedPlayers = hpLoss.players;
      affectedPlayers.forEach(function (playerId) {
        var playerUnits = playersUnits[playerId];
        var unitCount = playersUnitCount[playerId];
        var unitValueLoss = 0;

        for (var unitId in playerUnits) {
          var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];
          if (unitInfo.units_carried !== "N") continue;
          var unitFuel = unitInfo.units_fuel;
          var fuelMultiplier = hpLoss.units_fuel; //Check how much hp the unit actually loses (case for new hp inferior to 1)

          var unitHpLoss = findHpGain(unitInfo, hpLoss.hp);
          updateHP(unitId, unitHpLoss, true);
          unitValueLoss += unitInfo.units_cost * 0.1 * cm * unitHpLoss;

          if (fuelMultiplier !== 1) {
            unitInfo.units_fuel = Math.ceil(unitFuel * fuelMultiplier);
            checkLowProp(unitId, "", "units_fuel", "anifuel");
          }
        }

        unitCount.value += unitValueLoss;
        updatePlayerRow(playerId, {
          "unit-value": unitCount.value
        });
      });
    }

    var hpGain = hpChange.hpGain;

    if (hpGain) {
      var playerUnits = playersUnits[powerPId];
      var _unitCount = playersUnitCount[powerPId];
      var unitValueGain = 0;

      for (var unitId in playerUnits) {
        var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];
        if (unitInfo.units_carried !== "N") continue; //Check how much hp the unit gains (case for new hp superior to 10)

        var unitHpGain = findHpGain(unitsInfo[unitId], hpGain.hp);
        updateHP(unitId, unitHpGain, true);
        unitValueGain += unitInfo.units_cost * 0.1 * cm * unitHpGain;
      }

      _unitCount.value += unitValueGain;
      updatePlayerRow(powerPId, {
        "unit-value": _unitCount.value
      });
    }
  }

  if (globalChange) {
    var _playerUnits = playersUnits[powerPId];

    for (var prop in globalChange) {
      var propValue = globalChange[prop];
      if (propValue === 0) continue;

      for (var _unitId in _playerUnits) {
        var _unitInfo = unitsInfo[_unitId];
        var newProp = _unitInfo[prop] + propValue;
        var visualHandler = powerVisualHandlers[prop];

        if (visualHandler) {
          visualHandler(_unitInfo, newProp);
        }

        _unitInfo[prop] = newProp;
      }
    }
  }

  if (hiddenReplace) {
    unitReplace = unitReplace.concat(hiddenReplace);
  }

  if (unitReplace) {
    var powerAnimation = powerAnimations[coName];

    if (powerAnimation) {
      powerAnimation(powerRes.missileCoords);
    }

    unitReplace.forEach(function (unitProps) {
      //Game's unitInfo object
      var unitId = unitProps.units_id;
      var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];

      for (var _newProp in unitProps) {
        //New properties object from the response
        if (_newProp === "units_id") continue;
        var newValue = unitProps[_newProp];
        var _visualHandler = powerVisualHandlers[_newProp];

        if (_visualHandler && newValue !== unitInfo[_newProp]) {
          _visualHandler(unitInfo, newValue);
        }

        unitInfo[_newProp] = newValue;
      }
    });
  }

  if (playerReplace) {
    for (var playerId in playerReplace) {
      //Game's playerInfo object
      var _playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];

      for (var _newProp2 in playerReplace[playerId]) {
        //New properties object from the response
        var newValue = playerReplace[playerId][_newProp2];
        var _visualHandler2 = powerVisualHandlers[_newProp2];
        var tagCo = _newProp2 === "tags_co_power";

        if (_visualHandler2) {
          _visualHandler2(tagCo ? tagsInfo[playerId] : _playerInfo, newValue, tagCo);
        }

        if (!tagCo) {
          _playerInfo[_newProp2] = newValue;
        } else {
          tagsInfo[playerId][_newProp2] = newValue;
        }
      }
    }
  } //Only for Sensei


  if (unitAdd && unitAdd.units) {
    var _playerInfo2 = playersInfo[powerPId];
    var playerTeam = _playerInfo2.players_team;
    var countryCode = _playerInfo2.countries_code;

    if (viewerColors) {
      countryCode = viewerColors[powerPId] || countryCode;
    }

    var newUnits = unitAdd.units;
    var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(playerTeam); //Unit name is the same for every new unit
    //Infantry / Mech

    var unitName = unitAdd.unitName;
    newUnits.forEach(function (newUnit) {
      //Create a new copy of the generic unit object and add the missing properties
      var unitInfo = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(genericUnits[unitName]));

      for (var _newProp3 in newUnit) {
        unitInfo[_newProp3] = newUnit[_newProp3];
      }

      unitInfo.countries_code = countryCode;
      unitInfo.units_games_id = gameId;
      unitInfo.units_hit_points = 9;
      unitInfo.units_players_id = powerPId;
      createNewUnit(unitInfo, powerPId);
      updateUnitCount(powerPId, unitName, 1);

      if (gameFog === "Y" && isViewerTeam) {
        updateFog(unitInfo, unitInfo.units_vision, _playerInfo2, null, null, unitInfo.units_x, unitInfo.units_y);
      }
    });
    var unitCost = unitName === "Infantry" ? 900 : 2700;
    var addedValue = newUnits.length * unitCost;

    var _newValue = playersUnitCount[powerPId].value + addedValue;

    playersUnitCount[powerPId].value = _newValue;
    updatePlayerRow(powerPId, {
      "unit-value": _newValue
    });
  }

  if (weatherReplace) {
    changeWeather(weatherReplace.weatherCode);
  } //Discovered units for Sonja's powers & Sensei's new units


  if (discovered) {
    showDiscovered(discovered);
  }
} //Handler for Sasha's COP


function powerCopBarHandler(playerInfo, newValue) {
  var tagCo = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : false;
  var playerId = playerInfo.players_id;
  playerInfo.players_co_power = newValue;
  resetPowerBar(playerId, tagCo);
  updatePowerBar(playerId, playersInfo, tagCo);
}

function powerFundsHandler(playerInfo, newValue) {
  playerInfo.players_funds = newValue;
  updatePlayerRow(playerInfo.players_id, {
    "player-funds": newValue
  });
}

function powerHpHandler(unitInfo, newHp) {
  var unitId = unitInfo.units_id;
  var unitPId = unitInfo.units_players_id;
  var unitHp = unitInfo.units_hit_points;
  var addedHp = newHp - unitHp;
  updateHP(unitId, addedHp, true);
  var cm = findCostMultiplier(unitPId, true);
  var unitCount = playersUnitCount[unitPId];
  unitCount.value += unitInfo.units_cost * 0.1 * cm * addedHp;
  updatePlayerRow(unitPId, {
    "unit-value": unitCount.value
  });
}

function powerRefreshHandler(unitInfo, newValue) {
  var unitId = unitInfo && unitInfo.units_id;

  if (newValue === 0) {
    //Eagle
    unwaitUnit(unitId);
  } else if (newValue === -1) {
    //VB
    waitUnit(unitId); //Add stun icon

    var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
    var stunIcon = makeImage(unitSpan, true, "terrain/stun", "unit-licon");
    stunIcon.classList.add("stun-icon");
  }
}

function powerSupplyHandler(unitInfo) {
  var unitId = unitInfo.units_id;
  supply(unitId);
}

function powerVisionHandler(unitInfo, newVision) {
  if (gameFog !== "Y") return;
  var unitPId = unitInfo.units_players_id;
  var unitTeam = playersInfo[unitPId].players_team; //Only update the vision visual for the same team

  if (!hasTeamVision(unitTeam)) return;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[unitPId];
  var hiddenSkip = playerInfo.co_name === "Sonja" && playerInfo.players_co_power_on !== "N";
  var unitX = unitInfo.units_x;
  var unitY = unitInfo.units_y; //Add new vision then remove old one

  updateFog(unitInfo, newVision, playerInfo, null, null, unitX, unitY, hiddenSkip);
  updateFog(unitInfo, unitInfo.units_vision, playerInfo, unitX, unitY, undefined, undefined, false);
} //Ran after each CO power usage


function updateCopValues(playerId) {
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];

  if (playerInfo.players_co_max_spower < 0) {
    playerInfo.players_co_max_spower *= 1;
  }

  if (playerInfo.players_co_max_power < 0) {
    playerInfo.players_co_max_power *= 1;
  } //Find the number of stars and multiply by 1800 for each


  var copStarCount = playerInfo.co_max_power / 90000;
  var scopStarCount = playerInfo.co_max_spower / 90000;
  var newCopValue = Math.min(copStarCount * 270000, Math.abs(playerInfo.players_co_max_power) + copStarCount * 18000);
  var newScopValue = Math.min(scopStarCount * 270000, Math.abs(playerInfo.players_co_max_spower) + scopStarCount * 18000); //Update power bar hover text max values

  updateCopValuesDisplay(playerId, newCopValue, newScopValue);
}

function updateCopValuesDisplay(playerId, newCopValue, newScopValue) {
  if (gameCop === "N") return;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];

  if (playerInfo.players_co_max_power < 0) {
    playerInfo.players_co_max_power *= 1;
  }

  if (playerInfo.players_co_max_spower < 0) {
    playerInfo.players_co_max_spower *= 1;
  }

  var copValue = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .cop-max-value");
  var scopValue = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .scop-max-value");
  copValue.textContent = newCopValue / 10;
  scopValue.textContent = newScopValue / 10;
  playerInfo.players_co_max_power = newCopValue;
  playerInfo.players_co_max_spower = newScopValue;
}

function showDiscovered(discovered) {
  if (discovered.buildings) {
    discovered.buildings.forEach(discoverBuilding);
  }

  if (discovered.units) {
    discovered.units.forEach(discoverUnit);
  }
}

function discoverUnit(unit) {
  var unitId = unit.units_id; //When the game is over simply update the unit's z-index

  if (gameEndDate && unitsInfo[unitId]) {
    var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
    applyCSS(unitSpan, {
      "z-index": 110
    });
    return;
  }

  if (!unitsInfo[unitId] && unit.units_carried === "N") {
    var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
    var unitName = unit.units_name;
    createNewUnit(unit);
    updateUnitCount(unitPId, unitName, 1);
  }
}

function discoverBuilding(building) {
  var buildingX = building.buildings_x;
  var buildingY = building.buildings_y;
  var currentBuildingPId = buildingsInfo[buildingX][buildingY].buildings_players_id;
  var discoveredPId = building.buildings_players_id;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[discoveredPId];

  if (playerInfo) {
    ["countries_code", "countries_name"].forEach(function (prop) {
      return building[prop] = playerInfo[prop];
    });
    building["buildings_team"] = playerInfo.players_team;
  }

  var prevBuilding = buildingsInfo[buildingX][buildingY];
  buildingsInfo[buildingX][buildingY] = _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, prevBuilding), building);

  if (discoveredPId) {
    if (!playersBuildings[discoveredPId][buildingX]) {
      playersBuildings[discoveredPId][buildingX] = {};
    }

    playersBuildings[discoveredPId][buildingX][buildingY] = building.buildings_id;
  }

  if (currentBuildingPId != discoveredPId) {
    changeBuildingSprite(buildingsInfo[buildingX][buildingY]);

    if (gameFog === "Y") {
      //Put Building above Fog canvas
      changeBuildingZIndex(buildingX, buildingY, 110);
    }
  }

  updateBuildingCounts();
}

function resignHandler(resignRes) {
  eliminationHandler(resignRes);
}

function eliminatePlayer(eliminatedPId) {
  var eliminated = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : true;
  var player = playersInfo[eliminatedPId];
  var playerRow = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId);
  var playerUsername = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-username");
  var playerCountryLogo = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-country-logo");
  var playerOverview = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-overview-co");
  var playerOverviewInfo = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-overview-info");
  var playerTimer = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-timer");
  var playerCo = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-co img");
  var coName = player.co_name;
  var countryCode = player.countries_code;
  var classMethod = eliminated ? "add" : "remove"; //Update player box to eliminated

  playerRow.classList[classMethod]("player-overview-eliminated");
  playerOverview.classList[classMethod]("player-overview-eliminated-bg", "italic");
  playerOverviewInfo.classList[classMethod]("italic");
  playerCo.src = eliminated ? player.co_grayscale_image_path : player.co_image_path;
  ensureSpriteVersion(playerCo); //same for tag co

  if (tagsInfo && tagsInfo[eliminatedPId]) {
    var tagCoName = tagsInfo[eliminatedPId].co_name;
    var tagCo = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-tagco img");
    tagCo.src = eliminated ? tagsInfo[eliminatedPId].co_grayscale_image_path : tagsInfo[eliminatedPId].co_image_path;
    ensureSpriteVersion(tagCo);
  }

  playerCountryLogo.src = TP + (!eliminated ? "" : "gs_") + countryCode + "logo.gif";
  ensureSpriteVersion(playerCountryLogo);
  [playerUsername, playerTimer].forEach(function (el) {
    //playerTimer may not exist for older games
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList[classMethod]("striked");
  });
  updateEliminatedOverviewToggle();
} //Handler when a player is eliminated (Resign, by Capture, Rout, etc)


function eliminationHandler(eliminationRes) {
  var eliminatedPId = eliminationRes.playerId;
  var player = playersInfo[eliminatedPId];
  var playerRow = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId);
  var playerUsername = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-username");
  var playerCountryLogo = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-country-logo");
  var playerOverview = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-overview-co");
  var playerOverviewInfo = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-overview-info");
  var playerTimer = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-timer");
  var playerCo = document.querySelector("#player" + eliminatedPId + " .player-co img");
  var coName = player.co_name;
  var countryCode = player.countries_code; //Update player box to eliminated

  playerRow.classList.add("player-overview-eliminated");
  playerOverview.classList.add("player-overview-eliminated-bg", "italic");
  playerOverviewInfo.classList.add("italic");
  playerCo.src = player.co_grayscale_image_path;
  playerCountryLogo.src = TP + "gs_" + countryCode + "logo.gif";
  ensureSpriteVersion(playerCo);
  ensureSpriteVersion(playerCountryLogo);
  [playerUsername, playerTimer].forEach(function (el) {
    //playerTimer may not exist for older games
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.add("striked");
  });
  updateEliminatedOverviewToggle(); //Show Event screen for elimination

  var eliminationEvent = {
    username: player.users_username,
    co: coName,
    playerInfo: player,
    country: countryCode,
    text: eliminationRes.message
  };
  showEventScreen(eliminationEvent);
  player.players_eliminated = "Y"; //End Game handler when every opponent is eliminated

  if (eliminationRes.GameOver) {
    endGameHandler(eliminationRes.GameOver);
  } else if (eliminationRes.NextTurn) {
    endTurnHandler(eliminationRes.NextTurn);
  } //Remove eliminated player's units


  if (!eliminationRes.GameOver) {
    var playerUnits = playersUnits[eliminatedPId];
    var elimCountry = player.countries_name;
    var eliminatedTeam = player.players_team;
    var eliminatedByPId = eliminationRes.eliminatedByPId;
    var eliminatedByTeam = eliminatedByPId && playersInfo[eliminatedByPId].players_team;
    var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(eliminatedTeam);
    updatePlayerRow(eliminatedPId, {
      "player-income": 0
    });

    for (var unitId in playerUnits) {
      var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];

      if (unitInfo.units_carried !== "Y") {
        var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
        unitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(unitSpan);
      }

      if (gameFog === "Y" && isViewerTeam) {
        var unitX = unitInfo.units_x;
        var unitY = unitInfo.units_y;
        updateFog(unitInfo, unitInfo.units_vision, player, unitX, unitY);
      }

      deleteUnitInfo(unitInfo);
    } //Buildings change


    var playerBuildings = playersBuildings[eliminatedPId];

    for (var x in playerBuildings) {
      var _loop4 = function _loop4(y) {
        var buildingInfo = buildingsInfo[x][y];
        var newCountry = "Neutral";
        var newCountryCode = "";
        var propsToChange = ["terrain_name", "countries_code", "countries_name"];

        if (eliminatedByPId) {
          var playerInfo = playersInfo[eliminatedByPId];
          changeBuildingOwner(eliminatedPId, eliminatedByPId, buildingInfo);
          newCountry = playerInfo.countries_name;
          newCountryCode = playerInfo.countries_code;
          buildingInfo.buildings_players_id = eliminatedByPId;
          buildingInfo.buildings_team = playerInfo.players_team;
        } else {
          buildingInfo.buildings_players_id = null;
          buildingInfo.buildings_team = null;
        } //some of the player's buildings may still be called "Neutral ..."


        var countryRegex = new RegExp(elimCountry + "|Neutral");
        var newTerrainName = buildingInfo.terrain_name.replace(countryRegex, newCountry); //Replace HQ with a city

        if (/HQ/.test(newTerrainName)) {
          var buildingId = buildingInfo.buildings_id;
          var buildingSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + buildingId + "']");
          newTerrainName = newTerrainName.replace("HQ", "City");
          buildingInfo.terrain_defense = 3;
          applyCSS(buildingSpan, {
            top: parseInt(buildingSpan.style.top) + 9 + "px"
          });
        }

        var newValues = [newTerrainName, newCountryCode, newCountry];
        propsToChange.forEach(function (prop, i) {
          buildingInfo[prop] = newValues[i];
        });
        changeBuildingSprite(buildingInfo);
        /* if(buildingInfo.terrain_name.match(/HQ/)) console.log(buildingInfo); */

        if (gameFog === "Y") {
          var buildingX = buildingInfo.buildings_x;
          var buildingY = buildingInfo.buildings_y;

          if (eliminatedByPId && hasTeamVision(eliminatedByTeam)) {
            //Add vision of new buildings
            updateFog("Building", 0, playersInfo[getViewerPId()], null, null, buildingX, buildingY);
          } else if (hasTeamVision(eliminatedTeam)) {
            //Remove
            updateFog("Building", 0, playersInfo[getViewerPId()], buildingX, buildingY);
          }
        }
      };

      for (var y in playerBuildings[x]) {
        _loop4(y);
      }
    }
  }

  updateBuildingCounts();
} //Probably need a separate screen to display every winner's name & CO


function endGameHandler(endGameRes) {
  gameEndDate = endGameRes.gameEndDate;
  showEndGameScreen(endGameRes);
  freezeOngoingTimer();
}

function gameOverHandler() {
  if (freezeGame) return; // this is kind of a hack GameOver event should return this data but the whole callchain is a mess

  postData("api/game/fetch_game_viewer_data.php", {
    playersID: getViewerPId(),
    gameId: gameId
  }).then(function (res) {
    var gameOver = res.data.GameOver;
    gameOver.losers.forEach(function (loserId) {
      eliminatePlayer(loserId);
    });
    endGameHandler(gameOver);
  });
}

function setDrawHandler(drawData) {
  //Everyone has set draw
  if (drawData.GameOver) {
    return endGameHandler(drawData.GameOver);
  } //draw warning is not there for non players, end function


  if (!drawWarning) return; //Show the warning in the menu bar

  var displayWarning = drawData.displayWarning;
  animWarning(drawWarning, displayWarning); //Update warning text

  if (displayWarning && !setDraw) {
    drawWarningText.textContent = drawData.warningText;
  }
}

function pauseHandler(pauseRes) {
  var timerPaused = pauseRes.timerPaused; //Only update striked class when the condition on the client is the opposite

  if (timerPausedRef !== timerPaused) {
    var playerTimers = document.querySelectorAll(".player-timer");

    for (var _i13 = 0; _i13 < playerTimers.length; _i13++) {
      playerTimers[_i13].classList.toggle("striked");
    }

    gameHeaderTotalTime.classList.toggle("striked"); //Restart timers accordingly

    freezeOngoingTimer();
    var playerInfo = playersInfo[currentTurn];
    var newTurnStart = pauseRes.newTurnStart;

    if (newTurnStart) {
      playerInfo.players_turn_start = newTurnStart;
    }

    startPlayerTimer(currentTurn);
    pauseIcon.style.display = timerPaused ? "block" : "none"; //Reset client's reference

    pauseGame = !pauseGame;
  }

  timerPausedRef = timerPaused; //Skip the rest for non player viewers

  if (!getViewerPId()) return;
  var displayWarning = pauseRes.displayWarning;

  if (pauseWarningBtnText) {
    pauseWarningBtnText.textContent = pauseRes.warningBtnText;
  }

  animWarning(pauseWarning, displayWarning);

  if (displayWarning && !pauseGame) {
    pauseWarningText.textContent = pauseRes.warningText;
  }
}

function followHandler(followRes) {
  followCount.textContent = followRes.nFollows;
} //boot will be processed immediately by server, remove "ongoing timer"


function bootAETHandler(bootAETRes) {
  var playerId = bootAETRes.playerId;
  freezeOngoingTimer();
  var attempts = 8; // wait a sec for bootAET script to run

  setTimeout(pollBootAETStatus, 1000);

  function pollBootAETStatus() {
    postData("api/game/fetch_game_turn.php", "gameId=".concat(gameId)).then(function (res) {
      if (playerId != res.data) {
        handleBootAET();
      } else if (attempts--) {
        setTimeout(pollBootAETStatus, 1000);
      } else {
        throw new Error("Turn may have ended, try refreshing.");
      }
    })["catch"](handleError);
  }

  function handleBootAET() {
    // check if player ended turn before timer ran out
    // could happen if client has very spotty internet connection
    if (playerId != currentTurn) {
      return;
    } //get the game state after the boot or AET happened


    postData("api/game/fetch_game_viewer_data.php", {
      playersID: getViewerPId(),
      gameId: gameId
    }).then(function (res) {
      var state = res.data;
      var gameOver = res.data.GameOver;
      var game = state.game;

      if (gameOver) {
        showEndGameScreen(gameOver);
      } else {
        var nextPlayer = playersInfo[game.games_turn];
        var endTurnEvent = {
          username: "Day " + game.games_day,
          co: nextPlayer.co_name,
          playerInfo: nextPlayer,
          country: nextPlayer.countries_code,
          text: "It's now " + nextPlayer.users_username + "'s turn"
        };
        showEventScreen(endTurnEvent);
      }

      var nextTurnState = {
        buildingsInfo: state.buildings,
        currentTurnPId: game.games_turn,
        gameWeather: {
          code: game.games_weather_code
        },
        playersInfo: state.players,
        playersUnits: state.players_units,
        playersUnitCount: state.players_units_count,
        playersBuildings: state.players_buildings,
        tagsInfo: state.tags,
        unitsInfo: state.units,
        unitMap: state.unit_map,
        fogInfo: state.fog_array
      };
      updateGameState(nextTurnState);

      if (game.games_end_date) {
        gameEndDate = game.games_end_date;
      } else {
        //Update Game Header information
        gameHeaderDay.textContent = "Day " + game.games_day; //Update button display

        currentTurn = game.games_turn;
        var btnsDisplay = currentTurn === getViewerPId() ? "flex" : "none";
        var buttons = [endTurnBtn, nextUnitBtn, tagCOBtn];

        if (Object.keys(playersInfo).length != 2) {
          buttons.push(resignGameBtn);
        }

        changeButtonsDisplay(buttons, btnsDisplay);
        toggleCopButtons();
        currentTimer = playersInfo[game.games_turn].players_turn_clock;
        startPlayerTimer(game.games_turn); // maybe we are hotseating this player

        if (allViewerPId.length > 1 && allViewerPId.includes(currentTurn)) {
          swapActiveVision(currentTurn);
        }

        maybeUpdateActiveVisionTeam(currentTurn, playersInfo[currentTurn].players_team);
      }
    })["catch"](catchError);
  }
}

function endTurnHandler(endTurnRes) {
  freezeOngoingTimer(); //Select rows from the players table

  var currentPlayerRow = document.querySelector("#player" + currentTurn);
  var nextPId = endTurnRes.nextPId;
  var nextPlayer = playersInfo[nextPId];
  var nextPlayerPower = nextPlayer.players_co_power_on;
  var nextPlayerRow = document.querySelector("#player" + nextPId);
  var currentTurnArrow = document.querySelector(".current-turn-arrow"); //Refresh units of player whose turn has just ended

  var currentPlayerUnits = playersUnits[currentTurn];

  for (var unitId in currentPlayerUnits) {
    unwaitUnit(unitId);
  }

  if (endTurnRes.swapCos) {
    var currentPlayer = playersInfo[currentTurn];
    var swapEvent = {
      username: "CO Swap",
      co: currentPlayer.co_name,
      playerInfo: currentPlayer,
      tagCo: tagsInfo[currentTurn].co_name,
      tagsInfo: tagsInfo[currentTurn],
      swapCos: true,
      country: currentPlayer.countries_code,
      text: currentPlayer.users_username + " swapped " + "COs!"
    };
    swapCos(currentTurn);
    showEventScreen(swapEvent);
  } //change unit movement speed for no animations(always show when it's not the viewer's turn)


  movementSpeed = areAnimationsOn(nextPId) ? 200 : 0; // For hotseat just re-enable the draw button for the next player blindy :d

  if (allViewerPId.length > 1 && setDrawBtn) {
    setDraw = true;
    setDrawBtn.querySelector(".small_text").textContent = "Set Draw";
  }

  currentTurn = nextPId; //Show End turn & Next unit buttons on viewer's turn

  var btnsDisplay = currentTurn === getViewerPId() ? "flex" : "none";
  var buttons = [endTurnBtn, nextUnitBtn, tagCOBtn];

  if (Object.keys(playersInfo).length != 2) {
    buttons.push(resignGameBtn);
  }

  changeButtonsDisplay(buttons, btnsDisplay);
  toggleCopButtons();
  toggleClickableClass(nextPId, false);

  if (currentTurn === getViewerPId()) {
    unitSelectorRef = selectNextUnit(unitSelectorRef.index + 1, 1, false);
  } //Show event screen for next player


  var endTurnEvent = {
    username: "Day " + endTurnRes.day,
    co: nextPlayer.co_name,
    playerInfo: nextPlayer,
    country: nextPlayer.countries_code,
    text: "It's now " + nextPlayer.users_username + "'s turn"
  };

  if (tagsInfo.count < 1) {
    endTurnEvent.tagCo = tagsInfo[currentTurn].co_name;
    endTurnEvent.tagsInfo = tagsInfo[currentTurn];
  } //Set proper colors for the country in the menu then show event


  showEventScreen(endTurnEvent);

  if (allViewerPId.length > 1 && allViewerPId.includes(currentTurn) && !freezeGame) {
    swapActiveVision(currentTurn);
  }

  maybeUpdateActiveVisionTeam(currentTurn, playersInfo[currentTurn].players_team); //Remove bonuses from next player's units if power is on

  if (nextPlayerPower !== "N") {
    var _nextPlayerUnits = playersUnits[nextPId];

    for (var _unitId2 in _nextPlayerUnits) {
      var unit = unitsInfo[_unitId2];
      addBonus(unit, nextPId, nextPlayerPower, true);
    }

    nextPlayerPower = "N";
    playersInfo[nextPId].players_co_power_on = "N"; //Hide power text & show bar again

    updateRowPower(nextPId, nextPlayerPower, "visible", "hidden");
  } //Update weather


  var nextWeather = endTurnRes.nextWeather;

  if (gameWeather.code !== nextWeather) {
    changeWeather(nextWeather);
  } //Repair units on buildings
  //Update HP, Ammo, Fuel, and Units total value in the player info table


  var repairedUnits = endTurnRes.repaired;
  var suppliedUnits = endTurnRes.supplied || [];
  var cm = findCostMultiplier(nextPId, true);

  if (repairedUnits && repairedUnits.length !== 0) {
    repairedUnits.forEach(function (repairedUnit) {
      var unitId = repairedUnit.units_id;
      if (!unitsInfo[unitId]) return;
      var unitPId = unitsInfo[unitId].units_players_id;
      var hpHealed = repairedUnit.units_hit_points - unitsInfo[unitId].units_hit_points;
      var unitCost = unitsInfo[unitId].units_cost;
      var newTotalValue = playersUnitCount[unitPId].value + hpHealed * cm * unitCost / 10;
      playersUnitCount[unitPId].value = newTotalValue;
      updateHP(unitId, hpHealed);
      updatePlayerRow(unitPId, {
        "unit-value": newTotalValue
      });
      if (suppliedUnits.includes(unitId)) return;
      suppliedUnits.push(unitId);
    });
  } //Supplied units animations


  if (suppliedUnits && suppliedUnits.length !== 0) {
    suppliedUnits.forEach(function (unitId, unitIndex) {
      supply(unitId, unitIndex);
    });
  }
  /* function loopSupplied(index = 0) {
    const unitId = suppliedUnits[index];
    if(!unitId) return;
     supply(unitId);
     setTimeout(function() {
      loopSupplied(index + 1);
    }, 525)
  } */
  //Delete out of fuel Air and Naval units


  var nextPlayerUnits = playersUnits[nextPId];

  for (var _unitId3 in nextPlayerUnits) {
    var unitInfo = unitsInfo[_unitId3];
    var mType = unitInfo.units_movement_type;
    var unitFuel = unitInfo.units_fuel;

    if (unitFuel <= 0 && (mType === "A" || mType === "S" || mType === "L")) {
      var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + _unitId3 + "']");
      unitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(unitSpan);
      animExplosion(unitInfo);
      deleteUnitInfo(unitInfo);

      if (gameFog === "Y") {
        var unitX = unitInfo.units_x;
        var unitY = unitInfo.units_y;
        var playerInfo = playersInfo[unitInfo.units_players_id];
        var unitTeam = playerInfo.players_team;

        if (hasTeamVision(unitTeam)) {
          var unitVision = unitInfo.units_vision;
          updateFog(unitInfo, unitVision, playerInfo, unitX, unitY, undefined, undefined, undefined);
        } else {
          var neighbours = loopNeighbours(unitX, unitY);
          updateAirUnitFogOnMove(unitX, unitY, mType, neighbours, true, "Remove");
        }
      }
    }
  } //Add / remove the blue background class for current turn


  var currentPlayerRowCo = currentPlayerRow.querySelector(".player-overview-co");
  var nextPlayerRowCo = nextPlayerRow.querySelector(".player-overview-co");
  currentPlayerRowCo.classList.remove("player-overview-current-turn-bg");
  nextPlayerRowCo.classList.add("player-overview-current-turn-bg"); //Append the current turn arrow to the new player

  var nextPlayerHeader = nextPlayerRow.querySelector("header");
  nextPlayerHeader.appendChild(currentTurnArrow); //New timer & new funds

  var nextSeconds = parseInt(endTurnRes.nextTimer);
  playersInfo[nextPId].players_turn_clock = nextSeconds;
  playersInfo[nextPId].players_turn_start = endTurnRes.nextTurnStart;
  currentTimer = nextSeconds; //Update table's values

  var newTableValues = {
    "player-funds": endTurnRes.nextFunds
  };
  updatePlayerRow(nextPId, newTableValues); //Update Game Header information

  gameHeaderDay.textContent = "Day " + endTurnRes.day;
  gameDay = endTurnRes.day;
  gameTurn++;
  startPlayerTimer(nextPId);
}

function formatTimer(totalSeconds) {
  var header = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;
  var nextDays = Math.floor(totalSeconds / (3600 * 24));
  if (nextDays !== 0 && nextDays < 10) nextDays = "0" + nextDays;
  totalSeconds -= nextDays * 3600 * 24;
  var nextHours = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
  if (nextHours < 10) nextHours = "0" + nextHours;
  totalSeconds -= nextHours * 3600;
  var nextMinutes = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
  if (nextMinutes < 10) nextMinutes = "0" + nextMinutes;
  totalSeconds -= nextMinutes * 60;
  var nextTimer = "";

  if (nextDays !== 0) {
    nextTimer += !header ? nextDays + ":" : nextDays + "d ";
  }

  nextTimer += !header ? nextHours + ":" : nextHours + "h ";
  nextTimer += !header ? nextMinutes : nextMinutes + "m"; //No days left, add seconds

  if (nextDays === 0) {
    //totalSeconds only has 0-60 seconds left
    var nextSeconds = totalSeconds;
    if (nextSeconds < 10) nextSeconds = "0" + nextSeconds;
    nextTimer += !header ? ":" + nextSeconds : nextSeconds + "s";
  }

  return nextTimer;
}

function startPlayerTimer(playerId) {
  var playerTimer = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-timer");
  freezeOngoingTimer();
  if (freezeGame) return;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
  getServerTimeOffset.then(function (timeOffset) {
    // Try ISO 8601 Date format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ if this breaks again
    var webkitFix = playerInfo.players_turn_start.replace(/-/g, "/");
    var turnStartClient = new Date(webkitFix + " " + serverTimezone).getTime();
    var turnStart = Math.round((turnStartClient - timeOffset) / 1000);
    var turnClock = playerInfo.players_turn_clock;
    ongoingTimer = setInterval(function () {
      var now = Math.round(Date.now() / 1000);

      if (timerPausedRef) {
        var maxPauseTime = Math.max(60 * 60 * 24 * 7, maxTurn);
        remainingTurnTime = Math.max(0, turnStart + maxPauseTime - now);
      } else {
        var maxTurnTime = Math.max(0, maxTurn - (now - turnStart));
        currentTimer = Math.max(0, turnStart + turnClock - now);
        remainingTurnTime = Math.min(currentTimer, maxTurnTime);
      }

      updateTimer(remainingTurnTime, gameHeaderTurnTime);
      updateTimer(currentTimer, gameHeaderTotalTime, playerTimer);

      if (currentTimer <= 0 || remainingTurnTime <= 0) {
        if (gameEndDate) {
          freezeOngoingTimer();
          return;
        }

        var bootAETEvent = {
          action: "BootAET",
          playerId: playerId
        };
        bootAETHandler(bootAETEvent);
      }
    }, 1000);

    function updateTimer(seconds, headerTimer, playerTimer) {
      var newHeaderTimer = formatTimer(seconds, true);
      headerTimer.textContent = newHeaderTimer;

      if (playerTimer) {
        var newTimer = formatTimer(seconds);
        playerTimer.textContent = newTimer;
      }
    }
  });
}

function freezeOngoingTimer() {
  clearInterval(ongoingTimer);
  ongoingTimer = false;
  gameHeaderTurnTime.classList.remove("error-red", "bold");
}

function updateLastUpdatedDate() {
  var now = new Date();
  var month = now.getMonth() + 1;
  if (month < 10) month = "0" + month;
  var day = now.getDate();
  if (day < 10) day = "0" + day;
  var year = now.getFullYear();
  var formatedDate = month + "/" + day + "/" + year;
  gameHeaderLastUpdated.textContent = formatedDate;
  return Math.ceil(now.getTime() / 1000);
} //Add or remove buttons when it's the viewer's turn or not


function changeButtonsDisplay(buttons, display) {
  //don't change display for games that are over
  if (gameEndDate) return;
  buttons.forEach(function (button) {
    if (!button) return;
    button.style.display = display;
  });
} //Rename this function to be a bit more descriptive
//Also serves to remove unit fuel on turn's beginning to avoid looping units
//a second time


function toggleClickableClass(playerId, endTurn) {
  //Units
  var playerUnits = playersUnits[playerId];

  for (var unitId in playerUnits) {
    if (playerId === getViewerPId()) {
      var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
      if (!unitSpan) continue;
      unitSpan.classList.toggle("clickable");
