    } //Remove fuel for air & naval units at the beginning of the turn only


    if (!endTurn) {
      var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];
      var fuelCost = findTurnFuelCost(unitId);
      unitInfo.units_fuel -= fuelCost; //Append low fuel icon

      checkLowProp(unitId, null, "units_fuel", "anifuel");
    }
  } //Buildings


  if (playerId === getViewerPId()) {
    var playerBuildings = playersBuildings[playerId];
    var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
    var coName = playerInfo.co_name;
    var scopOn = playerInfo.players_co_power_on === "S";

    for (var x in playerBuildings) {
      for (var y in playerBuildings[x]) {
        var building = buildingsInfo[x][y];
        var buildingId = building.buildings_id;
        var buildingName = building.terrain_name;
        var buildingSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + buildingId + "']"); //"clickable" class on production facilities only

        if (/Base|Airport|Port/.test(buildingName) || coName === "Hachi" && scopOn && /City/.test(buildingName)) {
          buildingSpan.classList.toggle("clickable");
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function findTurnFuelCost(unitId) {
  var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];
  var mType = unitInfo.units_movement_type;
  var unitHidden = unitInfo.units_sub_dive !== "N";
  var coName = playersInfo[unitInfo.units_players_id].co_name;
  var fuelCost = unitInfo.units_fuel_per_turn;

  if (unitHidden) {
    fuelCost += 3;
  }

  if (mType === "A" && coName === "Eagle") {
    fuelCost -= 2;
  }

  return fuelCost;
} //Swap both CO pictures & power bars for a given player in the player info box


function swapCos(playerId) {
  swapCosDisplay(playerId);
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];

  if (playerInfo.players_co_max_power < 0) {
    playerInfo.players_co_max_power *= 1;
  }

  if (playerInfo.players_co_max_spower < 0) {
    playerInfo.players_co_max_spower *= 1;
  }

  var tagInfo = tagsInfo[playerId];
  var mainCoName = playerInfo.co_name;
  var tagCoName = tagInfo.co_name;

  if (mainCoName === "Sonja" || tagCoName === "Sonja") {
    handleSonjaOnTag(playerId, mainCoName, tagCoName);
  } //Only swap relevant properties in players/tags Info


  var propsToChange = ["co_name", "co_max_power", "co_max_spower", "players_co_id", "players_co_image", "players_co_power", "players_co_max_power", "players_co_max_spower"];
  propsToChange.forEach(function (prop) {
    var mainProp = playerInfo[prop];
    var tagProp = tagInfo[prop];
    playerInfo[prop] = tagProp;
    tagInfo[prop] = mainProp;
  });
}

function swapCosDisplay(playerId) {
  var main = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-co-container");
  var tag = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-tagco-container"); //the entire power bar elements containing the text and values as well

  var mainBar = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .main-co-bar");
  var tagBar = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .tag-co-bar");
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
  var coPower = playerInfo.players_co_power_on; //Remove the colored background & text for the power and show bar again

  if (coPower !== "N") {
    var copText = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .cop-on-text");
    var bgClass = coPower === "Y" ? "cop-on-bg" : "scop-on-bg";
    var textClass = coPower === "Y" ? "co-bar-power-cop" : "co-bar-power-scop";
    main.classList.toggle(bgClass);
    copText.classList.toggle(textClass);
    copText.style.visibility = "hidden"; //the power bar element itself that is hidden

    mainBar.querySelector(".power-bar").style.visibility = "visible";
  } // Switch images first so we keep the right order


  var mainCoImg = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-co img");
  var tagCoImg = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-tagco img");
  changeCoImageClass(tagCoImg, "co_portrait", "co_portrait_small");
  changeCoImageClass(mainCoImg, "co_portrait_small", "co_portrait");
  var mainCo = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-co");
  var tagCo = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-tagco");
  changeCoImageClass(tagCo, "player-co", "player-tagco");
  changeCoImageClass(mainCo, "player-tagco", "player-co");
  var tempTag = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-tagco-container").innerHTML;
  var tempBar = tagBar.innerHTML;
  var mainButtons = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-overview-bar > .power-buttons:not(.power-buttons-tag)");
  var tagButtons = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-overview-bar > .power-buttons-tag");
  var tempButtons = tagButtons.innerHTML;
  var activityStatus = main.querySelector(".player-activity-status");
  var activityStatusClone = activityStatus ? activityStatus.cloneNode(true) : null;
  tag.innerHTML = main.innerHTML;
  main.innerHTML = tempTag;
  tagBar.innerHTML = mainBar.innerHTML;
  mainBar.innerHTML = tempBar;
  tagButtons.innerHTML = mainButtons.innerHTML;
  mainButtons.innerHTML = tempButtons;
  var tagActivityStatus = tag.querySelector(".player-activity-status");

  if (tagActivityStatus) {
    tagActivityStatus.remove();
  }

  if (activityStatusClone) {
    main.prepend(activityStatusClone);
  }

  function changeCoImageClass(el, add, remove) {
    el.classList.add(add);
    el.classList.remove(remove);
  }
}

function handleSonjaOnTag(playerId, mainCo, tagCo) {
  var playerTeam = playersInfo[playerId].players_team;
  var data = {
    playersID: getViewerPId() || activeVision.playerID,
    objects: ["units"]
  }; //Update Fog visual for team units when Sonja tags in / out

  if (gameFog === "Y" && hasTeamVision(playerTeam)) {
    var playerUnits = playersUnits[playerId];
    var copOn = playersInfo[playerId].players_co_power_on !== "N";
    var visionChange;

    if (mainCo === "Sonja" && tagCo !== "Sonja") {
      visionChange = -1;
    } else if (mainCo === "Sonja" && tagCo === "Sonja") {
      visionChange = 0;
    } else {
      visionChange = 1;
    } //Decrement vision change for active CO power


    if (copOn && mainCo === "Sonja") visionChange--;

    for (var unitId in playerUnits) {
      var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
      var unitVision = unit.units_vision;
      var newVision = unit.units_vision + visionChange;
      var unitX = unit.units_x;
      var unitY = unit.units_y; //Add new vision then remove old one

      updateFog(unit, newVision, tagsInfo[playerId], null, null, unitX, unitY);
      updateFog(unit, unitVision, playersInfo[playerId], unitX, unitY, undefined, undefined, copOn && mainCo === "Sonja");
      unit.units_vision += visionChange;
    }

    if (mainCo !== "Sonja" && tagCo === "Sonja") {
      data.objects = ["units", "buildings"];
      postData("api/game/fetch_game_viewer_data.php", data).then(function (res) {
        var data = res.data;

        if (data.err) {
          return handleError(data);
        }

        addDiscoveredObjects(data);
      })["catch"](catchError);
    }
  } //Skip the rest if viewer is in the same team


  if (hasTeamVision(playerTeam)) return; //Request new unitsInfo from server to add HP to each unit for opponents' units

  if (mainCo === "Sonja" && tagCo !== "Sonja") {
    postData("api/game/fetch_game_viewer_data.php", data).then(function (res) {
      var data = res.data;

      if (data.err) {
        return handleError(data);
      }

      var newUnitsInfo = data.units;

      for (var _unitId4 in newUnitsInfo) {
        var newHp = newUnitsInfo[_unitId4].units_hit_points;
        var unitInfo = unitsInfo[_unitId4];
        unitInfo.units_hit_points = newHp;
        updateHP(_unitId4, 0);
      }
    })["catch"](catchError);
  } //Change all units HP to ?
  else if (mainCo !== "Sonja" && tagCo === "Sonja") {
    var _playerUnits2 = playersUnits[playerId];

    for (var _unitId5 in _playerUnits2) {
      var _unit = unitsInfo[_unitId5];
      _unit.units_hit_points = "?";
      updateHP(_unitId5, 0);
    }
  }
}

function changeWeather(newWeatherCode) {
  //Change map background to new weather
  var weather = {
    C: "clear",
    S: "snow",
    R: "rain"
  };
  var weatherName = weather[newWeatherCode];
  var currentWeather = gameWeather.code;
  mapRenderer.setWeather(weatherName);

  if (customMap) {
    map.src = "maps/" + newWeatherCode + mapId + ".png";
    ensureSpriteVersion(map);
  }

  var viewerTeam = getViewerPId() ? playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team : null;

  if ((currentWeather === "S" || currentWeather === "R") && currentWeather !== newWeatherCode) {
    cancelWeather();
  } //Rain vision updates


  if (currentWeather !== "R" && newWeatherCode === "R") {
    if (gameFog === "Y") {
      updateWeatherVision(viewerTeam, -1);
    }

    cancelWeather = animRain(weatherCanvas, maxX, maxY);
  } else if (currentWeather === "R" && newWeatherCode !== "R") {
    if (gameFog === "Y") {
      updateWeatherVision(viewerTeam, 1);
    }
  } //Snow weather


  if (currentWeather !== "S" && newWeatherCode === "S") {
    cancelWeather = animSnow(weatherCanvas, maxX, maxY);
  }

  gameWeather.code = newWeatherCode;
  gameWeather.name = weatherName; //Change buildings to new weather

  for (var x in buildingsInfo) {
    for (var y in buildingsInfo[x]) {
      changeBuildingSprite(buildingsInfo[x][y]);
    }
  }
}

function updateWeatherVision(viewerTeam, increment) {
  for (var playerId in playersInfo) {
    var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
    var playerTeam = playerInfo.players_team; //Loop units that are in the viewer's team

    if (hasTeamVision(playerTeam)) {
      var playerUnits = playersUnits[playerId];

      for (var unitId in playerUnits) {
        var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];
        var unitX = unitInfo.units_x;
        var unitY = unitInfo.units_y;
        var unitVision = unitInfo.units_vision; //Add new vision
        //Need to be this order otherwise all of the player's vision will be gone
        //for a brief moment and every unit will dissapear

        var newVision = unitVision + increment;
        if (newVision === 0) newVision = 1;
        updateFog(unitInfo, newVision, playerInfo, null, null, unitX, unitY);
        updateFog(unitInfo, unitVision, playerInfo, unitX, unitY);
        unitInfo.units_vision = newVision;
      }
    }
  }

  if (increment !== 1) return; //Weather is going from rain to clear, fetch new unitsInfo & buildingsInfo from server

  var data = {
    playersID: getViewerPId(),
    objects: ["units", "buildings"]
  };
  postData("api/game/fetch_game_viewer_data.php", data).then(function (res) {
    var data = res.data;

    if (data.err) {
      return handleError(data);
    }

    addDiscoveredObjects(data);
  })["catch"](catchError);
} //Handle response from fetch_game_viewer_data.php


function addDiscoveredObjects(data) {
  //Loop new unitsInfo & buildingsInfo and add what's missing
  var newUnitsInfo = data.units;

  for (var unitId in newUnitsInfo) {
    if (unitsInfo[unitId]) continue;
    var unit = newUnitsInfo[unitId];
    discoverUnit(unit);
  }

  var newBuildingsInfo = data.buildings;

  for (var x in newBuildingsInfo) {
    for (var y in newBuildingsInfo[x]) {
      var building = newBuildingsInfo[x][y];
      discoverBuilding(building);
    }
  }
} //Player row values given in an object: player-timer, player-funds, unit-count-total, unit-value


function updatePlayerRow(playerId, newValues) {
  var performTeamCheck = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : true;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
  var updatedPTeam = playerInfo.players_team; // If hotseating, force info updates to hide funds/unit value/etc

  var isHotseat = allViewerPId.length > 1;
  var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(updatedPTeam) || isHotseat;
  var coName = playerInfo.co_name;

  for (var value in newValues) {
    //Skip every value except the player timer when the player is not in the viewer's team
    if (performTeamCheck) {
      if (gameFog === "N" && coName === "Sonja" && value === "unit-value" && !isViewerTeam) continue;
      if (gameFog === "Y" && value !== "player-timer" && !isViewerTeam) continue;
    } //For player funds also update the playerInfo object


    if (value === "player-funds") {
      if (isHotseat && !newValues[value]) {
        newValues[value] = hasTeamVision(updatedPTeam) ? "0" : "?";
      }

      playerInfo.players_funds = newValues[value];
    }

    var element = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " ." + value);
    if (!element) continue;
    element.textContent = newValues[value];
  }
}

function updateRowPower(playerId, coPower, barVisibility, textVisibility) {
  if (gameCop === "N") return;
  var mainBar = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .main-co-bar");
  if (!mainBar) return;
  var copTextContainer = mainBar.querySelector(".cop-on-text");
  var coImage = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-co-container");
  var powerBar = mainBar.querySelector(".power-bar");
  var bgClass;
  var copText;
  var copTextClass;

  if (coPower === "Y") {
    bgClass = "cop-on-bg";
    copText = "POWER";
    copTextClass = "co-bar-power-cop";
  } else {
    bgClass = "scop-on-bg";
    copText = "SUPER";
    copTextClass = "co-bar-power-scop";
  }

  if (coPower !== "N") {
    coImage.classList.add(bgClass);
    copTextContainer.classList.add(copTextClass);
  } else {
    coImage.classList.remove("cop-on-bg", "scop-on-bg");
    copTextContainer.classList.remove("co-bar-power-cop", "co-bar-power-scop");
  }

  copTextContainer.textContent = copText;
  copTextContainer.style.visibility = textVisibility;
  powerBar.style.visibility = barVisibility; //Check for COP button when the power ends for the viewer

  if (coPower === "N") {
    toggleCopButtons();
  }
}

function findHpGain(unit, hpGain) {
  var unitHp = unit.units_hit_points;
  var newHp = unitHp + hpGain;

  if (newHp > 10) {
    hpGain = 10 - unitHp;
  } else if (newHp < 1) {
    hpGain = 1 + hpGain;
  }

  return hpGain;
} //unkillable is when a power, a black bomb or a silo is used to lower HP


function updateHP(unitId, addedHp) {
  var unkillable = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : false;
  var unitDead = arguments.length > 3 && arguments[3] !== undefined ? arguments[3] : false;
  var unit = unitsInfo[unitId]; //Skip carried units

  var carried = unit.units_carried === "Y";
  if (carried) return;
  var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "']");
  var hpSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .unit-ricon");
  var unitHp = unit.units_hit_points;
  var newHp = unitHp !== "?" ? unitHp += addedHp : "qhp";
  if (newHp !== "qhp" && newHp > 10) newHp = 10; //Not a CO power, delete unit at 0 HP

  if (!unkillable && (newHp <= 0 || unitDead)) {
    deleteUnitInfo(unit);
    unitSpan.parentElement.removeChild(unitSpan);
    return;
  } //CO power, Black bomb or Silo was used, unit remains at 1 HP


  if (unkillable && newHp <= 0 && unitHp !== "?") {
    newHp = 1;
  } // https://stackoverflow.com/questions/19126185/setting-an-image-src-to-empty
  // 1px transparent image for 10hp units to stop "10.gif not found" requests and errors in console


  if (newHp === 10) hpSpan.src = "data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7";else {
    hpSpan.src = TP + newHp + ".gif";
  }
  unit.units_hit_points = unitHp !== "?" ? newHp : "?";
  if (newHp < 10 || newHp === "qhp") hpSpan.style.display = "block";else hpSpan.style.display = "none";
} //Create a clickable option for different menus


function createOption(option, image) {
  var li = document.createElement("li");
  li.classList.add("menu-option");

  if (image) {
    li.appendChild(image);
  } else {
    var icon = new Image();
    icon.setAttribute("draggable", false);
    icon.src = findMenuIcon(option);
    ensureSpriteVersion(icon);
    li.appendChild(icon);
  }

  li.innerHTML += option;
  return li;
} //PlayersInfo is playersInfo / tagsInfo


function updatePowerBar(playerId, playersInfo) {
  var tag = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : false;
  //Skip for no COP games
  if (gameCop !== "Y") return;

  if (playersInfo[playerId].players_co_max_power < 0) {
    playersInfo[playerId].players_co_max_power = playersInfo[playerId].players_co_max_power * -1;
  }

  if (playersInfo[playerId].players_co_max_spower < 0) {
    playersInfo[playerId].players_co_max_spower = playersInfo[playerId].players_co_max_spower * -1;
  }

  var newCopValue = playersInfo[playerId].players_co_power;
  var starValue = findStarValue(playerId, tag ? tagsInfo : playersInfo);
  var bar = !tag ? " .main-co-bar" : " .tag-co-bar";
  var powerStars = document.querySelectorAll("#player" + playerId + bar + " .power-star");
  var copStars = document.querySelectorAll("#player" + playerId + bar + " .cop-star").length - 1;
  var copFunds = Math.abs(playersInfo[playerId].players_co_max_power) / 10;
  var scopFunds = Math.abs(playersInfo[playerId].players_co_max_spower) / 10;
  var currentFunds = newCopValue / 10;
  var copPercent = currentFunds * 100 / copFunds;
  var scopPercent = currentFunds * 100 / scopFunds; //Update power values in power info box

  var copValue = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " " + bar + " .cop-value");
  var scopValue = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " " + bar + " .scop-value");
  copValue.textContent = currentFunds > copFunds ? copFunds : currentFunds;
  scopValue.textContent = currentFunds > scopFunds ? scopFunds : currentFunds;
  var starIndex = 0;

  if (scopPercent >= 100) {
    //Remove the COP animation and readd it at the same time as SCOP so it's synced
    for (var _i14 = 0; _i14 < copStars.length; _i14++) {
      copStars[_i14].classList.remove("anim-power-bar");
    }
  } //Small delay to make sure the animation class is removed when it should be before
  //being readded


  setTimeout(function () {
    //Fill the completed stars
    while (currentFunds >= starValue) {
      if (starIndex >= powerStars.length) return;
      var starWidth = powerStars.length > 6 ? 115 : 110;
      var starPercent = powerStars[starIndex].children[0];
      starPercent.style.width = starWidth + "%";
      currentFunds -= starValue; //Add animation class

      if (areAnimationsOn()) {
        if (starIndex <= copStars && copPercent >= 100) {
          powerStars[starIndex].classList.add("anim-power-bar");
        } else if (starIndex > copStars && scopPercent >= 100) {
          powerStars[starIndex].classList.add("anim-power-bar");
        }
      }

      starIndex++;
    } //Fill the last uncompleted star


    if (currentFunds > 0 && currentFunds <= starValue) {
      if (starIndex >= powerStars.length) return;

      var _starWidth = currentFunds * 100 / starValue;

      var _starPercent = powerStars[starIndex].children[0];
      _starPercent.style.width = _starWidth + "%";
    }
  }, 10);
  toggleCopButtons();
}

function resetPowerBar(playerId) {
  var tag = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;
  var bar = !tag ? " .main-co-bar" : " .tag-co-bar";
  var powerStars = document.querySelectorAll("#player" + playerId + bar + " .power-star");

  for (var _i15 = 0; _i15 < powerStars.length; _i15++) {
    var percent = powerStars[_i15].children[0];

    powerStars[_i15].classList.remove("anim-power-bar");

    percent.style.width = 0;
  }
}

function toggleCopButtons() {
  for (var playerId in playersInfo) {
    updateMainPowerButtons(parseInt(playerId, 10));
  }
}

function getMainPowerButton(playerId, powerType) {
  return document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .player-overview-bar > .power-buttons:not(.power-buttons-tag) ." + powerType + "-button");
}

function setPowerButtonState(button, available, clickable) {
  if (!button) return;
  button.classList.toggle("power-button-disabled", !available);
  button.classList.toggle("power-button-locked", available && !clickable);
  button.setAttribute("aria-disabled", clickable ? "false" : "true");
  button.dataset.powerAvailable = available ? "true" : "false";
  button.dataset.powerClickable = clickable ? "true" : "false";
}

function updateMainPowerButtons(playerId) {
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
  if (!playerInfo) return;
  var controlledPlayer = allViewerPId.some(function (viewerId) {
    return parseInt(viewerId, 10) === playerId;
  });
  var canClick = controlledPlayer && currentTurn === playerId && !freezeGame;
  var copDisabled = playerInfo.players_co_max_power < 0;
  var scopDisabled = playerInfo.players_co_max_spower < 0;
  var copValue = Math.abs(playerInfo.players_co_max_power);
  var scopValue = Math.abs(playerInfo.players_co_max_spower);
  var currentValue = playerInfo.players_co_power;
  var coPower = playerInfo.players_co_power_on;
  var coName = playerInfo.co_name;
  var copAvailable = coName !== "Von Bolt" && !copDisabled && currentValue >= copValue && coPower === "N";
  var scopAvailable = !scopDisabled && currentValue >= scopValue && coPower === "N";
  setPowerButtonState(getMainPowerButton(playerId, "cop"), copAvailable, copAvailable && canClick);
  setPowerButtonState(getMainPowerButton(playerId, "scop"), scopAvailable, scopAvailable && canClick);
} //Function to find the proper icons when the unit menu opens


function findMenuIcon(option) {
  var icons = {
    Wait: "terrain/wait.gif",
    Join: "terrain/join.gif",
    Fire: "terrain/fire.gif",
    Launch: "terrain/fire.gif",
    "Fire Silo": "terrain/fire.gif",
    Explode: "terrain/fire.gif",
    Capt: "terrain/capt_icon.gif",
    Load: "terrain/makeprivate.gif",
    Unload: "terrain/unload.gif",
    Repair: "terrain/repair.gif",
    Supply: "terrain/resupply.gif",
    Delete: "terrain/delete.gif",
    Unhide: "terrain/riseunhide.gif",
    Hide: "terrain/divehide.gif",
    Appear: "terrain/divehide.gif"
  };
  return icons[option];
} //Select the available options when clicking on a movement tile


function checkTargetTile(x, y) {
  var currentUnit = currentClick.info;
  var optionsDisplay = [];
  var currentCargo = currentUnit.units_cargo1_units_id || currentUnit.units_cargo2_units_id ? true : false;

  if (unitMap[x] && unitMap[x][y] && currentUnit.units_id !== unitMap[x][y].units_id) {
    var targetUnitId = unitMap[x][y].units_id;
    var targetUnit = unitsInfo[targetUnitId];
    var targetName = targetUnit.units_name; //Load option

    var canLoad = checkCargo(targetUnit, currentUnit);
    var targetCargo = targetUnit.units_cargo1_units_id || targetUnit.units_cargo2_units_id ? true : false;

    if (canLoad) {
      var loadOption = {
        option: "Load",
        clickable: true
      }; //Transport is full

      if (canLoad !== "Y") {
        loadOption.clickable = false;
        loadOption.message = canLoad;
      }

      optionsDisplay.push(loadOption);
    } //Join option


    var targetUnitPId = targetUnit.units_players_id;

    if (targetName === currentUnit.units_name && targetUnit.units_hit_points < 10 && !targetCargo && !currentCargo && targetUnitPId === getViewerPId()) {
      optionsDisplay.push({
        option: "Join",
        clickable: true
      });
      return optionsDisplay;
    }

    if (optionsDisplay.length !== 0) return optionsDisplay;
    return;
  } //Unload option


  var isLandingTile = checkLanding(currentCargo, currentUnit, x, y);

  if (isLandingTile && currentUnit.units_x === x && currentUnit.units_y === y) {
    optionsDisplay.push({
      option: "Unload",
      clickable: true
    });
  } //Repair option


  var neighbours = loopNeighbours(x, y, currentUnit);
  var alliedNeighbours = neighbours.allied.length !== 0;

  if (currentUnit.units_name === "Black Boat" && alliedNeighbours) {
    optionsDisplay.push({
      option: "Repair",
      clickable: true
    });
  } //Supply option


  if (currentUnit.units_name === "APC" && alliedNeighbours) {
    optionsDisplay.push({
      option: "Supply",
      clickable: true
    });
  } //Hide options


  if (currentUnit.units_name === "Stealth" || currentUnit.units_name === "Sub") {
    var hideOption = {
      option: "",
      clickable: true
    };
    var subDive = currentUnit.units_sub_dive;

    if (subDive === "N" || subDive === "R") {
      hideOption.option = "Hide";
      optionsDisplay.push(hideOption);
    } else {
      hideOption.option = "Unhide";
      optionsDisplay.push(hideOption);
    }
  } //Capture & Silo options


  var unitTeam = playersInfo[currentUnit.units_players_id].players_team;
  var targetTile = buildingsInfo[x] && buildingsInfo[x][y] ? buildingsInfo[x][y] : "Terrain";

  if (currentUnit.units_name === "Infantry" || currentUnit.units_name === "Mech") {
    var terrainName = targetTile.terrain_name;

    if (targetTile !== "Terrain" && unitTeam !== targetTile.buildings_team && !/Silo|Rubble/.test(terrainName)) {
      optionsDisplay.push({
        option: "Capt",
        clickable: true
      }); //Silo
    } else if (/(Silo)$/.test(terrainName)) {
      optionsDisplay.push({
        option: "Launch",
        clickable: true
      });
    }
  } //Explode option


  if (currentUnit.units_name === "Black Bomb") {
    optionsDisplay.push({
      option: "Explode",
      clickable: true
    });
  } //Fire option
  //Don't calculate damage for indirects that have moved


  if (currentUnit.units_short_range && (currentUnit.units_x !== x || currentUnit.units_y !== y)) {} else if (currentUnit.units_ammo !== 0 || currentUnit.units_second_weapon) {
    //Get units in range of attacker and store in currentClick
    var unitsInRange = findUnitsInRangeOf(x, y, currentUnit, false);

    if (unitsInRange.length !== 0) {
      var unitAmmo = currentUnit.units_ammo;
      var secondWeapon = currentUnit.units_second_weapon;
      var fireOption = {
        option: "Fire",
        clickable: true
      };

      if (!unitAmmo && !secondWeapon) {
        fireOption.clickable = false;
        fireOption.message = "Unit has no ammos!";
      }

      optionsDisplay.unshift(fireOption);
      currentClick.unitsInRange = unitsInRange;
    }
  } //Delete option


  if (x === currentUnit.units_x && y === currentUnit.units_y) {
    optionsDisplay.push({
      option: "Delete",
      clickable: true
    });
  } //Wait option


  optionsDisplay.push({
    option: "Wait",
    clickable: true
  });
  return optionsDisplay;
} //Check if transport unit's tile is on a tile where it can unload


function checkLanding(cargo, unit, x, y) {
  var terrainName = terrainInfo[x] && terrainInfo[x][y] && terrainInfo[x][y].terrain_name || buildingsInfo[x] && buildingsInfo[x][y] && buildingsInfo[x][y].terrain_name;
  if (!terrainName) return;
  var unitName = unit.units_name;
  if (!cargo) return false; //Landers and black boats can unload anywhere

  if ((unitName === "T-Copter" || unitName === "Lander" || unitName === "Black Boat") && !/Sea|Reef/.test(terrainName)) {
    return true;
  } else if (unitName === "APC" || unitName === "Cruiser" || unitName === "Carrier") {
    return true;
  }
} //Check if unit is able to load in transport


function checkCargo(cargoUnit, currentUnit) {
  var firstCargo = cargoUnit.units_cargo1_units_id;
  var secondCargo = cargoUnit.units_cargo2_units_id;
  var mType = currentUnit.units_movement_type;
  var fullMsg = "Transport is full!";
  var cargoPId = cargoUnit.units_players_id;
  var currentUnitPId = currentUnit.units_players_id;

  if (cargoPId !== currentUnitPId) {
    return "Transport is not own";
  }

  if (currentUnit.units_name === "Infantry" || currentUnit.units_name === "Mech") {
    if (cargoUnit.units_name === "APC" || cargoUnit.units_name === "T-Copter") {
      if (!firstCargo) {
        return "Y";
      }

      return fullMsg;
    } else if (cargoUnit.units_name === "Black Boat") {
      if (!firstCargo || !secondCargo) {
        return "Y";
      }

      return fullMsg;
    }
  }

  if ((currentUnit.units_name === "B-Copter" || currentUnit.units_name === "T-Copter") && cargoUnit.units_name === "Cruiser") {
    if (!firstCargo || !secondCargo) {
      return "Y";
    } else {
      return fullMsg;
    }
  } else if (mType === "A" && cargoUnit.units_name === "Carrier") {
    if (!firstCargo || !secondCargo) {
      return "Y";
    }

    return fullMsg;
  } else if (mType !== "A" && mType !== "L" && mType !== "S" && cargoUnit.units_name === "Lander") {
    if (!firstCargo || !secondCargo) {
      return "Y";
    }

    return fullMsg;
  }

  return false;
} //Check if enough funds to repair


function checkIfCanRepair(alliedNeighbours, repairHp) {
  var playerFunds = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_funds;
  var repairableUnits = [];
  alliedNeighbours.forEach(function (ally) {
    var unitCost = ally.units_cost;
    var unitHp = ally.units_hit_points; //Skip if unit is not owned by viewer or not enough funds

    if (unitHp < 10 && playerFunds < unitCost / 10 * repairHp) return;
    repairableUnits.push(ally);
  });
  return repairableUnits;
}

function calculateDamage(attackerUnit, defenderUnit, endTile) {
  var attackerPId = attackerUnit.units_players_id;
  var defenderPId = defenderUnit.units_players_id;
  var attackerInfo = getPlayerInfo(playersInfo[attackerPId], attackerUnit, "attacker", endTile);
  var defenderInfo = getPlayerInfo(playersInfo[defenderPId], defenderUnit, "defender");
  return axios.post("api/calculator/calculate_new.php", {
    attacker: attackerInfo,
    defender: defenderInfo,
    gameId: gameId
  });

  function getPlayerInfo(player, unit, position, endTile) {
    var x = unit.units_x;
    var y = unit.units_y;
    var pipeSeam = unit.units_name === "Pipe Seam";
    var unitRange = unit.units_short_range;

    if (position === "attacker" && unitRange <= 1 && endTile) {
      //Take position at the end of the path
      x = endTile % maxX;
      y = (endTile - x) / maxX;
    }

    var terrain = terrainInfo[x] && terrainInfo[x][y] ? terrainInfo[x][y] : buildingsInfo[x][y];

    if (!pipeSeam) {
      return {
        cities: GAME_FLAGS__KINDLE_SCOP ? player.numProperties : player.cities,
        co: {
          co_name: player.co_name.replace(" ", ""),
          co_id: player.players_co_id
        },
        country: {
          code: player.countries_code,
          name: player.countries_name.replace(" ", "")
        },
        funds: player.players_funds,
        hp: unit.units_hit_points,
        playerId: player.players_id,
        power: player.players_co_power_on,
        terrain: {
          terrain_name: terrain.terrain_name.replace(/[_ ]/g, ""),
          id: terrain.terrain_id,
          terrain_defense: terrain.terrain_defense
        },
        towers: player.towers,
        unit: {
          units_ammo: unit.units_ammo,
          units_name: unit.units_name.replace(" ", ""),
          unit_id: unit.units_id,
          units_id: genericUnits[unit.units_name].units_id
        }
      };
    } else {
      //Default values for pipe seams
      return {
        cities: 0,
        co: {
          co_name: "Andy",
          co_id: 1
        },
        country: {
          code: "os",
          name: "OrangeStar"
        },
        funds: 0,
        hp: 10,
        power: "N",
        terrain: {
          terrain_name: "HRoad",
          id: 15,
          terrain_defense: 0
        },
        towers: 0,
        unit: {
          units_name: "Pipe Seam",
          units_id: 46
        }
      };
    }
  }
} //Function to check if owned units are around target coords(Repair option, hide unit)


function loopNeighbours(x, y, movingUnit) {
  var xv = [-1, 1, 0, 0];
  var yv = [0, 0, -1, 1];
  var neighbours = {
    allied: [],
    enemy: [],
    team: []
  }; //If a unit is given, take it's coordinates
  //Otherwise take the coordinates given as parameters

  var unitX = movingUnit && movingUnit.units_x !== null ? movingUnit.units_x : null;
  var unitY = movingUnit && movingUnit.units_y !== null ? movingUnit.units_y : null;
  var startX = unitX !== null ? unitX : x;
  var startY = unitY !== null ? unitY : y;
  var viewerTeam = playersInfo[getViewerPId()] && playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team;

  for (var _i16 = 0; _i16 < 4; _i16++) {
    var ax = x + xv[_i16];
    var ay = y + yv[_i16];
    var unitId = unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay] ? unitMap[ax][ay].units_id : null;
    var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];

    if (unit) {
      var unitTeam = playersInfo[unit.units_players_id].players_team;

      if (unitId && unit.units_players_id === getViewerPId()) {
        //Don't add moving unit to own units
        if (ax === startX && ay === startY) {} else {
          neighbours.allied.push(unit);
        }
      }

      if (unitId && (unitTeam === viewerTeam || grantedVisions[unitTeam])) {
        neighbours.team.push(unit);
      }

      if (unitTeam !== viewerTeam) {
        neighbours.enemy.push(unit);
      }
    }
  }

  return neighbours;
} //find which tiles loaded units can unload to from given transport


function findLandingTiles(cargoUnit, loadedUnit, x, y) {
  var player = playersInfo[cargoUnit.units_players_id];
  var unitTeam = player.players_team;
  var loadedUnitMType = loadedUnit.units_movement_type;
  var xv = [-1, 1, 0, 0];
  var yv = [0, 0, -1, 1];
  var landingTiles = []; //Loop adjacent tiles to transport

  for (var _i17 = 0; _i17 < 4; _i17++) {
    var ax = x + xv[_i17];
    var ay = y + yv[_i17];
    var loadedUnitMCost = findTerrainCost(loadedUnitMType, ax, ay, unitTeam, player); //Skip if loaded unit has no terrain cost on landing terrain

    if (!loadedUnitMCost || loadedUnitMCost === "A") continue;
    var cargoUnitId = cargoUnit.units_id;
    var adjacentUnitId = unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay] ? unitMap[ax][ay].units_id : null; //Skip if there is a unit adjacent to the end of the path and the unit is not itself
    //Since the unit hasn't actually moved yet when the option appears

    if (adjacentUnitId && adjacentUnitId !== cargoUnitId) continue;
    landingTiles.push({
      x: ax,
      y: ay
    });
  }

  return landingTiles;
} //Find units that are in attack range of given unit
//Used to draw clickable attack squares


function findUnitsInRangeOf(x, y, currentUnit) {
  var maxRange = currentUnit.units_long_range;
  var minRange = currentUnit.units_short_range;
  var currentUnitTeam = playersInfo[currentUnit.units_players_id].players_team; //Increment range by 1 for direct units for the loop

  if (minRange <= 0) {
    minRange = 1;
    maxRange = 1;
  }

  var attAmmo = currentUnit.units_ammo;
  var attName = currentUnit.units_name;
  var attGenId = genericUnits[currentUnit.units_name].units_id;
  var unitsInRange = [];

  for (var _i18 = -maxRange; _i18 <= maxRange; _i18++) {
    for (var j = -maxRange; j <= maxRange; j++) {
      var absoluteSum = Math.abs(_i18) + Math.abs(j);

      if (absoluteSum <= maxRange && absoluteSum >= minRange) {
        var ax = x + _i18;
        var ay = y + j;
        var terrainName = buildingsInfo[ax] && buildingsInfo[ax][ay] ? buildingsInfo[ax][ay].terrain_name : "Terrain";
        var ATTACK1 = baseDamageValues.ATTACK1;
        var ATTACK2 = baseDamageValues.ATTACK2; //If there is a unit and a pipe seam on the same tile, only add the unit
        //Enemy unit is in range

        if (unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay] && unitMap[ax][ay].team !== currentUnitTeam) {
          var unitId = unitMap[ax][ay].units_id;
          var unit = unitsInfo[unitId];
          var defGenId = genericUnits[unit.units_name].units_id;

          if (!(ATTACK1[attGenId] && ATTACK1[attGenId][defGenId]) && !(ATTACK2[attGenId] && ATTACK2[attGenId][defGenId])) {
            continue;
          } //Skip out of ammos with no secondary attack


          if (ATTACK1[attGenId] && ATTACK1[attGenId][defGenId] && attAmmo === 0 && !(ATTACK2[attGenId] && ATTACK2[attGenId][defGenId])) continue; //Exclude hidden units that can't be attacked by certain units

          var defName = unit.units_name;
          var subDive = unit.units_sub_dive;
          var defHidden = subDive === "Y" || subDive === "D";
          if (defHidden && defName === "Stealth" && attName !== "Stealth" && attName !== "Fighter") continue;
          if (defHidden && defName === "Sub" && attName !== "Cruiser" && attName !== "Sub") continue;
          unitsInRange.push(unitsInfo[unitId]);
        } //Terrain in range is pipe seam: only add if there is no unit on top of it
        //Use Neotank as defender
        else if (/Seam/.test(terrainName) && !(unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay])) {
          var _defGenId = genericUnits["Neotank"].units_id;

          if (!(ATTACK1[attGenId] && ATTACK1[attGenId][_defGenId]) && !(ATTACK2[attGenId] && ATTACK2[attGenId][_defGenId])) {
            continue;
          } //Skip out of ammos with no secondary attack


          if (ATTACK1[attGenId] && ATTACK1[attGenId][_defGenId] && attAmmo === 0 && !(ATTACK2[attGenId] && ATTACK2[attGenId][_defGenId])) continue;
          unitsInRange.push({
            units_id: buildingsInfo[ax][ay].buildings_id,
            units_name: "Pipe Seam",
            units_x: ax,
            units_y: ay
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return unitsInRange;
}

function openMenu(menu, x, y) {
  var tileWidth = 16 * scale;
  applyCSS(menu, {
    display: "flex",
    left: x * tileWidth + tileWidth + "px",
    top: y * tileWidth + "px"
  });
  var menuBottomPos = menu.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  var mapBottomPos = gameContainer.getBoundingClientRect().bottom; //Move menu upward if it goes out of the map
  // let menuTopOffset = 0;
  // if(menuBottomPos < mapBottomPos) return;
  // menu.style.top = 0;
  // menuTopOffset = menuBottomPos - mapBottomPos;
  // menu.style.top = y * tileWidth - menuTopOffset + "px";
}

function closeMenu() {
  unitOptionsMenu.style.display = "none"; // Close all build menu things

  buildOptionsMenu.style.display = "none";
  buildConfirmationMenu.style.display = "none";
  buildConfirmationBtn.onclick = null;
  showCountryColorMenu("close");
}

function resetAttack() {
  damageDisplay.style.display = "none";
}

function resetUnit() {
  if (currentClick && currentClick.info && currentTurn === getViewerPId()) {
    currentClick = {
      path: []
    };
    moving = false;
  }
}

function resetCreatedTiles(tileClasses) {
  var movementTiles = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(tileClasses));
  movementTiles.forEach(function (t) {
    t.parentElement.removeChild(t);
  });
}

var lastMouseMoveEvent = null;

function updateCoords(e) {
  var forceRedraw = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;
  var offset = getOffset(map);
  var mapLeft = Math.round(offset.left, 0);
  var mapTop = Math.round(offset.top, 0);
  var pageX = e.pageX;
  var pageY = e.pageY;

  if (e.touches && e.touches.length > 0) {
    pageX = e.touches[0].pageX;
    pageY = e.touches[0].pageY;
  } else if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches.length > 0) {
    pageX = e.changedTouches[0].pageX;
    pageY = e.changedTouches[0].pageY;
  }

  var mX = pageX - mapLeft;
  var mY = pageY - mapTop;
  coordX = Math.floor((pageX - mapLeft) / (16 * scale));
  coordY = Math.floor((pageY - mapTop) / (16 * scale));
  var ax = coordX,
      ay = coordY;

  if (coordX < 10) {
    ax = "0" + coordX;
  }

  if (coordY < 10) {
    ay = "0" + coordY;
  }

  var draw = forceRedraw || coordX != pX || coordY != pY;

  if (draw) {
    if (mX > 0 && mX < maxX * 16 * scale && mY > 0 && mY < maxY * 16 * scale) {
      updateTileDisplay(coordX, coordY);
      updateCursor(coordX, coordY);
      var coords = "(" + ax + "," + ay + ")";
      coordsDisplay.textContent = coords;
      var dmgSquare = e.target.classList && e.target.classList.contains("dmg-square");

      if (moving) {
        if (dmgSquare && currentClick.info.units_short_range >= 1) return;
        var path = drawPathTiles(movementInfo, coordX, coordY, currentClick.path);
        currentClick.path = path;
      } else if (showSiloRange) {
        resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='square']");
        createSquareInRangeOf(2, 0, "silo", coordX, coordY, siloClickHandler);
      }
    }
  }

  pX = coordX;
  pY = coordY;
  lastMouseMoveEvent = e;
}

function updateCursor(cursorX, cursorY) {
  applyCSS(cursor, {
    display: "block",
    left: cursorX * 16 - 6 + "px",
    top: cursorY * 16 - 5 + "px"
  });
} //Ran on page load


function checkPowers() {
  for (var player in playersInfo) {
    addPowerBonusesOnLoad(playersInfo[player].players_id);
  }
} //Already done in game map viewer data


function addPowerBonusesOnLoad(playerId) {
  var endTurn = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : false;
  var coPower = playersInfo[playerId].players_co_power_on;
  if (coPower !== "Y" && coPower !== "S") return;

  for (var unit in unitsInfo) {
    addBonus(unitsInfo[unit], playerId, coPower, endTurn);
  }
}

function addBonus(unit, playerId, coPower) {
  var endTurn = arguments.length > 3 && arguments[3] !== undefined ? arguments[3] : false;
  if (playerId !== unit.units_players_id) return;
  var one = 1;
  var two = 2; //Negate bonuses on end turn

  if (endTurn) {
    one = -1;
    two = -2;
  }

  var co = playersInfo[playerId].co_name;
  var mType = unit.units_movement_type;
  var unitRange = unit.units_long_range;

  if (co === "Sonja" && coPower !== "N") {
    var unitVision = unit.units_vision;
    var unitX = unit.units_x;
    var unitY = unit.units_y;
    var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
    var playerTeam = playerInfo.players_team;

    if (hasTeamVision(playerTeam)) {
      updateFog(unit, unitVision + one, playerInfo, null, null, unitX, unitY, !endTurn);
      updateFog(unit, unitVision, playerInfo, unitX, unitY, undefined, undefined, endTurn);
    }

    unit.units_vision += one;
  } else if (coPower === "Y") {
    if (co === "Adder" || co === "Koal") {
      unit.units_movement_points += one;
    } else if (co === "Max" && (mType === "A" || mType === "W" || mType === "T")) {
      unit.units_movement_points += one;
    } else if (co === "Jess" && (mType === "W" || mType === "T" || mType === "P")) {
      unit.units_movement_points += one;
    } else if (co === "Sami" && (mType === "F" || mType === "B")) {
      unit.units_movement_points += one;
    } else if (co === "Jake" && unitRange > 0) {
      unit.units_long_range += one;
    } else if (co === "Grit" && unitRange > 0) {
      unit.units_long_range += one;
    }
  } else if (coPower === "S") {
    if (co === "Adder" || co === "Koal") {
      unit.units_movement_points += two;
    } else if (co === "Max" && (mType === "A" || mType === "W" || mType === "T")) {
      unit.units_movement_points += two;
    } else if (co === "Jess" && (mType === "W" || mType === "T" || mType === "P")) {
      unit.units_movement_points += two;
    } else if (co === "Sami" && (mType === "F" || mType === "B")) {
      unit.units_movement_points += two;
    } else if (co === "Andy") {
      unit.units_movement_points += one;
    } else if (co === "Jake") {
      if (mType === "W" || mType === "T" || mType === "P") {
        unit.units_movement_points += two;

        if (unitRange > 0) {
          unit.units_long_range += one;
        }
      }
    } else if (co === "Grit" && unitRange > 0) {
      unit.units_long_range += two;
    }
  }
}

function getOffset(el) {
  var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  return {
    left: rect.left + window.pageXOffset,
    top: rect.top + window.pageYOffset
  };
}

function coordsFromNode(node) {
  var coords = {};

  if (node !== "?") {
    coords.x = node % maxX;
    coords.y = (node - coords.x) / maxX;
  } else {
    coords.x = "?";
    coords.y = "?";
  }

  return coords;
} //Function ran on page load to draw the Fog


function applyFog(fogInfo) {
  if (!fogInfo || gameEndDate && !freezeGame) return; //Fill the canvas then clear visible tiles

  fogCanvas.height = maxY * 16;
  fogCanvas.width = maxX * 16;
  fogCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)";
  fogCtx.fillRect(0, 0, fogCanvas.width, fogCanvas.height);

  for (var x in fogInfo) {
    for (var y in fogInfo[x]) {
      changeBuildingZIndex(x, y, 100);

      if (fogInfo[x][y] >= 1) {
        fogCtx.clearRect(x * 16, y * 16, 16, 16); //If building is in vision, put it above the fog canvas

        changeBuildingZIndex(x, y, 110);
      }
    }
  }
}
/** Checks if the viewer has vision of a team. */


function hasTeamVision(givenTeam) {
  if (getViewerPId() && playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team === givenTeam) {
    return true;
  } else if (grantedVisions && grantedVisions[givenTeam]) {
    return true;
  } else if (gameEndDate) {
    /* Everybody has shared vision when the game is over */
    return true;
  }

  return false;
} //add every player that has granted vision to user to the selector


function populateVisionSelector(grantedVisions) {
  if (!grantedVisions) return;
  var visionSelector = document.querySelector(".vision-switch-selector select");
  var f = document.createDocumentFragment();
  var seenTeams = {};

  for (var playerPID in grantedVisionPIDs) {
    var optionText = grantedVisionPIDs[playerPID]; //Team is the player's id in this case

    if (optionText.length > 1) {
      optionText = playersInfo[playerPID].users_username;
    }

    if (optionText in seenTeams) {
      continue;
    }

    seenTeams[optionText] = optionText;
    var option = document.createElement("option");
    option.textContent = optionText;
    option.value = playerPID;
    f.appendChild(option);
  }

  if (activeVision.playerID) {
    var currentPlayerOption = document.createElement("option");
    currentPlayerOption.textContent = "Current Player";
    currentPlayerOption.value = "Current Player";
    currentPlayerOption.lastPlayerID = playersInfo[activeVision.playerID].players_id;
    visionSelector.lastPlayerID = playersInfo[activeVision.playerID].players_id;
    f.prepend(currentPlayerOption);
  }

  visionSelector.onchange = function () {
    var playerPID = visionSelector.value;
    var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerPID];

    if (playerPID == "Current Player") {
      playerInfo = playersInfo[visionSelector.lastPlayerID];
    }

    var visionChangeData = {
      playerTeam: playerInfo.players_team,
      gameId: gameId
    };
    /* emitData(webSocket, visionChangeData); */

    postData("api/game/swap_vision.php", visionChangeData).then(function (_ref) {
      var data = _ref.data;

      if (data.err) {
        return handleClientError(data);
      } //player id of the player who has granted vision to viewer


      var playerId = data.playerId;
      swapActiveVision(playerId);
    })["catch"](catchError);
  };

  visionSelector.appendChild(f);
}

function maybeUpdateActiveVisionTeam(currentTurnPID, currentTeam) {
  var visionSelector = document.querySelector(".vision-switch-selector select");

  if (!visionSelector || !grantedVisions) {
    return;
  }

  if (visionSelector.value != "Current Player" || !grantedVisionPIDs[currentTurnPID]) {
    return;
  }

  visionSelector.lastPlayerID = currentTurnPID;
  var visionChangeData = {
    playerTeam: currentTeam,
    gameId: gameId
  };
  /* emitData(webSocket, visionChangeData); */

  postData("api/game/swap_vision.php", visionChangeData).then(function (_ref2) {
    var data = _ref2.data;

    if (data.err) {
      return handleClientError(data);
    } //player id of the player who has granted vision to viewer


    var playerId = data.playerId;
    swapActiveVision(playerId);
  })["catch"](catchError);
} //fetch new fog array


function swapActiveVision(newActiveVisionPID) {
  var url = "api/game/";
  var swapVisionData; //Get new board info for:
  //Non replay mode

  if (!freezeGame) {
    url += "fetch_game_viewer_data.php";
    swapVisionData = {
      playersID: newActiveVisionPID
    };
  } //replay mode on
  else {
    url += "load_replay.php";
    swapVisionData = {
      gameId: gameId,
      turn: gameTurn,
      activeVisionPId: newActiveVisionPID
    }; // Clear the stored replays when vision changes as they may be for the wrong activeVision

    replay = {};
  } // Hotseat, need to request a vision change


  if (allViewerPId.length > 1 && allViewerPId.includes(newActiveVisionPID)) {
    axios.post("/".concat(wsServerBranch, "/game/swapVision"), {
      userId: playersInfo[newActiveVisionPID].users_id,
      gameId: gameId,
      playerId: playersInfo[newActiveVisionPID].players_id,
      playerTeam: playersInfo[newActiveVisionPID].players_team
    }).then(function (response) {
      if (response.data.error) handleClientError(response.data.error);
    });
  }

  postData(url, swapVisionData).then(function (_ref3) {
    var data = _ref3.data;

    if (data.err) {
      return handleClientError(data);
    } //first is when loaded from replay


    var gameState = data.gameState || data;
    activeVision.playerID = playersInfo[newActiveVisionPID].players_id;
    activeVision.team = playersInfo[newActiveVisionPID].players_team; // If the game is not active and we didn't request data from a replay, then don't use it

    if (!gameState || !gameState.game || gameState.game["games_active"] == "N") return;
    var newVisionState = {
      buildingsInfo: gameState.buildings,
      currentTurnPId: gameState.currentTurnPId,
      gameTurn: gameTurn,
      gameWeather: gameState.gameWeather,
      playersInfo: gameState.players,
      playersUnits: gameState.players_units,
      playersUnitCount: gameState.players_units_count,
      playersBuildings: gameState.players_buildings,
      tagsInfo: gameState.tags,
      unitsInfo: gameState.units,
      unitMap: gameState.unit_map,
      fogInfo: gameState.fog_array
    };
    updateGameState(newVisionState); // If hotseating, swap vision

    if (allViewerPId.length > 1 && fogInfo) {
      var newFogInfo = data.fog_array;

      if (newFogInfo) {
        applyFog(newFogInfo);
        fogInfo = newFogInfo;
      }
    }
  })["catch"](catchError);
} //hiddenSkip is a check for Sonja's powers (skip Woods/Reefs)
//Needs to be given as a parameter for some specific cases


function updateFog(unitInfo, vision, playerInfo, iniX, iniY, newX, newY, hiddenSkip) {
  var delay = arguments.length > 8 && arguments[8] !== undefined ? arguments[8] : 0;
  var unitId = unitInfo.units_id;
  var viewerTeam = playersInfo[getViewerPId()] && playersInfo[getViewerPId()].players_team || activeVision.team;
  if (!fogInfo) return; //if not given as a parameter check in playerInfo

  hiddenSkip = hiddenSkip === undefined ? playerInfo && playerInfo.co_name === "Sonja" && playerInfo.players_co_power_on !== "N" : hiddenSkip; //Need different loops because either tile can be a mountain

  if (iniX !== null && iniY !== null) {
    //+3 vision to Infantry and Mech on Mountain
    vision = checkMountain(unitId, vision, iniX, iniY);

    for (var _i19 = -vision; _i19 <= vision; _i19++) {
      for (var j = -vision; j <= vision; j++) {
        var distanceToTerrain = Math.abs(_i19) + Math.abs(j);

        if (distanceToTerrain <= vision) {
          var _ret = function () {
            var ax = iniX + _i19;
            var ay = iniY + j;
            if (ax < 0 || ay < 0 || ax >= maxX || ay >= maxY) return "continue";
            var newTileVision = fogInfo[ax][ay] - 1;
            var unitTeam = unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay] && unitMap[ax][ay].team;
            var unitX = unitInfo.units_x;
            var unitY = unitInfo.units_y;
            var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(unitTeam); //Forest and Reefs

            var terrainName = terrainInfo[ax] && terrainInfo[ax][ay] && terrainInfo[ax][ay].terrain_name;

            if ((terrainName === "Wood" || terrainName === "Reef") && !hiddenSkip) {
              var teamNeighbours = getViewerPId() ? loopNeighbours(ax, ay, unitInfo).team : []; //Movement from Wood/Reef, set the tile to the number of allied neighbours

              if (ax === iniX && ay === iniY) {
                newTileVision = teamNeighbours.length; //Increment the Wood/Reef vision with the unit on the forest if applicable

                if (isViewerTeam && iniX === unitX && iniY === unitY) {
                  newTileVision++;
                }
              } else if (!checkHidden(ax, ay, iniX, iniY, viewerTeam, "Remove", hiddenSkip)) {
                return "continue";
              }
            }

            if (fogInfo && fogInfo[ax][ay] > 0) {
              fogInfo[ax][ay] = newTileVision;
            }
            /* if(fogInfo && fogInfo[ax][ay] === 0) {
              changeBuildingZIndex(ax, ay, 100);
              fogCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)";
              fogCtx.fillRect(ax * 16, ay * 16, 16, 16);
            }
             //Delete opponent's units out of vision if the game is not over
            if(fogInfo[ax][ay] === 0 && unitTeam && (unitTeam !== viewerTeam && !grantedVisions.includes(unitTeam))) {
              const unitId = unitMap[ax][ay].units_id;
              deleteUnitInfo(unitsInfo[unitId]);
              deleteUnitSpan(unitId);
            } */
            //visual updates after given delay (move, attack, etc)


            if (fogInfo && fogInfo[ax][ay] === 0) {
              setTimeout(function () {
                changeBuildingZIndex(ax, ay, 100);
                fogCtx.clearRect(ax * 16, ay * 16, 16, 16);
                fogCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)";
                fogCtx.fillRect(ax * 16, ay * 16, 16, 16);
              }, delay);

              var _unitId6 = unitMap[ax] && unitMap[ax][ay] && unitMap[ax][ay].units_id; //delete units that are not in the viewer's team if they exist
              //they may have been deleted already (out of fuel crash, etc)


              if (!_unitId6 || isViewerTeam) return "continue";
              setTimeout(function () {
                //delete the unit when the game is over
                //or put under fog canvas when it is(replay mode)
                if (!gameEndDate) {
                  deleteUnitInfo(unitsInfo[_unitId6]);
                  deleteUnitSpan(_unitId6);
                } else {
                  var unitSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + _unitId6 + "']");
                  applyCSS(unitSpan, {
                    "z-index": 103
                  });
                }
              }, delay);
            }
          }();

          if (_ret === "continue") continue;
        }
      }
    }
  } //Increment tiles with new position (move or build)


  if (newX !== undefined && newY !== undefined) {
    vision = checkMountain(unitId, vision, newX, newY);

    for (var _i20 = -vision; _i20 <= vision; _i20++) {
      for (var _j = -vision; _j <= vision; _j++) {
        var _distanceToTerrain = Math.abs(_i20) + Math.abs(_j);

        if (_distanceToTerrain <= vision) {
          var _ret2 = function () {
            var _terrainInfo$bx, _terrainInfo$bx$by;

            var bx = newX + _i20;
            var by = newY + _j;
            if (bx < 0 || by < 0 || bx >= maxX || by >= maxY) return "continue"; //New tile in vision's terrain check for Woods and Reefs
            //Add vision of Forest/Reef if ONE condition is met

            if (!checkHidden(bx, by, newX, newY, viewerTeam, "Add", hiddenSkip)) return "continue"; //don't add vision for teleport tiles

            if (((_terrainInfo$bx = terrainInfo[bx]) === null || _terrainInfo$bx === void 0 ? void 0 : (_terrainInfo$bx$by = _terrainInfo$bx[by]) === null || _terrainInfo$bx$by === void 0 ? void 0 : _terrainInfo$bx$by.terrain_id) == 195) return "continue"; //Increment tile's vision

            fogInfo[bx][by]++;
            setTimeout(function () {
              if (bx < 0 || by < 0 || bx >= maxX || by >= maxY) return;
              if (fogInfo[bx][by] <= 0) return;
              fogCtx.clearRect(bx * 16, by * 16, 16, 16);
              changeBuildingZIndex(bx, by, 110);
            }, delay);
          }();

          if (_ret2 === "continue") continue;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function checkMountain(unitId, vision, x, y) {
  var unitName = unitsInfo[unitId] ? unitsInfo[unitId].units_name : "Property";
  var terrainName = terrainInfo[x] && terrainInfo[x][y] ? terrainInfo[x][y].terrain_name : "Property";

  if (terrainName === "Mountain" && (unitName === "Infantry" || unitName === "Mech")) {
    vision += 3;
  }

  return vision;
}

function checkHidden(x, y, newX, newY, viewerTeam, type) {
  var hiddenSkip = arguments.length > 6 && arguments[6] !== undefined ? arguments[6] : false;
  var terrainName = terrainInfo[x] && terrainInfo[x][y] ? terrainInfo[x][y].terrain_name : "Property";

  if (terrainName === "Wood" || terrainName === "Reef") {
    //Skip forests & reefs for Sonja's powers
    if (hiddenSkip) return true; //Skip:
    //- Unit type on terrain is air
    //- Unit that moved is not adjacent to terrain

    var unitOnTerrain = unitMap[x] && unitMap[x][y] ? unitsInfo[unitMap[x][y].units_id] : null;
    var unitTeam = unitMap[x] && unitMap[x][y] ? unitMap[x][y].team : null;
    var unitOnTerrainMType = unitOnTerrain && unitOnTerrain.units_movement_type;
    var distanceToTerrain = Math.abs(x - newX) + Math.abs(y - newY);
    if (type === "Add" && (distanceToTerrain == 1 || distanceToTerrain === 0 || unitOnTerrainMType === "A" && unitTeam !== viewerTeam && !grantedVisions[unitTeam])) return true;
    if (type === "Remove" && (distanceToTerrain === 1 || distanceToTerrain === 0 || unitOnTerrainMType === "A" && unitTeam !== viewerTeam && !grantedVisions[unitTeam])) return true;
    return false;
  }

  return true;
} //This update the vision for forests/reefs when the opponent moves an air unit in/out of them


function updateAirUnitFogOnMove(x, y, mType, neighbours, unitVisible, change) {
  var delay = arguments.length > 6 && arguments[6] !== undefined ? arguments[6] : 0;
  var terrainName = terrainInfo[x] && terrainInfo[x][y] ? terrainInfo[x][y].terrain_name : "Property";

  if (fogInfo && (terrainName === "Wood" || terrainName === "Reef") && mType === "A") {
    if (change === "Add" && unitVisible) {
      fogInfo[x][y]++;
      setTimeout(function () {
        fogCtx.clearRect(x * 16, y * 16, 16, 16);
        changeBuildingZIndex(x, y, 110);
      }, delay);
    } else if (change === "Remove" && unitVisible) {
      //Check neighbouring units and replace the vision of the forest/reef by the amount of allied units that are next to it
      var teamNeighbours = neighbours.team;
      fogInfo[x][y] = teamNeighbours.length;

      if (fogInfo[x][y] === 0) {
        setTimeout(function () {
          fogCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)";
          fogCtx.fillRect(x * 16, y * 16, 16, 16);
          changeBuildingZIndex(x, y, 100);
        }, delay);
      }
    }
  }
} //prev building is for replays, for changing the position of HQs / Cities


function changeBuildingSprite(building, prevBuilding) {
  var buildingId = building.buildings_id;
  var buildingPId = building.buildings_players_id;
  var buildingName = building.terrain_name; //update building sprite per viewer color selections

  if (buildingPId) {
    var newBuildingCountry = countryNames[viewerColors[buildingPId]];
    Object.keys(countryNames).forEach(function (code) {
      //find current name
      if (buildingName.indexOf(countryNames[code]) >= 0) {
        buildingName = buildingName.replace(countryNames[code], newBuildingCountry);
      }
    });
  } //update sprite


  buildingName = buildingName.replace(/ /g, "").toLowerCase();
  var buildingSprite = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + buildingId + "'] img");
  var weatherName = gameWeather.code !== "C" ? "_" + gameWeather.name.toLowerCase() : "";
  buildingSprite.src = TP + buildingName + weatherName + ".gif";
  ensureSpriteVersion(buildingSprite); //Add clickable class

  if (buildingPId === getViewerPId() && /base|airport|port/.test(buildingName)) {
    buildingSprite.parentElement.classList.add("clickable");
  } //Changing the element's position


  if (!prevBuilding) return;
  var currentType = building.terrain_name.match(/HQ|City/);
  var prevType = prevBuilding.terrain_name.match(/HQ|City/); //no matches means position changes are not needed

  if (!currentType || !prevType) return;
  var offset;
  if (currentType[0] === "City" && prevType[0] === "HQ") offset = 9;else if (currentType[0] === "HQ" && prevType[0] === "City") offset = -9;
  if (!offset) return;
  var buildingSpan = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + buildingId + "']");
  applyCSS(buildingSpan, {
    top: parseInt(buildingSpan.style.top) + offset + "px"
  });
}

function changeBuildingZIndex(x, y, zIndex) {
  if (buildingsInfo[x] && buildingsInfo[x][y]) {
    var buildingEl = document.querySelector("span[data-building-id='" + buildingsInfo[x][y].buildings_id + "']");
    buildingEl.style.zIndex = zIndex;
  }
}

function changeBuildingOwner(oldPId, newPId, buildingInfo) {
  if (!buildingInfo) return;
  var x = buildingInfo.buildings_x;
  var y = buildingInfo.buildings_y;
  var buildingName = buildingInfo.terrain_name;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[oldPId]; //Building has to not be Neutral

  if (oldPId) {
    var oldOwner = playersBuildings[oldPId];
    delete oldOwner[x][y];

    if (Object.keys(oldOwner[x]).length === 0) {
      delete oldOwner[x];
    }
  } //No new player id means building went out of vision
  //end function


  if (!newPId) return; //Create player's building object
  //It does not exist at first in Fog when you don't see opponent's properties

  var newOwner = playersBuildings[newPId];
  var newPlayerInfo = playersInfo[newPId];

  if (!newOwner) {
    playersBuildings[newPId] = {};
    newOwner = playersBuildings[newPId];
  }

  if (!newOwner[x]) {
    newOwner[x] = {};
  } // Update urban properties


  if (playerInfo && playerInfo.numProperties > 0) playerInfo.numProperties--;
  newPlayerInfo.numProperties++; //Update cities

  if (/City/.test(buildingName)) {
    if (playerInfo && playerInfo.cities > 0) playerInfo.cities--;
    newPlayerInfo.cities++;
  } //Update towers
  else if (/Tower/.test(buildingName)) {
    if (playerInfo && playerInfo.towers > 0) playerInfo.towers--;
    newPlayerInfo.towers++;
  } //Update labs
  else if (/Lab/.test(buildingName)) {
    if (playerInfo && playerInfo.labs > 0) playerInfo.labs--;
    newPlayerInfo.labs++;
  }

  newOwner[x][y] = buildingInfo.buildings_id;
}

function resetBuildingCapture(unitId, x, y) {
  var unitName = unitsInfo[unitId] && unitsInfo[unitId].units_name;

  if (buildingsInfo[x] && buildingsInfo[x][y] && buildingsInfo[x][y].buildings_capture < 20 && (unitName === "Infantry" || unitName === "Mech")) {
    //There is already a unit on the tile, meaning the player joined a unit
    //Don't reset capture
    if (unitMap[x] && unitMap[x][y]) return;
    buildingsInfo[x][y].buildings_capture = 20;
    var captIcon = document.querySelector("span[data-unit-id='" + unitId + "'] .unit-licon");

    if (captIcon) {
      captIcon.parentElement.removeChild(captIcon);
    }
  }
}

function applyScale(n) {
  if (scale < 0.5 && n < 0) {
    return;
  } //do not allow to get too small
  else if (scale > 2.9 && n > 0) {
    return;
  } //do not allow to get too big
  else {
    scale = Math.round((scale + n) * 10) / 10; //increase scale
  }

  zoomLevel.textContent = scale.toFixed(1) + "x";
  var containerWidth = gameContainer.getBoundingClientRect().width;
  var containerRight = gameContainer.getBoundingClientRect().right;
  var mapWidth = maxX * 16 * scale; //Map is smaller than container, no scrollbars

  if (mapWidth <= containerWidth) {
    applyCSS(gamemapContainer, {
      height: maxY * 16 * scale + "px",
      overflow: "visible",
      width: mapWidth + "px"
    });
  } //Map goes out of the container, add scrollbars
  else {
    applyCSS(gamemapContainer, {
      height: maxY * 16 * scale + "px",
      overflow: "scroll",
      width: "100%"
    });
  }

  gamemap.style.transform = "scale(" + scale + ")";
  localStorage.setItem("scale", scale);
  var mapRight = gamemapContainer.getBoundingClientRect().right;
  updatePlayersTablePosition(containerRight, mapRight);
}

function updatePlayersTablePosition(containerRight, mapRight) {
  var playerBox = playersTable.querySelector(".player-overview-container");
  var playerBoxStyle = getComputedStyle(playerBox);
  var playerBoxMarginW = parseFloat(playerBoxStyle.marginLeft) + parseFloat(playerBoxStyle.marginRight);
  var playerBoxMarginH = parseFloat(playerBoxStyle.marginTop) + parseFloat(playerBoxStyle.marginBottom); // Include right-side padding + scrollbar gutter so side layout does not overflow gamecontainer.

  var playersTableW = playerBox.getBoundingClientRect().width + playerBoxMarginW + 10 + 18;
  var playerBoxH = playerBox.getBoundingClientRect().height + playerBoxMarginH;
  var showPlayerBoxesBelow = playerBoxPositionPreference === PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_BOTTOM || playerBoxPositionPreference === PLAYER_BOX_POSITION_AUTOMATIC && mapRight + playersTableW >= containerRight;

  if (showPlayerBoxesBelow) {
    //Table is moved under the map
    gameContainer.appendChild(playersTable);
    var tableH = playerCount > 4 ? 4 * playerBoxH : playerCount * playerBoxH;
    var tableW = Math.ceil(playerCount / 4) * playersTableW;
    applyCSS(playersTable, {
      alignItems: "center",
      display: "flex",
      flexDirection: "column",
      flexWrap: "wrap",
      height: tableH + "px",
      left: "0",
      margin: "0 auto",
      overflowY: "visible",
      paddingLeft: "0",
      position: "relative",
      width: tableW + "px"
    });
  } else {
    //Table is moved beside the map
    gamemapContainer.appendChild(playersTable);
    var mapH = maxY * 16 * scale;
    var playersTableH = playerBoxH * playerCount;
    applyCSS(playersTable, {
      alignItems: "center",
      display: "flex",
      flexDirection: "column",
      flexWrap: "nowrap",
      height: (playersTableH >= mapH ? mapH : playersTableH) + "px",
      left: "100%",
      margin: "unset",
      overflowY: playersTableH >= mapH ? "scroll" : "visible",
      paddingLeft: "0",
      position: "absolute",
      width: "auto"
    });
  }

  if (getViewerPId()) {
    updateViewerBoxPosition();
  }
}

function updateViewerBoxPosition() {
  if (!viewerInfoBox) return;
  var currentTop = viewerInfoBox.getBoundingClientRect().top;

  if (currentTop > window.innerHeight) {
    if (viewerBoxPosition === "top") return;
    var ref = gameMenuControls.querySelector("section");
    gameMenuControls.insertBefore(viewerInfoBox, ref);
    viewerBoxPosition = "top";
  } else if (viewerBoxPosition !== "bottom") {
    var _ref4 = nextPlayerBox || playersTable;

    var refBottom = _ref4.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;

    if (refBottom > window.innerHeight) return;

    if (nextPlayerBox) {
      playersTable.insertBefore(viewerInfoBox, nextPlayerBox);
    } else {
      playersTable.appendChild(viewerInfoBox);
    }

    viewerBoxPosition = "bottom";
  }
}

function applyCSS(el, styles) {
  if (!el) return;

  for (var prop in styles) {
    el.style[prop] = styles[prop];
  }
}

function findPlayersBuildings() {
  var playersBuildings = {};

  for (var x in buildingsInfo) {
    for (var y in buildingsInfo[x]) {
      var building = buildingsInfo[x][y];
      var buildingId = building.buildings_id;
      var buildingPId = building.buildings_players_id;

      if (!playersBuildings[buildingPId]) {
        playersBuildings[buildingPId] = {};
      }

      if (!playersBuildings[buildingPId][x]) {
        playersBuildings[buildingPId][x] = {};
      }

      playersBuildings[buildingPId][x][y] = buildingId;
    }
  }

  return playersBuildings;
} //Makes an object containing the unit ids each player has


function findPlayersUnits() {
  var playersUnits = {}; //Initialize every player

  playerKeys.forEach(function (playerId) {
    playersUnits[playerId] = {};
  });

  for (var unit in unitsInfo) {
    unit = unitsInfo[unit];
    var unitId = unit.units_id;
    var unitPId = unit.units_players_id;
    if (!unitPId) continue;
    playersUnits[unitPId][unitId] = unitId;
  }

  return playersUnits;
} //Makes an object containing the amount of each unit each player has


function findPlayersUnitCount() {
  var unitCounts = {};

  for (var playerId in playersUnits) {
    unitCounts[playerId] = {
      count: {},
      total: 0,
      value: 0
    };
    var unitIds = playersUnits[playerId];
    var cm = findCostMultiplier(playerId, true);

    for (var unitId in unitIds) {
      var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];
      var unitName = unitInfo.units_name;
      var unitCost = unitInfo.units_cost;
      var unitHp = unitInfo.units_hit_points;
      var playerUnits = unitCounts[playerId];

      if (!playerUnits.count[unitName]) {
        playerUnits.count[unitName] = 0;
      }

      playerUnits.count[unitName]++;
      playerUnits.value += unitCost * cm * unitHp / 10;
      playerUnits.total++;
    }

    displayUnitCount(playerId, unitCounts[playerId].count);
  }

  return unitCounts;
} //Function to display unit count for every unit a player has


function displayUnitCount(playerId, playerUnits) {
  var unitCountDisplay = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .unit-count-display div"); //Reset display

  unitCountDisplay.innerHTML = "";
  var playerCountry = playersInfo[playerId].countries_code;
  var countKeys = Object.keys(playerUnits); //Sort units by unit cost

  countKeys.sort(function (a, b) {
    var aCost = genericUnits[a].units_cost;
    var bCost = genericUnits[b].units_cost;
    return aCost - bCost;
  });
  var f = document.createDocumentFragment(); //Create unit's sprite to display

  countKeys.forEach(function (unitName) {
    var unitContainer = createUnitCountDisplayUnit(playerCountry, playerUnits, unitName);
    f.appendChild(unitContainer);
  });
  unitCountDisplay.appendChild(f);
}

function updateUnitCount(playerId, unitName, increment) {
  var updatedPTeam = playersInfo[playerId].players_team;
  var isViewerTeam = hasTeamVision(updatedPTeam);
  var unitsCount = playersUnitCount[playerId];
  unitsCount.total += increment;

  if (gameFog === "Y" && isViewerTeam || gameFog === "N") {
    updatePlayerRow(playerId, {
      "unit-count-total": unitsCount.total
    });
  } //Initiate count object


  if (!unitsCount.count) {
    unitsCount.count = {};
  }

  if (!unitsCount.count[unitName]) {
    unitsCount.count[unitName] = 1; //Need to redo the display to have the new unit in order and not
    //at the end of the list

    displayUnitCount(playerId, unitsCount.count);
  } //Unit already exists in the display, simply increment it in the
  //player's object and in the display
  else {
    var unitContainer = document.querySelector("#player" + playerId + " .unit-count-" + unitName.replace(/[ .]/g, "").toLowerCase());
    var _unitCount2 = unitContainer.children[1];
    unitsCount.count[unitName] += increment;
    _unitCount2.textContent = " x " + unitsCount.count[unitName]; //Count is at 0 after the update, delete unit from count and redo list

    if (unitsCount.count[unitName] === 0) {
      delete unitsCount.count[unitName];
      displayUnitCount(playerId, unitsCount.count);
    }
  }
} //Creates a div with the unit sprite along how many of that unit the the player has


function createUnitCountDisplayUnit(playerCountry, playerUnits, unitName) {
  var unitContainer = document.createElement("div");
  var unitSprite = new Image();
  unitSprite.setAttribute("draggable", false);
  var unitCount = document.createElement("span");
  unitCount.textContent = " x " + playerUnits[unitName];
  unitName = unitName.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase();
  unitSprite.src = TP + playerCountry + unitName + ".gif";
  ensureSpriteVersion(unitSprite);
  unitContainer.classList.add("unit-count-" + unitName.replace(".", ""));
  unitContainer.appendChild(unitSprite);
  unitContainer.appendChild(unitCount);
  return unitContainer;
}

function selectNextUnit(unitIndex, modifier) {
  var showMovement = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : true;

  //Skip if no next unit btn
  if (!nextUnitBtn) {
    //Return the same object for later uses
    return unitSelectorRef;
  }

  viewerUnits = playersUnits[getViewerPId()];
  var viewerUnitsKeys = Object.keys(viewerUnits);
  var viewerUnitsCount = viewerUnitsKeys.length - 1;
  var iterationCount = 0;
  var unitId;

  if (showMovement) {
    //Loop until the unit is a unit that hasn't moved
    while (iterationCount <= viewerUnitsCount) {
      if (unitIndex > viewerUnitsCount) {
        unitIndex = 0;
      } else if (unitIndex < 0) {
        //Case for previous unit selection
        unitIndex = viewerUnitsCount;
      }

      unitId = viewerUnitsKeys[unitIndex];
      var unitMoved = unitsInfo[unitId].units_moved;
      var unitCarried = unitsInfo[unitId].units_carried;
      if (unitMoved === 0 && unitCarried === "N") break;
      unitIndex += modifier;
      iterationCount++;
    }

    var _openBase = unitSelectorRef.openBase;

    if (!_openBase) {
      //Clear tiles if any and show next unit's movement
      resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square'], .action-square");
      unitClickHandler({
        id: unitId
      });

      if (lastMouseMoveEvent) {
        updateCoords(lastMouseMoveEvent, true);
      }
    } else {
      showBuildOptions(_openBase.x, _openBase.y);
    }
  }

  var nextUnitIndex = unitIndex + 1;
  var nextIterationCount = 0;
  var nextUnitId; //Same process as before, loop until the next unit is unmoved to display in the next
  //unit box

  while (nextIterationCount <= viewerUnitsCount) {
    if (nextUnitIndex > viewerUnitsCount) {
      nextUnitIndex = 0;
    } else if (nextUnitIndex < 0) {
      //Case for previous unit selection
      nextUnitIndex = viewerUnitsCount;
    }

    nextUnitId = viewerUnitsKeys[nextUnitIndex];
    var _unitMoved = unitsInfo[nextUnitId].units_moved;
    var _unitCarried = unitsInfo[nextUnitId].units_carried;
    if (_unitMoved === 0 && _unitCarried === "N") break;
    nextUnitIndex++;
    nextIterationCount++;
  }

  var openBase; //Units remain

  if (nextIterationCount <= viewerUnitsCount) {
    nextUnitDisplay(nextUnitId);
  } //No unmoved units left, check for open base
  else {
    openBase = openBaseCheck(getViewerPId());

    if (!openBase) {
      selectNextBtn.style.display = "none";
    } else {
      nextBuildingDisplay(openBase);
    }
  }

  var refObject = {
    index: unitIndex,
    displayedUnitId: parseInt(nextUnitId)
  };

  if (openBase) {
    refObject.openBase = {
      x: openBase.buildings_x,
      y: openBase.buildings_y
    };
  }

  return refObject;
}

function nextUnitDisplay(nextUnitId) {
  var nextUnit = unitsInfo[nextUnitId];
  if (!nextUnit) return;
  var nextUnitName = nextUnit.units_name;
  var nextUnitHp = nextUnit.units_hit_points;
  var countryCode = nextUnit.countries_code;

  if (viewerColors) {
    countryCode = viewerColors[nextUnit.units_players_id] || countryCode;
  }

  var unitSrc = TP + countryCode + nextUnitName.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase() + ".gif";
  var nextUnitImg = document.querySelectorAll("#select-next-unit img"); //Sprite

  var unitSprite = nextUnitImg[0];
  var unitContainer = nextUnitBtn.children[0];
  var hpSrc = TP + nextUnitHp + ".gif";
  var hpSpan;
  unitSprite.src = unitSrc;
  ensureSpriteVersion(unitSprite);

  if (nextUnitHp < 10) {
    //Hp icon already exists
    if (nextUnitImg[1]) {
      hpSpan = nextUnitImg[1];
      applyCSS(hpSpan, {
        display: "block"
      });
    } //Otherwise create it
    else {
      hpSpan = new Image();
      hpSpan.setAttribute("draggable", false);
      applyCSS(hpSpan, {
        bottom: "8px",
        position: "absolute",
        right: "8px"
      });
      unitContainer.appendChild(hpSpan);
    }

    hpSpan.src = hpSrc;
  } else if (nextUnitHp === 10 && nextUnitImg[1]) {
    hpSpan = nextUnitImg[1];
    applyCSS(hpSpan, {
      display: "none"
    });
    hpSpan.src = hpSrc;
  }
} //Display a building instead of a unit in the "Next" box


function nextBuildingDisplay(building) {
  var terrainName = building.terrain_name;
  var nextUnitImg = document.querySelectorAll("#select-next-unit img");
  var nextSprite = nextUnitImg[0];
  var hpSpan = nextUnitImg[1];
  nextSprite.src = TP + terrainName.replace(/ /g, "").toLowerCase() + ".gif";
  ensureSpriteVersion(nextSprite); //Hide HP if it's visible

  if (hpSpan) {
    hpSpan.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function openBaseCheck(playerId) {
  var playerBuildings = playersBuildings[playerId];

  for (var x in playerBuildings) {
    for (var y in playerBuildings[x]) {
      var building = buildingsInfo[x][y];
      var terrainName = building.terrain_name; //Building must be a base

      if (!/Base/.test(terrainName)) continue; //Building has a unit on it

      if (unitMap[x] && unitMap[x][y]) continue;
      return building;
    }
  } //No empty base found


  return;
} //Check if the moved unit was in the next unit box


function nextUnitCheck(selectedUnit) {
  var displayedUnitId = unitSelectorRef.displayedUnitId;
  var unitPId = selectedUnit.units_players_id;
  var selectedUnitId = selectedUnit.units_id;

  if (unitPId === getViewerPId() && selectedUnitId === displayedUnitId) {
    unitSelectorRef = selectNextUnit(unitSelectorRef.index + 1, 1, false);
  }
} //Select the next open base after building on one


function nextBaseCheck(selectedBase) {
  var basePId = selectedBase.buildings_players_id;
  var x = selectedBase.buildings_x;
  var y = selectedBase.buildings_y;
  var openBase = unitSelectorRef.openBase;

  if (basePId === getViewerPId() && openBase && openBase.x === x && openBase.y === y) {
    var nextOpenBase = openBaseCheck(getViewerPId());

    if (!nextOpenBase) {
      selectNextBtn.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }

    nextBuildingDisplay(nextOpenBase);
    unitSelectorRef.openBase = {
      x: nextOpenBase.buildings_x,
      y: nextOpenBase.buildings_y
    };
  }
}

function endTurn(action) {
  var endTurnData = {
    action: action,
    playerID: getViewerPId()
  };
  emitData(webSocket, endTurnData);
}

function openEndTurnConfScreen() {
  var tag = arguments.length > 0 && arguments[0] !== undefined ? arguments[0] : false;
  toggleConfMenu(endTurnConfScreen);

  if (tag) {
    endTurnConfHeader.textContent = "Tag COs and then End Turn?"; // Show the current player's tag switch with an animation

    endTurnCosContainer.style.display = "flex";
    endTurnCo.src = playersInfo[getViewerPId()].co_image_path;
    endTurnTagCo.src = tagsInfo[getViewerPId()].co_image_path;
    ensureSpriteVersion(endTurnCo);
    ensureSpriteVersion(endTurnTagCo); //Apply country's colors to the screen

    var eventColors = countriesColors[playersInfo[getViewerPId()].countries_code];
    var darkColor = eventColors.dark;
    var lightColor = eventColors.light; //Modify colors for less opacity

    var darkGrad = darkColor.replace(")", ", 0.4)");
    var lightGrad = lightColor.replace(")", ", 0.8)");
    [endTurnCo, endTurnTagCo].forEach(function (coElement) {
      applyCSS(coElement, {
        background: lightGrad,
        borderColor: lightColor,
        boxShadow: "3px 3px 2px 2px " + darkGrad
      });
    });
    setTimeout(function () {
      var boxWidth = endTurnCosContainer.clientWidth;
      endTurnCo.style.transform = "scale(0.7) translateX(" + boxWidth / 0.7 / 2 + "px)";
      endTurnTagCo.style.transform = "scale(1) translateX(" + -(boxWidth / 2) + "px)";
    }, 250);
  } else {
    endTurnConfHeader.textContent = "End Turn?";
    endTurnCosContainer.style.display = "none";
  } //Change the next country's text & logo


  for (var _i21 = 0; _i21 < playerCount; _i21++) {
    var playerId = playerKeys[_i21];
    if (playerId != getViewerPId()) continue; //Find the player after the viewer that is not eliminated

    _i21++;
    if (_i21 >= playerCount) _i21 = 0;
