    while (playersInfo[playerKeys[_i21]].players_eliminated !== "N") {
      _i21++;
      if (_i21 >= playerCount) _i21 = 0;
    }

    var nextPlayer = playersInfo[playerKeys[_i21]];
    var countryCode = nextPlayer.countries_code;
    var countryName = countryNames[countryCode];
    endTurnNextCountry.textContent = countryName;
    endTurnNextLogo.src = TP + countryCode + "logo.gif";
    ensureSpriteVersion(endTurnNextLogo);
    break;
  }
}

function endTurnConfirmation(action) {
  endTurnConfScreen.style.display = "none";
  closeMenu();
  resetCreatedTiles("span[class$='tile'], span[class$='square'], .action-square, .check-range-square");
  resetAttack();
  endTurn(action);
  toggleClickableClass(getViewerPId(), true);

  if (gameCop === "Y") {
    var copBtn = getMainPowerButton(getViewerPId(), "cop");
    var scopBtn = getMainPowerButton(getViewerPId(), "scop");
    setPowerButtonState(copBtn, false, false);
    setPowerButtonState(scopBtn, false, false);
  }

  endTurnCo.style.transform = "";
  endTurnTagCo.style.transform = "";
}

function deleteConfirmation(deleteData) {
  //Show screen and add listeners to buttons
  deleteConfScreen.style.display = "block";

  deleteConfBtn.onclick = function () {
    emitData(webSocket, deleteData);
    resetUnit();
    closeMenu();
    deleteConfScreen.style.display = "none";
  };

  deleteCancelBtn.onclick = function () {
    deleteConfScreen.style.display = "none";
  };
}

function showAngryNell() {
  angryNell.style.display = "block";
  setTimeout(function () {
    angryNell.style.opacity = 1;
  }, 25);
  setTimeout(function () {
    angryNell.style.opacity = 0;
    setTimeout(function () {
      angryNell.style.display = "none";
    }, 300);
  }, 3000);
}

function animUnit(path, unitId, unitSpan, unitTeam, viewerTeam) {
  var i = arguments.length > 5 && arguments[5] !== undefined ? arguments[5] : 0;
  if (!unitsInfo[unitId]) return;

  if (i < path.length) {
    var x = path[i].x;
    var y = path[i].y;
    var unitInfo = unitsInfo[unitId];
    var firstCargo = unitInfo.units_cargo1_units_id;
    var secondCargo = unitInfo.units_cargo2_units_id;
    var unitSprite = unitSpan.children[0];
    var hpSpan = unitSpan.children[1];
    var unitVisible = path[i].unit_visible;

    if (hpSpan) {
      hpSpan.style.visibility = "hidden";
    } //Find initial unit direction and skip to the first movement tile


    if (i === 0) {
      findSpriteDirection(path, unitId, unitSprite, x, y, i);
      return animUnit(path, unitId, unitSpan, unitTeam, viewerTeam, i + 1);
    }

    applyCSS(unitSpan, {
      left: x * 16 + "px",
      top: y * 16 + "px"
    });

    if (gameFog === "Y") {
      //Enemy unit enters vision from initial tile
      if (!unitVisible && i === 0) {
        applyCSS(unitSpan, {
          visibility: "hidden",
          zIndex: 100
        });
      } else {
        setTimeout(function () {
          applyCSS(unitSpan, {
            visibility: unitVisible ? "visible" : "hidden",
            zIndex: unitVisible ? 110 : 100
          });
        }, movementSpeed / 2);
      }
    }

    setTimeout(function () {
      animUnit(path, unitId, unitSpan, unitTeam, viewerTeam, i + 1); //End of Path and unit is in vision, put unit back above fog Canvas

      if (i === path.length - 1 && unitsInfo[unitId]) {
        unitSpan.style.zIndex = 110;
        waitUnit(unitId);

        if (hpSpan) {
          hpSpan.style.visibility = "visible";
        }

        unitSprite.style.transform = "scaleX(1)"; //Unit is Transport and has loaded units, open the menu with Unload option
        //when unit reached destination
        //game has to not be in replay mode

        var unitPId = unitInfo.units_players_id;
        var unitCarried = unitInfo.units_carried === "Y";

        if (unitPId === getViewerPId() && !unitCarried && (firstCargo || secondCargo) && !freezeGame) {
          var isLandingTile = checkLanding(true, unitInfo, x, y);

          if (isLandingTile) {
            if (!currentClick) currentClick = {};
            currentClick.info = unitInfo;
            showUnitOptions([{
              option: "Unload",
              clickable: true
            }], x, y);
          }
        }
      } //Change direction only when unit has reached the end of the tile


      if (path[i + 1]) {
        findSpriteDirection(path, unitId, unitSprite, x, y, i);
      }
    }, movementSpeed);
  }
}

function findSpriteDirection(path, unitId, unitSprite, x, y, i) {
  if (!unitsInfo[unitId] || !path[i + 1]) return;
  var nextX = path[i + 1].x;
  var nextY = path[i + 1].y;
  var currentNode = y * maxX + x;
  var nextNode = nextY * maxX + nextX;
  var direction = findDirection(currentNode - nextNode);
  movingSprite = findMovingSprite(unitsInfo[unitId], direction);
  unitSprite.src = movingSprite;
  ensureSpriteVersion(unitSprite); //Flip the sideway sprite to the proper direction

  if (direction === "left") {
    unitSprite.style.transform = "scaleX(-1)";
  } else if (direction === "right") {
    unitSprite.style.transform = "scaleX(1)";
  }
}

function findMovingSprite(unit, direction) {
  var countryCode = unit.countries_code,
      unitName = unit.units_name;

  if (viewerColors) {
    countryCode = viewerColors[unit.units_players_id] || countryCode;
  }

  var movingSprites = {
    right: "side",
    left: "side",
    up: "up",
    down: "down"
  };
  var cc = countryCode.toLowerCase();
  var name = unitName.replace(/[ .]/g, "").toLowerCase();
  var movingSprite = "terrain/aw2/movement/".concat(cc, "/").concat(cc).concat(name, "_m").concat(movingSprites[direction], ".gif");
  return movingSprite;
} // function showUnitMoving(unit, moving) {
//   const unitSprite = document.querySelector(`span[data-unit-id='${unit.units_id}'] .sprite`);
//   if(!unitSprite) return;
//   const immobileSprite = unitSprite.src;
//   unitSprite.src = moving ? findMovingSprite(unit, "right") : `${TP}${unit.countries_code}${unit.units_name}.gif`;
// }


function animExplosion(unit) {
  //Reset gif
  explosionIcon.src = "";
  var mType = unit.units_movement_type;

  if (["L", "S"].includes(mType)) {
    explosionIcon.src = "terrain/sea_explosion.gif";
  } else if (mType === "A") {
    explosionIcon.src = "terrain/air_explosion.gif";
  } else {
    explosionIcon.src = "terrain/land_explosion.gif";
  }

  ensureSpriteVersion(explosionIcon);
  var unitX = unit.units_x;
  var unitY = unit.units_y;
  animIcon(explosionIcon, 500, "", unitX, unitY, -8, -8);
} //offsetX / Y is in px


function animIcon(icon, delay, animation, x, y) {
  var offsetX = arguments.length > 5 && arguments[5] !== undefined ? arguments[5] : 0;
  var offsetY = arguments.length > 6 && arguments[6] !== undefined ? arguments[6] : 0;

  if (animation) {
    // Force reflow so the animation repeats if we call animIcon multiple times in a row
    // https://gist.github.com/paulirish/5d52fb081b3570c81e3a
    icon.classList.remove(animation);
    void icon.offsetWidth;
    icon.classList.add(animation);
  }

  applyCSS(icon, {
    display: "block",
    left: x * 16 + offsetX + "px",
    top: y * 16 + offsetY + "px",
    pointerEvents: "none"
  });

  if (animIconTimeoutMap.has(icon)) {
    window.clearTimeout(animIconTimeoutMap.get(icon));
  }

  var timeoutID = setTimeout(function () {
    icon.style.display = "none";

    if (animation) {
      icon.classList.remove(animation);
    }
  }, delay);
  animIconTimeoutMap.set(icon, timeoutID);
} //Sturm's CO powers


function animMeteor(coords) {
  var delay = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 3000;
  if (!coords) return;
  var x = coords[0].x;
  var y = coords[0].y; //Determine from where the meteor falls to the given coordinates

  var xTranslate = maxX / x > 2 ? 180 : -180;
  var yTranslate = maxY / y > 2 ? 180 : -180;
  gamemapContainer.classList.remove("anim-shake-screen");
  applyCSS(meteor, {
    display: "block",
    left: x * 16 - 33 + "px",
    top: y * 16 - 33 + "px",
    transform: "translateX(" + xTranslate + "px) translateY(" + yTranslate + "px) scale(2.4)"
  });
  setTimeout(function () {
    meteor.style.display = "none";
  }, delay);
  setTimeout(function () {
    gamemapContainer.classList.add("anim-shake-screen");
  }, delay / 2);
}

function animWarning(warningElement, displayWarning) {
  if (!warningElement) return;

  if (displayWarning) {
    applyCSS(warningElement, {
      display: "flex",
      width: 0
    });
  } //Small delay to make sure the display has changed before the animation begins


  setTimeout(function () {
    applyCSS(warningElement, {
      opacity: displayWarning ? 1 : 0,
      width: displayWarning ? "60px" : 0
    }); //Wait until animation is over before changing the display

    if (!displayWarning) {
      setTimeout(function () {
        warningElement.style.display = "none";
      }, 500);
    }
  }, 25);
}
/**
 * Moves a HTML element back and forth to create a wiggle effect.
 * @param {HTMLElement} element - The HTML element to wiggle.
 * @param {Number} startDelayMS - The delay in milliseconds before the element starts wiggling.
 * @param {Number} numberOfWiggles - The number of times the element should wiggle.
 */


function wiggleTile(element) {
  var startDelayMS = arguments.length > 1 && arguments[1] !== undefined ? arguments[1] : 0;
  var numberOfWiggles = arguments.length > 2 && arguments[2] !== undefined ? arguments[2] : 7;
  var deltaX = 2.25;
  var deltaY = 0.1;
  var steps = [];

  for (var _i22 = 0; _i22 < numberOfWiggles; _i22++) {
    if (_i22 % 2 === 0) {
      // wiggle right then left
      steps.push({
        dx: deltaX,
        dy: -deltaY
      });
      steps.push({
        dx: -deltaX,
        dy: deltaY
      });
    } else {
      // wiggle left then right
      steps.push({
        dx: -deltaX,
        dy: deltaY
      });
      steps.push({
        dx: deltaX,
        dy: -deltaY
      });
    }
  }

  window.setTimeout(function () {
    return animateHTMLElement(element, steps, 25);
  }, startDelayMS);
}
/**
 * Animates the movement of a div element through moving it by a certain number of pixels in each direction at each step.
 * @param {HTMLElement} element - The HTML element to animate.
 * @param {Object[]} animationSteps - An array of objects, each object can have a dx and dy property, representing the number of pixels to move the element in the x and y directions, respectively.
 * @param {Number} durationPerStepMS - The duration in milliseconds for each step of the animation.
 * @returns {Function} A function that can be called to cancel the animation.
 */


function animateHTMLElement(element, animationSteps, durationPerStepMS) {
  if (!element || !animationSteps || animationSteps.length === 0) return;

  if (currentPlayingHTMLAnimations.has(element)) {
    // Cancel any existing animations on the element
    var cancelPreviousAnimationFunction = currentPlayingHTMLAnimations.get(element);
    cancelPreviousAnimationFunction();
  } // Prepare for animation


  var originalX = parseFloat(element.style.left);
  var originalY = parseFloat(element.style.top);
  var startX = originalX;
  var startY = originalY;
  var currentStep = 0;
  var animationId;
  var startTime;
  var goalX;
  var goalY;

  function cancelAnimation() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
    element.style.left = originalX + "px";
    element.style.top = originalY + "px";
    currentPlayingHTMLAnimations["delete"](element);
  }

  function animateStep(timestamp) {
    // Finished animating
    if (currentStep >= animationSteps.length) {
      cancelAnimation();
      return;
    } // Start a new step


    if (!startTime) {
      var _step$dx, _step$dy;

      var step = animationSteps[currentStep];
      var dx = (_step$dx = step.dx) !== null && _step$dx !== void 0 ? _step$dx : 0;
      var dy = (_step$dy = step.dy) !== null && _step$dy !== void 0 ? _step$dy : 0;
      startTime = timestamp;
      goalX = startX + dx;
      goalY = startY + dy;
    }

    var elapsedTime = timestamp - startTime;
    var progress = elapsedTime / durationPerStepMS;
    var currentX = startX + (goalX - startX) * progress;
    var currentY = startY + (goalY - startY) * progress;
    element.style.left = currentX + "px";
    element.style.top = currentY + "px"; // Reached the target position

    if (progress >= 1) {
      currentStep++;
      startTime = null;
      startX = currentX;
      startY = currentY;
    }

    animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animateStep);
  }

  currentPlayingHTMLAnimations.set(element, cancelAnimation);
  animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animateStep);
  return cancelAnimation;
}

function showEventScreen(event) {
  //An event is already being displayed, add the next one to the queue
  if (eventScreenDisplayed) {
    eventQueue.push(event);
    return;
  } //Populate the event screen elements
  //elements' variables already declared at the start of the file


  eventUsername.textContent = event.username;
  eventText.textContent = event.text;
  eventCo.src = event.playerInfo.co_image_path;
  ensureSpriteVersion(eventCo);

  if (event.country) {
    eventCountry.src = TP + event.country.toLowerCase() + "logo.gif";
    ensureSpriteVersion(eventCountry);
  }

  if (event.tagCo) {
    eventTagCo.src = event.tagsInfo.co_image_path;
    eventTagCo.style.display = "block";
    ensureSpriteVersion(event.tagCo);
  } else {
    eventTagCo.style.display = "none";
  } //Apply country's colors to the Event screen


  var eventColors = countriesColors[event.country];
  var darkColor = eventColors.dark;
  var lightColor = eventColors.light; //Modify colors for less opacity

  var darkGrad = darkColor.replace(")", ", 0.4)");
  var lightGrad = lightColor.replace(")", ", 0.8)");
  applyCSS(eventScreenContent, {
    borderColor: lightColor
    /* color: darkColor */

  });
  [eventCo, eventTagCo].forEach(function (coElement) {
    applyCSS(coElement, {
      background: lightGrad,
      borderColor: lightColor,
      boxShadow: "3px 3px 2px 2px " + darkGrad
    });
  }); //Start animation

  eventScreenDisplayed = true;
  eventScreen.style.display = "block";
  eventScreenContainer.classList.add("event-screen-open");

  if (event.swapCos) {
    //Wait until the screen has finished expanding before swapping COs
    //Width and Height expand animations are both 0.5s each
    setTimeout(function () {
      var boxWidth = eventCosContainer.clientWidth;
      eventCo.style.transform = "scale(0.7) translateX(" + boxWidth / 0.7 / 2 + "px)";
      eventTagCo.style.transform = "scale(1) translateX(" + -(boxWidth / 2) + "px)";
    }, 1250);
  }

  eventScreenCloseTimer = setTimeout(closeEventScreen, 5000);
}

function closeEventScreen() {
  eventScreenDisplayed = false;
  eventCo.style.transform = "";
  eventTagCo.style.transform = "";
  eventScreen.style.display = "none";
  eventScreenContainer.classList.remove("event-screen-open"); //Display next event in queue

  if (eventQueue.length !== 0) {
    var nextEvent = eventQueue.shift(); //Small delay to make sure the class is removed before being readded

    setTimeout(function () {
      if (nextEvent.gameEndDate) {
        showEndGameScreen(nextEvent);
      } else if (nextEvent.co) {
        showEventScreen(nextEvent);
      }
    }, 25);
  }
}

function showEndGameScreen(event) {
  if (eventScreenDisplayed) {
    return eventQueue.push(event);
  }

  var winners = event.winners;
  var losers = event.losers;
  endGameDay.textContent = "Day " + event.day;
  endGameMessage.textContent = event.message;
  endGameScreen.style.display = "block";
  endGameNavOverview.style.display = "flex";
  swapClickedClass(endGameNavOverview, endGameNavStats); // Get end game stats

  var playerStats = postData("api/game/players_stats.php", {
    playerIDs: winners.concat(losers)
  }).then(function (res) {
    var playerStats = res.data;

    if (!playerStats) {
      return;
    }

    winners.forEach(function (winnerId, i) {
      updateEndGamePlayerRow(0, 1, 2, winnerId, playerStats[winnerId], "winner", i);
    }); //No losers for draws

    if (losers.length === 0) {
      var loserList = document.querySelector(".end-game-loser-list");
      loserList.style.display = "none";
      return;
    }

    losers.forEach(function (loserId, i) {
      updateEndGamePlayerRow(2, 1, 0, loserId, playerStats[loserId], "loser", i);
    });
  })["catch"](function (err) {
    console.error(err);
  });
} //The elements' indexes are reversed for winners / losers


function updateEndGamePlayerRow(coElIndex, usernameIndex, kdIndex, playerId, unitStats, side, i) {
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
  var coName = playerInfo.co_name.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase();
  var username = playerInfo.users_username;
  var countryCode = playerInfo.countries_code;
  var countryColors = countriesColors[countryCode];
  var playerList = document.querySelector(".end-game-" + side + "-list");
  var playerListTitle = document.querySelector(".end-game-" + side + "-title");
  var playerRow = document.querySelector(".end-game-" + side);
  var countryLogo = document.querySelector(".end-game-" + side + "-title img"); //Clone the existing row and change the elements after the first one

  if (i !== 0) {
    playerRow = playerRow.cloneNode(true);
    countryLogo = countryLogo.cloneNode();
  }

  var coImage = side === "loser" ? playerInfo.co_grayscale_image_path : playerInfo.co_image_path;
  playerRow.children[coElIndex].src = coImage;
  ensureSpriteVersion(playerRow.children[coElIndex]);
  playerRow.children[usernameIndex].textContent = username;
  countryLogo.src = TP + countryCode + "logo.gif";
  ensureSpriteVersion(countryLogo); //get kill/death

  var killCount = 0;
  var deathCount = 0;
  unitStats === null || unitStats === void 0 ? void 0 : unitStats.forEach(function (unit) {
    killCount += unit.kills;
    deathCount += unit.deaths;
  });
  var killSpan = playerRow.children[kdIndex].children[0];
  var deathSpan = playerRow.children[kdIndex].children[2];
  killSpan.textContent = killCount;
  deathSpan.textContent = deathCount;
  applyCSS(playerRow, {
    background: countryColors.light.replace(")", ", 0.4)"),
    borderColor: countryColors.dark
  }); //Append the new row

  if (i !== 0) {
    playerList.appendChild(playerRow); //For the losing team append the logo before the first element in the title

    if (side === "loser") {
      playerListTitle.insertBefore(countryLogo, playerListTitle.children[0]);
    } else {
      playerListTitle.appendChild(countryLogo);
    }
  }
}

function fetchStatsInfo(playerId) {
  postData("api/game/player_stats.php", {
    playerId: parseInt(playerId)
  }).then(function (res) {
    if (typeof res.data === "string") {
      return gameStatsErr.textContent = res.data;
    }

    gameStatsErr.textContent = "";
    displayStatsScreen(res.data, playerId);
  })["catch"](function (err) {});
}

function displayStatsScreen(playerStats, playerId) {
  var unitList = document.querySelector(".game-stats-units-list");
  unitList.innerHTML = "";
  var killBtn = document.querySelector(".game-stats-kills");
  var deathBtn = document.querySelector(".game-stats-deaths");
  swapClickedClass(killBtn, deathBtn);
  var username = playersInfo[playerId].users_username;
  gameStatsUsername.textContent = username;
  var playerInfo = playersInfo[playerId];
  var countryCode = playerInfo.countries_code;
  var countryColors = countriesColors[countryCode];
  var fadedColor = countryColors.light.replace(")", ", 0.4)");
  gameStatsScreen.style.borderColor = countryColors.light; //unitList.style.borderBottom = "2px solid " + fadedColor;

  var prevSelected = document.querySelector(".game-stats-select-" + currentStatsPId + " img");
  var selectedCountry = document.querySelector(".game-stats-select-" + playerId + " img");
  currentStatsPId = playerId;
  prevSelected.classList.remove("green-border");
  selectedCountry.classList.add("green-border");
  var f = document.createDocumentFragment();
  var killStore = {};
  var deathStore = {};
  var killCount = 0;
  var deathCount = 0;
  var totalKillValue = 0;
  var totalDeathValue = 0; //Add fund value of each unit to get total for the game

  var totalGeneratedFunds = playersInfo[playerId].players_funds;

  if (typeof totalGeneratedFunds !== "number") {
    totalGeneratedFunds = 0;
  } //set equal to 0 if still hidden (only relevant for fog)
  //Sort units by cost before displaying


  playerStats.sort(sortUnits); //Display every unit

  playerStats.forEach(function (unit) {
    var unitName = unit.unitName;
    var unitKills = unit.kills || 0;
    var unitDeaths = unit.deaths || 0;
    var killValue = unitKills * genericUnits[unitName].units_cost;
    var deathValue = unitDeaths * genericUnits[unitName].units_cost;
    totalKillValue += killValue;
    totalDeathValue += deathValue;

    if (unit.funds !== "?") {
      totalGeneratedFunds += unit.funds;
    }

    killStore[unitName] = unitKills;
    deathStore[unitName] = unitDeaths;
    if (unitKills) killCount += unitKills;
    if (unitDeaths) deathCount += unitDeaths;
    var unitImage = new Image();
    unitImage.setAttribute("draggable", false);
    unitImage.src = TP + countryCode + unitName.replace(" ", "").toLowerCase() + ".gif";
    ensureSpriteVersion(unitImage);
    var unitLi = document.createElement("li");
    unitLi.appendChild(unitImage);
    var countSpan = document.createElement("span"); //Hide units that haven't been killed
    //If kills is in the response it means there are deaths

    if (unitKills === 0) {
      unitLi.style.display = "none";
    }

    countSpan.textContent = "x " + unitKills;
    countSpan.classList.add("game-stats-unit-count", "bold");
    unitLi.appendChild(countSpan);
    f.appendChild(unitLi);
  });
  gameStatsGeneratedFunds.textContent = totalGeneratedFunds + " G.";
  gameStatsKillDeathValue.textContent = totalKillValue + " G.";
  gameStatsKillCount.textContent = killCount;
  gameStatsDeathCount.textContent = deathCount; //Button click changes the numbers

  killBtn.onclick = function () {
    swapClickedClass(killBtn, deathBtn);
    swapStats(killStore, totalKillValue);
  };

  deathBtn.onclick = function () {
    swapClickedClass(deathBtn, killBtn);
    swapStats(deathStore, totalDeathValue);
  };

  unitList.appendChild(f);

  function sortUnits(a, b) {
    var aCost = genericUnits[a.unitName].units_cost;
    var bCost = genericUnits[b.unitName].units_cost;
    return aCost - bCost;
  }

  function swapStats(store, storeValue) {
    var statCountSpans = document.querySelectorAll(".game-stats-unit-count");
    var unitLi = document.querySelectorAll(".game-stats-units-list li");
    var storeKeys = Object.keys(store);
    gameStatsKillDeathValue.textContent = storeValue + " G.";

    for (var _i23 = 0; _i23 < statCountSpans.length; _i23++) {
      var _unitCount3 = store[storeKeys[_i23]];
      statCountSpans[_i23].textContent = "x " + _unitCount3;
      unitLi[_i23].style.display = _unitCount3 !== 0 ? "flex" : "none";
    }
  }
}

function swapClickedClass(btnWith, btnWithout) {
  btnWith.classList.add("end-game-nav-clicked");
  btnWithout.classList.remove("end-game-nav-clicked");
}

function postData(url, data) {
  return axios.post(url, data);
}

function loadDamageValues() {
  axios.get("js/damage_inc.json").then(function (res) {
    baseDamageValues = res.data;
  })["catch"](function (err) {
    console.log(err);
  });
}

function testPost(url, data) {
  axios.post(url, data).then(function (res) {
    console.log(res.data);
  })["catch"](function (err) {
    console.log(err);
  });
}

function ensureSpriteVersion(element) {
  if (!element || !element.src || element.src.includes("?v=")) return;
  element.src += "?v=" + SPRITE_VERSION;
}

function debug_attack() {
  return _debug_attack.apply(this, arguments);
}

function _debug_attack() {
  _debug_attack = _asyncToGenerator( /*#__PURE__*/_regeneratorRuntime().mark(function _callee() {
    var getClickedUnit, getClickedTile, createAttackPath, createAttackData, attackerUnit, defenderUnit, attackTile, attackData;
    return _regeneratorRuntime().wrap(function _callee$(_context) {
      while (1) {
        switch (_context.prev = _context.next) {
          case 0:
            createAttackData = function _createAttackData(attackerUnit, defenderUnit, attackTile) {
              var attId = attackerUnit.units_id;
              var attackData = {
                action: "Fire",
                attacker: {
                  playerID: attackerUnit.units_players_id,
                  unitID: attId,
                  path: createAttackPath(attackerUnit, attackTile)
                }
              };

              if (defenderUnit.units_name !== "Pipe Seam") {
                attackData.defender = {
                  playerID: defenderUnit.units_players_id,
                  unitID: defenderUnit.units_id
                };
              } else {
                var defX = defenderUnit.units_x;
                var defY = defenderUnit.units_y;
                attackData.seamID = buildingsInfo[defX][defY].buildings_id;
                attackData.action = "AttackSeam";
              }

              return attackData;
            };

            createAttackPath = function _createAttackPath(attackerUnit, attackTile) {
              var startTile = {
                x: parseInt(attackerUnit.units_x, 10),
                y: parseInt(attackerUnit.units_y, 10)
              };
              var startNode = startTile.x + maxX * startTile.y;
              var attackNode = attackTile.x + maxX * attackTile.y;
              if (attackNode === startNode) return [startNode];
              var mp = attackerUnit.units_movement_points;
              if (attackerUnit.units_fuel < mp) mp = attackerUnit.units_fuel;
              var attackerTeam = playersInfo[attackerUnit.units_players_id].players_team;
              var movement = getMovementTiles(maxX, maxY, attackerUnit.units_movement_type, mp, startTile, attackerTeam, playersInfo[attackerUnit.units_players_id], false);
              return findShortestPath(movement, attackNode);
            };

            getClickedTile = function _getClickedTile() {
              return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                var handler = function handler(e) {
                  gamemap.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
                  updateCoords(e);
                  resolve({
                    x: coordX,
                    y: coordY
                  });
                };

                gamemap.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
              });
            };

            getClickedUnit = function _getClickedUnit() {
              return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                var handler = function handler(e) {
                  var unitSpan = e.target.closest("span.game-unit");
                  if (!unitSpan) return;
                  gamemap.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
                  var unitId = unitSpan.getAttribute("data-unit-id");
                  resolve(unitsInfo[unitId]);
                };

                gamemap.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
              });
            };

            console.log("Click attacker");
            _context.next = 7;
            return getClickedUnit();

          case 7:
            attackerUnit = _context.sent;
            console.log("Click defender");
            _context.next = 11;
            return getClickedUnit();

          case 11:
            defenderUnit = _context.sent;
            console.log("Click attack-from tile");
            _context.next = 15;
            return getClickedTile();

          case 15:
            attackTile = _context.sent;
            attackData = createAttackData(attackerUnit, defenderUnit, attackTile);
            console.log(attackData);
            emitData(webSocket, attackData);

          case 19:
          case "end":
            return _context.stop();
        }
      }
    }, _callee);
  }));
  return _debug_attack.apply(this, arguments);
}
